summary: Orange ball of light floats across the night sky
description:
Myself and another witness were outdoors celebrating the new year when we observed a single bright orange ball of light travel across the night sky. It stayed on a northerly track, did not change altitude, and took about 20 seconds to cross the horizon until it was out of view. Fireworks were being set off at the time, but this did not appear to be any kind of firework, chinese lantern, or paper on fire. It was too bright, fast, and tracked steadily. The sky was slightly foggy, but the ball of light was very visible. There was no sound.
Interestingly, this is my second report of this nature. The last one was in New Caney, TX on the night of July 4, 2012. There were also fireworks being set off that night, but without the fog I could clearly see it was a ball of what looked like fire. This was a nearly identical sighting in duration and way it behaved.
Also, upon talking to one of my neighbors since then, he also witnessed the one in 2012, although I did not know at the time of my report, so I did not include this information.

Each light move at the same pace as the other light. They each moved symmetrically away from each other, but remained in that 30 degree angle. Then the lights rotated around each other symmetrically. One light went lower as the other light went higher. Each light's movement and speed mirrored the others. This rotatation was about 180 degrees and only took the lights 3-5 seconds to complete. The lights then moved upwards and west into a cloud bank. I did not see the lights again. No sound was heard.

They were heading west in this triangular formation through the sky and then suddenly they vanished, all of them in a millisecond! We agree they probably crossed the sky in about 3-5 seconds! Myself and Alex are in shock tonight and we cannot understand how aircraft or any sort of projector could have pulled this off. Only seconds after their disappearance they reappeared, close to where they had vanished but much further away than before, appearing as a tighter triangular cluster or very dim beams. We could not see their disc shape at this stage as they were much further from us at this point, appearing as almost a star. At this point we spotted a regular plane in the sky at normal aircraft distance from us and then heard a helicopter shortly after this. This had distracted us and we then looked back to see that the cluster had completely vanished. We stayed outside for 20 minutes more but could only see the normal stars in the sky with light cloud beginning to overcast.

It was probably much further than it looked. It did not blink nor were there any landing lights or any other light other than orange except it glowed with a ferocity almost like a fire. It moved at a quick pace but not super fast.
It came towards me over the top of the house at helicopter height, completely silently, then continued to arc upward and away. I lost sight of it behind a tree line in my parent’s neighborhood. I simply turned and drove away.
I don’t know why I didn’t take any photos or video. My phone was right near my hand and I easily could have. I just didn’t even think of it until it was gone.
Other things of note:
1) I was completely sober
2) I am currently menstruating (John Keel has noted a correlation between menstruating women and sightings)
3) no one else on the block seemed to even notice anything even when I slowed down and lowered my window to stare at it for a minute. There were other people and cars.
4) there were stars and other aircraft in the sky at the time.

summary: Took photos of sunrise and orb showed up in two photos.
description:
All I can say is I was taking photos of the sunrise from a condo penthouse standing on the balcony. Took three photos and with my phone and looked at them and say a round object in one photo. Wiped my phone camera lens thinking I had a spot on it and took another photo. The orb was still there but had move a short distance to the south. The time between the third photo and the fourth was two minutes. Then it was gone.
The photos are numbered 1-4.
None of the characteristics listed below apply.

summary: Orange glow across sky, then bright orange/fire colored object rising upwards and disappearing into night sky
description: I was in a Lyft on the way from Agoura Hills up to the Santa Barbara airport. It was the middle of the night and very dark. The driver and I were having good conversation, when suddenly she just pointed to the sky and we both went silent. We couldn’t make sense of what we were seeing. The sky was filled with a horizontal, orange glow. Then, seemingly out of nowhere, a very, very brightly lighted object appeared and rose into the sky, disappearing into the night. It almost looked as though it had fire trailing after it, but not a long trail. It all happened very fast, as it seemed to disappear into the dark clouds. After that, both the driver and I kept searching the sky, wondering if we would see it again. We had no idea what it was, and the remainder of the ride was fully comprised of discussion about it. After the first sighting, we did see it again about two minutes later, but we did not see an object. We only saw that same orange hue in the sky. A horizontal glow. The Lyft driver thought she saw it a third time a few minutes later, just for a second, but I didn’t see that one. We kept talking about it, trying to make sense of it. We thought perhaps it was a missile or rocket…

summary: UFOs disguised as stars, dart past window.
description:
My partner woke me up at 3am telling me he saw stars move. While looking out the window, we saw one star slowly move toward the centre of town. It has the same luminosity as a star, and it looked quite far away. Laying back in bed we talked for around 30 minutes, he had his back turned to the window. When suddenly a ball of light shot across the window, it's distance would only have been a few metres.
The shape was ball like, and it shone brightly but it appeared to be some sort of artificial light similar to led asnothing around it was affected by the light. Shaken we did not look out the window until 20 minutes later, when we noticed three other bright stars had disappeared.

summary: The UFOS was like very very brite and when they went, they went like a dash.
description: There was bright lights at least 5/6 on each of the 4 UFOs. But when they dashed away it left a dirty yellow trail almost like a aeroplane but 1 trail for each of them and dirty yellow.

summary: While driving I witnessed a large, saucer shaped craft with a domed top (like a stereotypical flying saucer)
description: The saucer was large (witnessed at a distance, it appeared to be at least as large as an airplane) and had many lights in multiple colors (mostly red, blue, and yellow). It reminded me of a carnival ride, the colors and lights were so bright. It was low in the sky to the west of me and hovering for roughly 30 seconds to a minute. While driving I passed by some trees and lost sight of it for a few seconds, but came out and was still able to find the craft unmoved from its previous position in the sky. However, when I passed by some more trees, I came out to find the craft had completely disappeared. I could not find it at all, not even distantly, so it would have to have moved very fast to be completely out of the sky in those few seconds I was out of sight of it.

summary: Node 27 had a magnetometer spike
5 objects in formation during daylight
description: Noticed strange objects in afternoon sky. 5 objects moving South across the sky turning In southwest direction, almost veering right. Visible for about 2 minutes then gone.

summary: Every night around 2am I have been seeing things in the sky that kind of looks like drones but it's not they are larger. Some have an orange type light at the bottom. Some have bright white at the…
Traveled horizontally slowly. Stopped and sat for a few secs. Darted down left. Stopped. Then fast north.
description: We were sitting on the front porch talking. Not looking up at the sky. Then both of us turned left. We saw an object moveing slowly horizontally to the left. I said do you see what I see he said yes. It maintained color and degree of luminescence. It stopped and stayed in the same position for a few seconds. ..darted down to the left and stopped. Sat there for a few seconds. Then darted North very very quickly and disappeared.

location: Lake Milton (outside of Youngstown), OH, USA
summary: Was using payphone to tell sister gonna be late w car and it appeared over exit ramp, my friend witnessed as well as everyone on 76
description:
I stopped to use the pay phone to let my sister know that we were lost and going to be late with her car and then it suddenly appeared, it was just there, one second it wasn't but the next, it was! There was no seeing it come and go, almost as if it came out of an invisible black hole! so I asked my friend if she saw it (my sister got mad& assumed I was drinking) and we just watched it sit there hovering but the trees barely made a movement, it made a soothing humming sound, it was very graceful, the lights glowed one by one, all in order now that I look back it's funny that I didn't try to look in the windshield to see what was in it but that was the last thing on my mind for some reason we weren't scared it was actually relaxing and didn't pose any threat whatsoever. When we left and got back on the freeway there were semis pulled over and cars pulled over and everyone was staring up in awe! I know what I saw It was a mass sighting, police in a few different jurisdictions also reported it. The next morning my sister said "what did you say about a UFO"? Because it was on the news.
I'm a horrible artist I will include a few pictures that I saw on your website that looks very…

summary: Saw fast moving disk in sky as well an entities in the craft
description: Saw multiple disks in sky throughout the night. Some were disk shape some looked like large spaceships from movies. They were fast moving and varied in color. Some were red, blue, green. All weren’t visible with the naked eye. Needed to use a camera to be able to see some. Also some looked pixelated as if they were trying to be invisible. Electronic hum was heard a few times throughout the night. This has been going on for over a month now. In addition I’ve been seeing pixelated entities for over a month too. In recent days it’s been so many. I can feel them touch me and sometimes when they do they cause extreme pain. Sometimes is feels like they’re draining my energy and causes me to almost faint. Some look like the classic gray alien. Some look like people. Some are small ive seen dogs cats snakes birds. Some look like gnomes and wizards. Some look like robotic. Some are really tall I can’t see them. To the eye the entities look like a pixelated blur. Like the light is bending around something. To see them I look a black screen and see the reflection in my glasses. When this happens you hear the neighborhood dogs bark and the lights get really bright. Also I can see shadows of…

summary: Huge glow hovering over town & then disappeared like the speed of light off to the west
description:
My son & I were coming back from youth group night & were north bound on loop 306.
All of a sudden we both noticed a huge glow in the sky- it was so bright & appeared to be green. We both noticed it hovering & then saw it head west & in a flash- it was gone. No trace was left behind. It appeared to be close to Goodfellow Air Force Base. We noticed an abnormal amount of AFB action in the sky after this.

summary: Three circular lights lined up in a triangular shape, then rotated clockwise
description:
Pulled into the driveway and getting out of the car i pointed out to my girlfriend what I thought were stars in a constellation. She pointed out the lights were way too bright and had a green hue to them.
The lights were there for about 2-3 minutes before rotating over clockwise, then disappearing.

summary: Craft heading east to west
description: Craft moved faster and lower than a plane. A few seconds later another object coming from same general direction but my view was obstructed by clouds.

summary: Object streaked across sky with a green haze and green trail
description: An object appeared to the northeast while driving North on Val Vista in between Chandler Heights and Ocotillo at approximately 6:30 AM in Gilbert, AZ. It only lasted a few seconds, and my initial thoughts were maybe a "shooting star", however it was too close (distance seemed in our immediate airspace, similar to an airplane) or maybe a firework (however, it was rather fast and there was no explosion).

summary: Brighter ball moved like the speed of light
description: Took the dog out as usual in the AM and noticed what I thought was a star . Thought it was brighter and more yellow than usual so I stared at it for a few seconds. It must’ve know I was looking because then it immediately moved diagonally up to the right and disappeared! Never have seen anything in the sky nice as fast as it did and the weird angle it took was beyond strange. I looked everyday after that in the same spot and saw shooting stars for two days in a row. There was no sound. Almost a month later to the date and we heard a tuning fork in the sky but couldn’t see anything.

summary: Captured during long exposure photo session.
description:
I noticed this while post-editing long exposure images from early Wednesday morning, December 14, 2022 of the Geminid meteor shower. These are definitley not meteors.
There are five (5) distinct trails, none of which travel in a straight line. Not sure exactly what I captured here, but I have shot thousands of milky way/night sky long-exposure images and have never seen anything quite like this. GPS from area are 40°54'17.064" N 72°48'55.716" W. Facing WSW.
I have included three (3) images. An unedited JPG, a color corrected JPG, the original RAW file, and a map from Google of the area we were photographing from. Your site won't let me upload the RAW file.

summary: Black triangle with glowing warm orange lights at each corner. Silent, moved across sky. Almost invisible, seemed to be very large.
description: My neighbor and I were watching the meteor shower and we saw a large black triangle with 2 orange lights move across the sky. Was not as high as airplanes, was significantly bigger. So silent, it almost seemed as though it absorbed any sound around it. Moved in such a smooth way, different than anything I have ever seen. I could not look away, I was so mesmerized.

summary: Turquoise light shooting fast in the sky then disappears
description: I was driving home from worked & I felt a light over me but it was really quick . As I look up I see what looked like a light beam of bright pretty turquoise colored light going at the speed of light basically across the sky & just disappear. Y’all prolly think I’m crazy but I seriously freaked out and now I’m asking Jesus what else exist in this world . I know what I saw & wish I could explain better . Never seen anything like it & I’ve been alive 30 years . It didn’t even have a certain shape from what a saw . Pretty color though . Deff caught my attention . Usually I wouldn’t bother to report this cause it’s Baltimore & random things just happen all the time but I’m curious if anyone has ever experienced what I saw or mabey has evidence , just to confirm I’m not crazy or at least not alone ..

summary: The object of focus last night was an object that has lights in in a pyramid grid, but the actual shape is difficult to confirm
description:
the latest observation is similar to my past reports. I pick up on something different almost every evening, trying to focus on a particular object each time. a new formation that I noticed is line of lights stating from the main object, these lights can be bright or not. when not moving they are usually brighter. i feel the same result every time. they get super close but no contact as I usually get too tired around 11pm, need sleep for work next day. I intend to stay up to observe very late this Friday the 16th, hoping to be able to provide more concrete evidence assuming they will get closer to me if I can just stay up for it.
again, tons of low flying plans moving right over my backyard.... I'm not the only one trying to figure out whats going on here.

summary: As we were standing on the ramp near the beach, my friend said, “What is that?” And for a few more seconds it flew extremely horizontal
description:
The craft looked like a spec of light, circular. It was very bright for being small and disappeared shortly after I saw it. It flew horizontally across the night sky. It was only in the sky for 5 seconds, but it was clear to see while it was there.
First time seeing a UFO, very cool!
So excited and ungrounded with excitement after that happened that I got two flat tires on the way home. No regrets. Still, from now on I am going to stay grounded bc seeing one wasn’t worth the $700 expense.
Also, I am not miraculously enlightened. Nope. Maybe they will explain to me further so I don’t keep wondering about. No need to be so shy right? Anyway yep. That’s all the info I have for you.
There were not lights on the object, THE OBJECT WAS A LIGHT.

summary: Blue orb seen for 1-2 seconds at approximately 100 feet in altitude flying from east to west over the southern end of RIC.
description: Blue orb at about 100 feet alt witnessed for 1 to 2 seconds. Orb was flying east to west over the southern end of Richmond Int Airport. Orb beloved to have flown over runway before it was sighted by me. Orb made no sound and blue light went out after I observe it almost directly overhead. No aircraft in the air at time of sighting at approximately 843pm 12/13/2022

summary: Large bright pulsating circular object appeared in the sky out of nowhere
description:
A large orange disc shaped pulsating object appeared out of nowhere in the sky above the fields which was extremely bright. It seemed to look shocked as we spotted it and expand/contract in size whilst moving left to right quickly almost as if it didn’t know which way to go or assessing us. It had the appearance of a large Pac-Man, shortly after sighting this it shrank to a small white dot before flying across the sky.
We also witnessed what looked like 2 shooting stars before and after the sighting.
We took a video of the sighting.

summary: Bright Red Light appearing to be low in the dark (night) sky
description: The Red Light reminded me of a spot light that you would see when a helicopter is looking for something below but it differed because it was bright red and it did not appear to shine downward or move in any direction. It suddenly appeared and stayed steady and red and the same size for approx a minute and then disappeared without appearing to get smaller as if it was moving further away. I did not see any other lights of any other color around it. The sky around it appeared/remained dark.

summary: I thought at first this might be a plane making its way upwards, soon to see that it was remaining stationary.
description: I was in a parking lot when I saw something that looked like a plane moving upwards after takeoff. I realized the “cross” shape did not go away, that the object was remaining stationary. I moved part way through the video to get more footage from a different angle. As I moved, I quickly noticed it moving sideways while maintaining its shape. I moved the camera back and got footage of this rapid sideways movement of a “cross/T-shape” object.

summary: it almost looked like a bright star but it was movie left and right up and down it was not a plane
description: I saw a bright light and it was moving into a triangle going left right up

location: Lower Hutt, Wellington Region, New Zealand
summary: Witnessed a strange white light flying over Lower Hutt. Possible Chinese Rocket.
description:
Was standing outside at 10pm on the 12/12/22 and saw a strange white light approaching from the west in what looked like a cloud.
There were no clouds that night so I watched it for about 15 min and could not identify it as anything usual. It flew off towards the South East and eventually faded out.
I took Photos of it and later read reports from around New Zealand on the weatherwatch meteor reports website that were the same as what I saw.
Therefore it wasn't local to just Wellington and could be seen around the country. This suggests it could be high in the atmosphere. There was some suggestion there that it could have been a Chinese rocket launch that apparently occurred at 9.30pm.
It could possibly be that, but I haven't seen it confirmed.
Its very unusual to see any sort of rocket like that in New Zealand.

summary: Numerous big bright rapidly changing lights.
description: Numerous bright lights in the night sky. Theses lights are often times 100 to 200 yards from the ground. They change color, size and shape very quickly. The finer details can only be seen when looking at the video frame by frame. Often accompanied by much smaller, more numerous lights seen within the trees below and sometimes on the ground. Some nights we may have just one, somewhat stationary light, while other nights there are many that seem to move in all directions and at different speeds. Also, they make a very hard to describe noise. Maybe humming or static and or ringing. This has been occurring on a consistent nightly basis now for 6 to 8 weeks. I would love to know what it may be and appreciate the time someone is taking to view this. I have many more of these videos if needed.

summary: A bright white light suddenly appeared in the western sky at night.
description: While flying from Prince George to Vancouver British Columbia at 25,000 feet above sea level approximately 9 PM Pacific time on December 12, 2022 myself and another Pilot witness a white light appear in the western sky above the horizon. It appeared to be stationary, and after approximately 10 seconds, it turned orange and faded shortly disappearing. It reappeared after approximately five minutes as a bright white light again, fading to orange and disappearing. This happened approximately three or four more times. I’ve seen many satellites in the night sky, and none of them have appeared as this one appeared. I have no idea what it was and I’ve never seen anything like it.

summary: helicopter accompanied by two small lights
description: at 6 pm, i heard 2 very loud helicopters fly over headed sse. which was unusual in itself, i've lived here more than 20 years and am familiar with the flight patterns of commercial jets and the small aircraft from the nearby town airport. i live in a very rural area with no military bases close by. at 8:40 pm i again heard the sound approaching from the sse this time and went outside to see a large helicopter being accompanied by 2 small lights, 1 in front roughly 100 ft. and the other in back and to the side. i've never seen anything like it. i was in the Navy in a P-3 squadron and have seen many types of aircraft.

summary: Orb was heading west at high rate of speed then made a right 45 degree turn and went into warp drive
description: Me and my son were traveling northbound on Highway 49 when a blue orb crossed our field of vision The orb was traveling at a high rate of speed westbound across the highway when it made an abrupt 45° turn and went into warp drive. My estimate is that it went 50 miles north bound in approximately one second before disappearing.

summary: Large, low-flying triangle with bright lights.
description:
I was driving west leaving work. I was on highway 160 approaching Talisman drive.
I noticed very bright lights coming in a southeast direction. I Looked up to assume I would see an airplane. My thoughts were that craft is flying very low, that it would barely make it above the trees. And that it was so large it couldn't possibly land at our local airport. I also noted that it had no "wings" and no tail. There were about 6-8 white lights and one red on the craft's left side. And no detectable sound. It was very clear and distinct.
The craft was flying just above a local fast-food restaurant, and was larger than that building.
I stopped in my lane and watched it fly over my car. It disappeared when I looked in my rear-view mirror.
I have been looking in our town's newspaper for any reports of a large aircraft sighting. I have found none.
I am very curious and would like to hear your thoughts. I was in such awe I did not get a photo. I did however, look on Google and found a photo of what I recall seeing. Please understand this is a photo off Google and not my own. It shows exactly what I saw.

summary: Seven bluish white lights zigzagging in the sky at unexplainable speeds and directions. Beams going down to earth.
description:
Sighting: Belgium, Wisconsin 12/12/22 at 6:45pm
My son, 13 years old, and myself, both with a clean bill of physical and mental health witnessed a phenomenon. We left our home in the Country driving west (near Lake Michigan) while it was dark. I suddenly noticed unexplainable bluish/white lights in the sky. They were zigzagging around the sky at speeds that made them appear 100 ft away to 100 miles away in milliseconds. The hair on my neck stood and I had goosebumps! I said to my son, “Please tell me you are seeing this too?” , “Please tell me I’m not crazy.”, he replied, “Oh my god, what’s going on?”, “They are following us!” We both starred, seeing 7 in total. They followed along side the car at times and at one time flew from behind and over the car. At this time I actually grabbed a hold of my son’s coat and just felt I needed to hold onto him. I’m was truly scared as it felt like we were surrounded. It was as though they were playing with us. At times they came together almost appearing to dance- choreographed- they’d swirl together and then disburse across the sky. At one time they all came together and then faded. Then 3 or 4 would be aside or in front of us again. We were…

summary: It looked like a huge battle ship over a dozen long gun like wings it was transparent to the eye.
description: The flying object looked almost pixilated. You could see through it as it hid in the clouds early flying above and across I65. It looked at first glance like a mass of crows in a formation. But as it came in my field of vision, I could see it was one uniform object. It resembled a tree branch flying. But these were the wings of this craft. They were bent in various directions similar to crafts in STAR TREK. ABOUT a dozen very long arms extending from two cylinder like centers. It was moving noiselessly, fast, and purposeful. It seemed to be preparing to land as it crossed the field. I was awe struck. I immediately called my husband. This craft was not from Earth.

summary: I NOTICED A BLUE AND RED SHAPE FLASHING AND MOVING FROM SIDE TO SIDE.
description: IT WAS AROUND 8:30 P.M. I WENT OUTSIDE TO LOOK AT THE STARS AND NOTICED THIS FLASHING OBJECT OVER PAPAY WESTRAY (ORKNEY). I WENT INSIDE AND PHONED A FRIEND WHO THN WENT OUTSIDE HIS HOME AND HE WITNESSED IT TOO. HE CALLED ME BACK AND DID NOT HAVE A CLUE WHAT IT WAS. I WENT OUT GAIN AND THE OBJECT HAD MOVED FURTHER TO THE LEFT OF SIGHTING. AT FIRST WE THOUGHT IT WAS A AEROPLANE OR HELICOPTER. RULED THIS OUT DUE TO AEROPLANE NEVER STANDS STILL IN FLIGHT, NOR DOES A HELICOPTER FLY THAT HIGH, PLUS THERE WAS NO SOUNDS.

summary: Bright orange saucer shaped craft. Flying/hovering just inside the clouds.
description: About 7pm I saw a bright orange saucer shaped craft flying/hovering heading East toward my house. West South/West. It was cloudy, and it was just inside the clouds. It was generaly flying East and at times was hovering. I didn't hear any sound from it. I'm an Army veteran. It wasn't flying like an airplane, or hovering like a hellicopter.I unlocked the door and got my wife and showed her. Then got my younger son. The first thing my wife said is that "It's hovering." By the time I got my younger son to see it. It was heading West and much further away. It's flight characteristics were all wrong.

summary: We saw three bright while lights. They appeared to be massive in size
description: There were a grouping of three very large lights. Bright white circular objects that moved through the sky. At one point all 3 of the objects converged on each other to make one massive light. At that point I began to record them and a small plane or helicopter flew under it and gave you a sense of the enormity of the objects.

summary: Egg-shaped object popping in and out of sky at random locations
description: Egg-shaped object moving across the sky at insane speeds. Would actually pop in and out of the sky and reappear several seconds later in completely different part of the sky.

summary: I first seen multiple lights…round in nature…and thought to myself am I really seeing this?! So I grabbed my phone and took pictures!
description:
It definitely is a UFO sighting. I have pictures. No one else seems to have seen this or is able to explain what happened.
This one was different from what I have experienced in the past. I do have photos on my ring doorbell from previous times too.

summary: Bright light appeared, started to move and creates blue trail and everything goes dark and 2 orbs result. Then another shortly appears.
description: Im driving for a rideshare company and just dropped off my final rider for the night and a block away, I stop at about 250am on the morning of Sunday December 11 at a stop sign to put my app on "home mode" when I noticed this really bright light as bright as the streetlights around me up in the sky on the horizon. It starts moving toward me and when it does it continues to glow really bright and a blue tail followed in its path. It looked like a comet but as it got closer I noticed it looked like a ship. Im not kidding when I say it looked like an A-wing from Star Wars. I tried my quickest to get my phone out and record. I shut down my app and pulled up my camera. Unfortunately the camera was facing me (selfie mode) and it was too dark to see. I noticed however it wasnt picking up the UFO. I turned the camera off and back on and hit record. As I was doing this the entire thing, ship and light blue contour just completely disappear. I notice out of exactly where the light was, these barely visible orbs. 2 of them. They take off in opposite directions. I continue filming one of them as I exit my vehicle. In the video Im freaking out. Im talking about the orbs as I follow one with my…

summary: Light formation in sky disappeared abruptly
description: While standing on my back deck, I noticed a formation of lights around a dark silhouette in the northern sky. There was no color to the lights other than a yellowish tinted white - like a car headlight. I almost thought a plane was crash landing but it appeared rather close and seemingly moving closer. Also there was no sound. I called in to my husband who was sitting at the table to come out and see it. As soon as I yelled for him, the object disappeared. It did not move away or leave - it simply disappeared. Both the lights and the silhouette vanished. I was very freaked out by what I saw but decided not to report it. Tonight I clicked on a news article about a ufo sighting recently in Montgomery County PA. There were other news links to other reports and I browsed through them. One in particular caught my attention. It was an article about a sighting in Glenmoore PA on 3/24/2022. The photo included in the article depicted two objects. The bottom one featured that same formation of lights that I saw in December. I just thought you should know and have it reported.

summary: Green Light orb
description: A green orb, which appeared to be lit up and about the size of a car tire, floated through the trees lining the road in front of my house then disappeared at the top of my driveway.

summary: I had to go out to my truck and that's when I saw it.
description: Ok so it was between 9 or 10 pm, Like early December and believe it or not it was not that cold out yet, And it was a clear night sky, I needed to grab something out of my truck and as soon as I stepped out my front door I could not help but notice that the moon looked way brighter than usual, At least that's what I thought it was, As I was making my way to my truck which was like around 30 yards away, I got around 10 ft away and all of a sudden, And I mean fast the light came down and had to be around 30 to 50 ft above me, It was circular and fully lit but not like a flash light, Like the moon, It takes a lot to scare me, And this did, When it came down over top of me, I remember I opened my truck door tucked my head inside, Like I was trying to hide from it, Instantly I knew that was not working so I slammed the door ran back to my house, Slammed that door, Locked it, Ran to my bedroom slammed that door Locked it, Jumped into my bed and just layed there totally silent and trying to figure out what I saw for probably an hour, Freaked me out.

summary: 3 rotating lights shining through clouds moving at a consistent speed and moving in a consistent pattern
description: Hard to describe in detail, but I do have a video (poor quality) but if brightness is adjusted you can see the lights

summary: Object was stationary and parallel with a star for several minutes. Then gained altitude in a linear fashion before moving west.
description: The object was a bright round object that looked like a star. It was sitting stationary next to an actual star. It was very odd to see two stars of equal lumen parallel with very little space between them. After several minutes the object began to gain altitude in a linear fashion. At about maybe 20 to 30 thousand feet it stopped gaining in elevation and began to traverse west directly over my house slowly accelerating as until it suddenly vanished like a cloak was used.

summary: Highly reflective silver objects in the sky not that far in the sky. We saw it, and watched it for a few seconds before it just disappeared.
description: We were driving home on Bruce Rd, and I looked over towards my husband who was driving and saw out the truck window 3 very reflective objects in the sky. I said "what the...." and my husband turned and looked. He saw them as well. We kept driving and watched them until we were parallel with the objects and then all 3 just disappeared. They were lined up one on top of Nother with clear space between them. It was a very sunny out. They were the most reflective thing I have ever seen. I checked flight tracker and there were no aircraft around our location.

summary: My wife noticed 6 lights after taking a photo of me installing a roof over out chicken run.
description: Noticed the lights after taking the photo. We had christmas lights on in the house, but were unable to recreate any sort of reflection on the sliding patio door (photo was taken from inside the house). Photo was taken from the east side of Interstate 5 looking north toward the coburg hills.

summary: Was high in the sky then came down lower real close very very bright light
description: I was outside using the bathroom and I look up and it kind of looked like the moon at first but as I was watching it came down really close to me it was a circle with the brightest light I've ever seen in my life. As I was watching it come closer to me I yelled for my uncle and he came out and seen it also it stayed close for about 2 minutes and then went back up and floated for a while and then disappeared. It's very dark where I'm at no other lights it was very cloudy but you could see this bright Circle among everything else. It was a perfect circle very bright and moved very fast.

summary: Several moving objects in the sky
description: Many Moving lights . Please see video

summary: Taking sunset pictures, noticed a weird fireball
description: I was taking my normal sunrise photos when I noticed that there was an extremely bright light just above the mountain, it didn't move for 2 minutes and then just suddenly disappeared, I have a decent camera so I tried to zoom in and get pictures of it and I noticed that there's like a black void between the two streaks of light, no idea what it was, but it wasn't normal

summary: Massive obsidian coloured cigar shaped object
description: At 6:25 AM Eastern time on the morning of Saturday, December 10, 2022, I sighted a massive, obsidian-coloured, cigar shaped object on the way home from work on the night shift. I was wide awake, fully sober, fully alert, and still focused on the previous evening's shift at work. This object was massive--appeared to be about 2000 meters long and 150 meters wide, headed east at 1500 km/hour, around 35 km altitude. The object obscured much of the sky and appeared to be enveloped in a long, black, oily bubble. I had a sense of anxiety observing this phenomena.

summary: Spikes on magnetometer at MADAR site 177. MSV confirmed on compass as well.
Green laser-like light
description: Was walking to my car, to leave for work. When I looked towards the backyard I suddenly seen a green “laser like” light shoot from the sky. Lots of overcast so I was unable to see where the light was projecting from. Lasted for about 2-4 seconds the first time, making a very fast, circular motions, hitting the back neighbors cow and the next door neighbors tree. The second time it hit my back yard, then disappeared. No circular motion the 2nd time, just a solid green light.

summary: Blue, pulsating light, below 7,000ft cloud ceiling on a rainy night.
description:
I stepped out on our patio to lock our garage door in preparation for going to bed. I looked Eastward and immediately saw a very strange, blue-colored light, hovering over and behind trees next to the McKenzie River. It was raining out, so I knew that this object had to be below the cloud deck.
I snapped a couple of pictures with my new iPhone 14 Pro Max (raw mode), then immediately went inside to grab my Luna Optics night vision binoculars. I returned to the patio and went to turn the binoculars on, and found the batteries were dead, even though brand new. I returned inside, grabbed my auxiliary battery brick, and powered the binoculars using the external battery source.
I have been around aviation for my entire life, and I knew this was not like anything I had ever seen. We have a large hospital immediately to our North, and I enjoy watching the lifeflight helicopters flying in and landing on the hospital roof. This was not a helicopter, and was not a drone, which I see flying over the river often.
I had enough time to check all of my flight programs for aircraft in the area, and there were none. I called 911 to report this sighting, just so there would be an official log of it.…

summary: A bright silver light appearing out of nowhere, then completely disappearing.

I carefully kept my eye on the area where I saw the light as I continued to travel on the freeway, moving closer to the location of the light. Then the light faded back up, literally out of nowhere, as there was nothing visible to the naked eye in the sky where it appeared. This fading in and out of existence happened probably 3 or 4 times and then it completely discontinued. I watched this area for some time, but was unable to see any kind of object in the sky whatsoever. The bright silver light I saw, when it reached its maximum size, appeared to me to be an actual object, something possibly the size of a small airplane. summary: Numerous Orbs from the Flight Deck of commercial flight

I was the Captain on a flight from LAX to JFK on December 8, 2022. Upon returning to the flight deck from a bathroom break, I was told by the first officer to quickly look outside and see what he was viewing. There was a large white orb, with a second one above it and slightly right, in the night sky.
As pilots we try to rationalize and determine what we are looking at and verify that it is no issue for our aircraft. The orbs stayed for a bit and then suddenly vanished. The first officer and the flight attendant, who was in the cockpit while I was in the bathroom, said there had been an even brighter orb which looked like oncoming aircraft traffic just a few moments prior. They had looked at the TCAS with nothing on the display.
The night sky was quite bright due to a full moon in the western sky which was lighting up our whole eastern view of the sky. There was a low overcast layer which kept the ground light from shining through. A few moments later we noticed the orbs again and were shocked by how bright they were.
We had heard earlier that day that Mars would be the second brightest object in the sky, after the moon, due to its proximity to our planet this evening. The orbs…

summary: Low flying white light moving west to east.
description: At approx 5:22pm, on 26 Nov 2022, I went out onto my front porch to bring in my flag. As I was rolling up the flag I observed a single bright, white light at low altitude (500ft approx) moving above and to the left of me. I first saw it as it came over the east side of my roof. The light was traveling unusually slow for a common aircraft. There were no common aircraft running lights, no red light, no strobe. It moved from direct west to east. The light was very bright, much brighter than the stars, and appeared to "ray out" in spikes all around it. No structure could be seen. There was a long "spike" of light coming out of the back end (no sparks, fire or debris). There was absolutely no sound from it. As it passed I heard a neighbor's dog start barking (although it must be said that that dog is a constant barker). As the light got closer toward the Island Pond village it very quickly just "faded out". I watched briefly and it did not reappear along the trajectory it was on. It did not change course throughout the sighting.

summary: Driving up the bypass I witnessed a metallic almost glassy cone shaped object. It was upright and vertical, and was rotating.
description:
Driving up the bypass I witnessed a metallic almost glassy cone shaped object. It was upright and vertical, and was rotating with the sun shining on it prominently, which is what drew my attention to the object initially. The sun was off to my right through the windshield of my work Van, as the object rotated the sun gleamed off of it very brightly, almost blindingly so. It only lasted around 3 seconds, but it was very well defined, and clearly not a plane or any other regular object such as a drone.
The object continued to rotate, and as it did so, it began to fade away in a very strange fashion, almost as if it was being hidden behind a sheet made of the blue sky behind it. There were no clouds anywhere near this object.
Having seen this, I pulled over into the parking lot across from the McDonald's, attempted to look for this object and began to film in the event it returned, to no avail. Considering I was working, I only had so much time to sit and wait, so I stayed put for around 5 minutes, returned to my work van and made note of the time, location and any other pertinent details.
It was utterly bizarre.

It had no visible propulsion system e.g. propeller(s), or exhaust heat plume The craft had no markings, except for what I thought might be part of a tail fin, which was black and white. Thinking about it, however, it probably was not a tail fin because of it's very low profile. The surface of the craft was smooth; there were no visible ribs. No landing gear was visible. In short, it simply looked like a slow moving silver-white cigar tube.
The object I observed was, as stated, moving very slowly through the air. The field in the background made it easier to see in profile. It held steady at a very low altitude and I observed no vertical or horizontal drift.
I looked at it for as long as I could, perhaps five seconds, then I looked back at the road, as this was rush hour.…

Second was triangular in shape and red/white lights moving erratically up and down, side to side.
Last night was a bright white ball-I thought it was a comet or shooting star at first since it had a long white "tail-" but then it moved at such a fast pace in a straight line and not downward, then disappeared. I have never seen anything like this ever. The speed of movement made me realize this was something else. This happened last year at this time also. In the fall. By winter, the lights and balls disappear till next fall.

summary: I saw a bright orange light in the sky.

I thought it may be a satellite at first because it was moving at a steady pace in one direction till it stopped and began traveling in a complete opposite direction. I had time to get my father out of bed to see what I was seeing. This light was very bright at times then would go dim when it went to move it went from one place to another with ease. Never did go to one direction fast though it was a steady back and forth motion. I could see a outline of a black figure behind the light but never could exactly distinguish if it was circular for a triangular shape. At times I could have sworn there was 2 extra lights that would appear this went on for what seemed 20 to 30 mins till the object once moved where I originally seen it then disappeared. I have never seen anything like it. I definitely can not explain what I seen. My cell phone camera would not pick up what I was seeing.

Bright stationary star suddenly disappears instantly
description: My husband and I were looking East off our porch at a bright star we suspected may be a planet because it looked somewhat similar in brightness and size as Mars, which was near it. It was lower on the horizon but still up in the sky, not high up though. We however didn’t remember another planet being in that area and were intrigued by this new, planet looking star. As we are watching it, the once steady intensity of light starts to somewhat fluctuate, dimming and then getting brighter, also subtly changing colors but still staying in the same spot. We commented on how it reminded us of Sirius, maybe it was Sirius we thought. It still seemed unusually bright and it really looked a lot like Mars but not red. As we are suspecting that must be the case, it literally disappears instantly from the sky! It was gone in an instant, my husband and I both saw it at the same time disappear. It did not come off as a ship or flying object however, it looked like a bright star provided its intensity and fixed position. Which is why we were so shocked when it suddenly disappeared.

Also It was a really foggy night wich is unusual in the city. My wife also saw them for the first time and thought she was also tripping but then we saw them again.

I started filming them when the formation broke up. I also took a picture. It seemed like it lasted for a long time but it was probably 3-5 minutes total. summary: Saw a tight, open bowl shaped formation of small round dots of light move quickly across the sky.
description:
Hi. I keep searching to find that what I saw was a Starlink train, but all of those appear to be in a straight line. I sent the following information to the head of the local astronomy club the next day, and he agreed that while it was probably a satellite grouping, he has not heard of anything like this. Since I'm not claiming to have discovered a new comet or asteroid, this seemed to be the best place to report my experience.
The event occurred on the night of Tuesday, November 1st, right around midnight going into the 2nd. I am a fan of meteor showers and was watching for some Taurid fireballs. I'm in the city so sky conditions were poor. Lowest magnitude visible was 3.5 and that's pushing it. I saw 2 nice, very bright, fairly slow meteors in about an hour session.
But then I saw a curved, open bowl-shaped formation of lights, 2nd or 3rd magnitude, approximately 8-12 points of light traveling quickly in precise, steady formation. They were tightly spaced, and I'd guess the entire formation was about 10-15 degrees wide max. I saw them first overhead as they moved from north to south, disappearing below the horizon in less than 30 seconds. No trails. Then a very few minutes…

summary: Silent, unblinking white light moving slowly ENE at a time when no air or satellite traffic in area.
description:
Took brief walk before sunrise and stopped to look at clear, cloudless sky. Saw several bright stars and possibly planets. Then noted one, about as bright as Venus, was actually moving toward the ENE at or near the speed of a high altitude jetliner. The single white light never blinked, and after it passed slowly overhead, I still heard no sound.
Shortly after it first appeared to be moving, it may have veered slightly off course twice, and there may have been one or two tiny white lights moving near it, but not certain about either of those observations because my vision is not flawless.
Checked my phone for the time, but preferred to watch the moving light, rather than attempt a photo.
Later checked Flightradar24 website, which showed no flights near Cape Cod at that time, and the In the Sky satellite tracking website, which showed only one satellite heading NE well off the coast of Cape Cod near that time.

The rear aircraft was an obtuse triangle shape with a red light at the center, but with a strobe on its nose. These aircraft flew silently, very slowly and seemed to be at a low altitude. They appeared very large. I could not make out a color. These aircraft were not trying to hide from any observers on the ground. While it was dark and the aircraft were silent, anyone could have seen these things.

They were without strobes and position lights and lacked any noticeable sound. There were no vehicles driving by that would have illuminated structures casting a shadow into the sky (the sky was partly cloudy at the moment; few clouds that were visible); geese that fly in formation always make noise while in flight but there was no noise and no jagged formation movement...and, I rarely have seen/heard geese flying at night. I know what I saw, and these were definitely objects that could not be classified and definitely were not drones of any kind. Although close to an airport, I do know that these objects were not an aircraft; at least not listed in Jane's book.

Deer in field ahead of me ran off, but could have been due to my presence, even though I wasn't as close as close to them as I normally was when they typically run off.

Neither of us moved our heads or looked at each other while we conversed about what we were seeing - a small, perfectly spherical bright silver/white metallic object moving incredibly fast across the sky and then just disappearing into the blue sky. Then, within about five more seconds, they faded back down, again steadily, back to invisible. Both lights were moving, slowly, toward the east.
I have heard this slow-flash to extraordinarily bright, brief illumination referred to as a "power up" by others who have captured similar appearances in video footage.
I remained watching for about another hour with no further activity.
My location lies directly beneath an air corridor to nearby Payne Field, in Everett, which lies about 7 miles directly to the north. There is no conceivable way the activity I witnessed could have had anything to do with local airport activity.
I am a project manager in telecommunications and information security.

summary: BRIGHT light panned like a spotlight in both windows in my bedroom - no sound - no cars - no people. 2nd time this has happened
description: I was the only witness. I did not physically see anything but a BRIGHT light. I was in my bedroom, wide awake & on my phone. I saw a light coming through the window beside me on my right and the window on the other wall to my left. The light panned like someone was shining a flashlight or driving a car. But I did not hear anything or see anything when I looked out my window. This only lasted less than a minute - maybe 15 second, but it was a very steady light. The light was as bright as a photo being taken wirh the flash or the sun's light. When I saw the light, I will admit I got scared and turned my phone on lock mode to hide my light & as soon as I did that the light in the windows vanished. I will say, the light seemed to shine for 15 seconds to a minute, because it was slow and fast at the same time. I'm so puzzled. This is the second time this has happened to me and I was the only witness. Same exact experience. No time was missing, but the complexity of trying to figure out how long the light shined is quite puzzling. It happened quickly and steadily. I saw it happen quickly, but in a different way it lingered for so long in that quick moment.

summary: Shifting lights around disk with dome.
description: On several nights in late August and early September myself and several neighbors observed a craft near our homes. The vehicle hovered silently. It's shape was that of a disk with a dome in the middle. Along the disk length was a row of white lights, while the center dome shifted between red, green, and blue light. Comparing the sighting with sky charts proved it was not any known celestial object; it was in the area of the constellation of Bootes on our northwest horizon. My neighbor noted that, on the night of September the first, it was hovering in the west, and quickly zipped to the northwest, near Seginus, around the time I came outside. It remained hovering and color shifting while I recorded it. Since Bootes moved beyond our horizon, I have not spotted it again.

summary: Extremely fast moving, dimly lit, triangular shaped object in sky.
description: I was in my backyard with my boyfriend looking at the stars. I saw what I thought was a satellite and started to say so but it was moving way way too fast. He looked up and saw it as well. There were no trails or lights just an extremely fast moving object in the night sky traveling we believe from North to South. It was moving as fast as a shooting star, never stopped moving and continued across the upper western horizon until we could no longer see it. We tried to think of anything it could have been but it was moving so so fast, was silent and had no lights or flashes making it somewhat difficult to see. What slight glow(if any) or silhouette of the object we could see looked to be triangular or possibly diamond shaped. Too fast to be a satellite, too quiet and unlit to be a lower flying jet and too high up and fast to be a bird. Possibly some new technology stealth aircraft? That's what we're telling ourselves.

More of a yellow color. Similar to sun reflection. Object appeared to be very far away. Estimate on west coast. It slowly faded and lowered to the horizon. No longer visible before it reached horizon. I would relate the horn shaped object to be somewhat similar to transparent deep sea creatures with internal lighting system. When I first saw the object with my naked eye it appeared to be a multi tipped star shape with red and white blinking lights. Binoculars revealed a more detailed shape of the two objects. I called local non emergency police and reported. I can't find any reported rocket launches on this date. I can't find weather balloon data.

However, the faint lights were reddish, it seemed like a row of lights were side by side floating in a long line. It seemed pretty close to us, and initially we thought it was still, then realized it was floating, moving very slow. We watched for about 5-6 minutes and then it was gone.
We went about our night and then got busy with life. However, I went online tonight to see if anyone else saw this and wanted to know what it might be. What was odd was how quiet it was being that it looked like something that spanned maybe 20-40 ft. I ran across this site and would love to know what it was. I don’t assume it was an alien yet would really like to satisfy my curiosity.

summary: a silent, dark, rectangular flying object
description:
At about 8:30pm, 9/25, I looked up into the sky and saw an object coming toward me and my family overhead. It had a "belly" of a single line of lights running down its length that flashed on and off one-by-one in order -- I recall them being red, blue, green, and white. I called out to my family to look, as we were outside eating. But then just as soon as I saw it and called out, the object literally "snapped" out of vision and was gone from sight for about 2 more seconds. And then, as it was directly overhead, it snapped back on and was fully visible for 2 more seconds. At this point, one of my daughters also saw it. However, she was the only other one who saw it during that second phase of visibility because she was not under the sun umbrella we had left up (my husband and son had an obstructed view and didn't see any of it). And then it snapped back off and was completely gone.

I then noticed there were more than 3 lights. There was 5 or 6 and they were all traveling at the same steady rate, from south to north. Then we just kept going and were perplexed by the whole thing. I realize that Space X launched on Saturday and people were able to see that in this area, but this was different. That appeared to be one larger light that was emitting light and moving across the sky. This was more of a hovering/slow moving formation.
The videos are not great. I included a few still frames from the…

I am familiar with the expected trajectory, speed, and duration of visibility simply through observation. Whatever this was, it was not flying like anything I had seen before.
In addition to circling above while moving west to east, the "craft" itself was rotating and flying very, very fast. The planes I see out my window always fly away from Northern Virginia. This one flew right over head and then disappeared.
When I first saw it, I thought through all possible alternatives before settling on "UFO", and I'm not sure I'm saying I think it was for sure. I thought very large bird? (because of the circling). Marine One coming in for a landing at DCA?

I could hear the sound of the wind as it glided past. This is a sound I've heard several times in my life such as geese landing, or other birds gliding or in some instances a large kite flying. The craft was low to the ground, maybe 200 to 300 feet from the ground (about the same height as many of our wind turbines in the area, or about the same height as many planes I've witnessed landing). There are several trees in my yard and my neighbors, leaving only a small portion of the yard where I was able to view the entire thing, but I could still see it through the trees or at least portions of it. There was no lights and no engine noise, the wings were very thin and dark colored. An airstrip about 20 miles from me often flies the gliders that are towed behind planes…

One person moved to follow the movement as it passed over my house, I did not. I felt, more than saw, but it felt like there was something invisible spinning around those lights. I know that is strange, but I very much got the impression that the 4 lights were one side of the craft and the off center light was where the craft arched, or bent, and the light was passing through an invisible disc. The people who saw it agreed it was strange, and thought the movement was very odd. Suggestions of Space X and Starlink don't make much sense when compared to what I saw, but I suppose it isn't out of the question. summary: Bright v-shape light coming from behind a quick-moving craft
description: Around 7:40pm on Saturday night 9/24/22, I went to close the blinds in my room and witnessed a strange moving light in the sky. Not a plane, as there was a plane in sight too, going a different direction, but this looked very different. This was only one prick of unblinking light moving in a straight across the sky right to left as I looked from my window (Eastbound). The pinpoint of light had a thick v-shaped very bright white light beaming out behind it. I had my dad get up to look at kitchen window then we ran to the backyard to see. There was no sound coming from it. We watched it as it was for a few moments continuing straight and relatively fast on its path, then all of a sudden the light beam seemed to detach from the craft and was left behind hanging in the sky as the prick of light continued on. Within a few moments, the prick of light wasn’t visible at all and as the light beam faded too, it was like it was never there – nowhere to be seen. My dad and I were flabbergasted and agreed that it was very odd, especially the way the light suddenly detached from the craft itself and was left paused in the sky while the craft continued on, only to fade out some moments later…

It caught my eye because coming out presumably the back of the craft was solid streams of light that dissipated after not long, but extended up and back I would estimate 10-20 craft/dot lengths. After watching for maybe 10-15 seconds the streams stopped and the craft continued. I would say it appeared close and steady like the ISS which i have seen several times, but seemed faster than I recall the ISS being, so possibly closer. My guess is that this was a plane doing a routine fuel dump. But would the fuel reflect light, the streams were bright white like stars and planes look in the night sky. I hate that I didn't get a video, but did get a picture at least, but a good one.

The object traveled across the sky for one minute in front of three contrails: one in the center rear and one on each side at 45-degree angles resembling a bright white arrow in the sky. Half a minute after seeing it, the object turned a bright florescent green, then vanished leaving no trace of lingering contrails. We both took photos of it on our iPhones and my husband took a short 5-second video on his. We are both working professionals: I am a retired college professor currently a novelist and illustrator, and my husband is a Project Manager.
If you discover what this was, please inform me via email.

summary: Round bright object hovering at dusk
description: My 3 kids and I (ages 13, 11, 9) were taking a walk at dusk in our subdivision after dinner. It was getting dark so we were headed back toward our house. Suddenly, we noticed a bright round object hovering above us (not still, slowly moving). It was lit very brightly. It was moving steadily and slowly, at the speed of a floating balloon. It was completely noiseless, and appeared round. It did not appear to have wings or any shape even remotely close to a plane or helicopter. It was as close to our heads as a kite would be, maybe closer. It appears much further in the video, but the video is not a good reflection of what we actually witnessed live. My 13 year old took out her phone and recorded it, but by this point, it had already moved away from us in proximity. After she stopped recording, it suddenly vanished. We could no longer see it, which was weird because the light was so bright just seconds prior. Something that bright should have been visible even from a distance. In the video, you can see a bat fly by the lens of our camera. Even the bat is flying faster than this object, which is so strange and fascinating.

summary: Silent, high altitude fast moving.
description: My toddler thought she spotted a bird and pointed to myself and her mother a football shaped object passing just below the high-thin cirrus cloud layer. I observed the object as I observed many in my 20 year military career at sea. This was not a drone or hobby grade RC… as I am an RC pilot I can confirm that with certainty. The sunset backlit the object so it appeared nearly black in color but a few times a “shine” or “gleam” of light could be seen. The travel speed and trajectory were very deliberate. The altitude was high and the object was going at least double the speed of a commercial airliner. No wings, no mechanical motion and no exhaust were present. No noise what so ever was heard. We watched from horizon to horizon as the object passed from roughly southwest to northeast (left to right) across our view.

description:

To be sure it wasn't moving, I put my thumb up directly under it and watched to see if it went up/down or left/right of my thumb. It did not move. It was hovering in place against ridiculously strong winds blowing from south to north. I watched this strange, hovering behavior for approximately 2-3 mins.
About 1 minute after I began watching this object, I said to my wife Connie, "Connie, check that out. There's a UFO right there."
I said it half-jokingly, but in my mind there was no other logical explanation. I guess I was looking for some confirmation that what I was seeing was actually happening.
We watched it together for another minute or so while it was hovering in place, both of us entirely perplexed. Connie even said to me, "That is really, really weird!"

summary: At least 3 crafts circling PA NJ DE area
description:
At 10:10pm I exited my front door after hearing what sounded like hovering helicopters for at least 5-10 minutes.There were 3 elongated crafts circling this area, as well as over in Jersey, further south possibly into Delaware. They didn't hover over 95 at all but were circling the whole area. I couldn't see any light or shadow of the objects themselves and could only see the lights (some flashing and others steady) on the underside.The vehicles were going between significant changes in elevation, made lateral movements, and changes in trajectory. They moved at a steady pace while the radius of their flight broadened and narrowed. The bottoms all had a white, single, centered light towards the front followed by two pairs of lights that changed colors between white, green, and red, and then a tail light. If I had to estimate they were 40 feet long. The planes arriving and leaving nearby Philadelphia International Airport were apparently unaffected and didn't have any engagement or stopping of flights.
Eventually after about an hour, while I could still hear them, they were not visible.

description: I was leaving the house for work and looked up to the sky, over the top of our house while in the driveway. My husband came out to see what I was standing there looking up at just as it flew over and I pointed it out. Just as he said "I see it" the object began to fade from as bright as a star to a dimmer and dimmer white, moving so fast toward the east, then vanished. It moved so quickly, that it covered such a distance, with no sound, no flashing lights, I was dumbfounded. My husband said it was probably the ISS, but once I got to work and googled its schedule, it is not due to pass over our area until this evening - visible for 7 minutes the NASA schedule says. This object was visible for less than half of that time. I am still baffled by this.

summary: Two solid lights moving in unison, one fluctuating in luminosity.
description:
About 10:45pm, not sure the exactly as I was pacing holding a 2 year old who wouldn't sleep.
Viewing out north facing over sized windows I saw two lights roughly 4 degrees apart moving in unison from northwest to southeast at a slow rate roughly 5 degrees every 8 to 10 seconds. The lights were solid and did not blink or flicker. The lights were aligned north to south and the south light gained intensity for about 5 seconds at a time twice during my observation going from about the luminosity of Saturn to something more like Jupiter or even Venus then fading back out. The north light remained a consistent Saturn type luminosity. The south light did seem more amber when it was at its brightest. I could be wrong due to my color blindness, but it was definitely not white though this was harder to tell once it dimmed. It was harder to tell the color of the north light due to its brightness. I called my wife over to see it, and though she didn't witness the fluctuations of luminosity of the south light she did see the lights before they went out of view.

summary: Blue light that rapidly grew, broke off into 3, "fell" a small bit, and disappeared

It then broke off into 3 smaller blue lights that "fell" a tiny bit in the sky before completely vanishing. The large light grew for about 4 seconds and did not have a tail nor did it seem to be moving. However, the 3 smaller lights "fell" a tiny amount for about 1 second each before vanishing and they each had tails. None of the lights had defined edges, they were round however they were very glowy which made them seem a bit blurred. It was completely silent outside, there were no people outside, no cars running, and no dogs barking. I watched for about 2 more minutes and nothing else happened. The whole experience happened too fast for me to pull my phone out and take a video or picture.

We caught a glimpse on video, bit it only captured the smallest ball of light, and didn't really capture what we were actually seeing.

summary: Not sure if it was one or two
description: I actually thought it was a plane at first. Two white lights in the sky, looked like a plane coming right at me. From the intensity of the lights, I thought it was fairly low for a passenger jet. I used to live on an approach path in CT about 15 miles from the airport, so I’m used to seeing those lights. We rarely get planes overhead at Crissey Field, and I love watching planes, so when I hear one I notice it. I watched it for several seconds, and it didn’t seem to get any closer. I took out my phone and filmed it for a few seconds, then stopped and adjusted my phone and filmed again for a few seconds, then stopped, turned the camera and filmed again for over a minute. I swear, that “plane” never got any closer. And I couldn’t hear a plane. And the lights never changed to green and red. I came inside, turned out the lights, moved something on the floor by the front windows so I could stand there. That took maybe a minute at the most. I opened the window, and the lights were gone. Could it have been obliterated by the fog rolling in? I suppose so, but I never heard a plane. Opened windows so I could hear better. I honestly have no idea what I just saw.

I tried to tell a few people, though I was met with the typical looks or criticism of seeing things or being nuts. I don't know if anyone else saw it, but if they did, I'm sure they were either as flabbergasted as I was, or wrote it off as nothing of importance.

I assumed they were satellites or drones until I noticed one move at lightning speed to the other side of the mountain while another dot disappeared and then reappeared.
At one point two dots with a halo merged together and formed what I could only describe as a ball of white, static energy, growing and morphing into a larger orbe of vibrating, fast-moving, blue-green particles. Even more shocking was a white light that appeared from the dark and quickly morphed into a bright, glowing trickle of bright strings. It looked like glowing tentacles that began to dispense additional moving, glowing light trickling down the night sky and all around its location. It was truly the most shocking and incredible thing I have ever seen.

I yelled, so my husband looked up and saw it too, he took a video with his phone, (it was too dark).
Here are the points of what I saw;
It was a black cigar shape approx 300ft long.
It had one bright white light on the back end and a smaller white light at the front.
The hudge body of the craft blocked out the stars as it moved & also blended into the night sky, so that details on the craft were not visible.
It moved slowly over our trees and up into the middle of the sky until it disappeared into the heavens.
There is a bog on our 10 acres and I have seen lights there and once a huge beem of light over or in it before. I have lived here for 24 years.

summary: “Glow stick” sighting. A +40ft fluorescent green tube of light glided across sky. No tail or trail of light. No sound.
description:
My stepdad and I witnessed a fluorescent green tube of light glide across sky. It came from the southeast sky, glided above the neighborhood and across the sky into the northwest horizon. It was dusk so it was easy to see that there was no light trail or tail behind the green glowing “glow stick.” It was flying below airplane level and at about the level that helicopters fly at in that area. Based on its estimated elevation and distance from us, we guess that it was greater than 40 but smaller than 100 feet. The “green glow stick” made no sound and moved in a very straight, smooth line. Glided is the best way to describe its motion.
Our background: we’re a regular ‘ol working-class family. My stepdad is retired from a local water district and I work full time. On the day of the sighting we were sitting on his back porch watching for shooting stars and faces towards the north-northwest when he noticed the “green glow stick” emerge from the corner of his eye out of the south-southeast. He called to me and my husbands attention to look several times. About the third time he said “hey look!” is when I saw the UAP. I watched it glide off into the N-NW.

summary: Large aircraft - smooth, fast, and soundless
description: My husband and I were at Cunningham Park, Queens lying on a picnic blanket on a patch of green near the Tennis Court. It was nearing sunset and I laid on my belly using my phone, while my husband laid on his back facing the sky. After some time, he nudged me and point up to the sky and as I looked and focused in, I could see a large oval space craft gliding past me-- smooth, fast, and soundless. As we were lying on the park ground, near the Tennis court wall, our view of it was blocked as it headed south and passed over the wall and many trees. The skies were grey-ish blue and the outline of the craft was only a tinge darker so we could spot it, however, it was so light "grey/silver" it looked translucent. We could see what looked like ridge patterns (for lack of a better word) on the bottom face of the craft but it moved so quickly, that was all we could gather. It was incredibly large, and considerately close to the ground, so what we both saw was undeniable.

summary: Large, silent chevron/boomerange craft moving across Manhattan, NY--seen from Central Park
description: My wife and son (almost 2 years old at the time) and I were hanging out in Central Park after dinner and laying in the Hecksher Ballfields, right beyond 2nd base of field 6. We were looking toward downtown as we laid facing the sky and my wife noticed it first and then me, a large, boomerang/chevron (I guess) shaped object flying from west to east, south to north across the sky. It was above the clouds, but still oddly visible and clearly not an airplane or any other kind of aircraft we had seen. It was very large and totally quiet and moving steadily, smooth, and quickly--no sound. (NOTE: since this event, I often observe airplanes heading in this same path toward LaGuardia Airport, however, they are lower in altitude and make a lot of noise. This seemed quite higher in altitude, and it also was much larger than any airplane I have ever seen. It had that boomerang shape, almost like massive wings, but there was no visible body to it). Also, the shape altho sort of a giant "V" or soft-edged boomerang shape, it did seem to shift in an odd way, almost a hazy quality to it. I know it sounds odd, but it was just such a strange thing we both saw. We were both very surprised and curious…

summary: Noticed a very bright star, but it suddenly faded completely dark. Reappeared and began filming. Recorded it fading to black again.

I began filming and got a total of about 25 minutes filming this object. It slowly moves around but the movements aren’t entirely obvious with the naked eye. Very slow movements. Upon zooming in on the video, you can clearly see there are several lights, sometimes flashing blue and randomly red.
When it fades out to black, it’s a very slow gradual fade. You can still see it up until it is completely dark. I recorded for a bit after the fade and it did not return as it did prior to filming.
* 1 plane passed by the object (caught on video not attached to this submission)

* very slow movement, unnoticeable to the naked eye
* was floating in the area for 30+ minutes

I moved my head and glasses while in the car to make sure the object was not just glare, and the object appeared too large and too high up to be a balloon (if my height estimate was correct, it would be roughly house-sized, although this was hard to judge based on the duration of time I saw it, as well as the lack of any additional reference points). The object also appeared to be too “solid” to have been a cloud, and I don’t know of any birds or aircraft that just vanish from sight instantly. I have never seen anything like this before in my life, and had I not been driving at the time, I would have attempted to get a picture/video, although once home, I drew a rough sketch for reference.
