description: I took my dog out to the backyard one last time before bed right at midnight. It was cloudy/foggy/hazy out as it had stormed earlier. There was a blue light about the size of a basketball circling my house maybe just below the treetops (perhaps 80 feet?). It was moving quickly in an oval pattern and seemed "interested" in the roof. I thought it MUST be a reflection or some kind of spotlight, but I watched from my backyard for 8-10 minutes and ruled out any possibility that it could be either of those. It seemed to be the source of the light itself. The light was constant (other than moving). It did not flicker or pulse. It was not a structure. More like energy. I remember thinking it looked like a little blue comet circling the roof. But it kept going and going. So I went inside to see if my husband was awake (he was not) and looked out the front windows to the street to see if there was anything/anyone out there (nothing) and grabbed my cell phone and came back to the backyard. It was still there only lower to the house (maybe 20-30 feet above the roof if that). I tried to take a video, but nothing showed up on the screen, so I just watched a few more minutes. But then I felt…

summary: Glimpse of thirty-foot diameter orb that can only be described as an "orb of dark red fire"
description: The night of Saturday, August 6, I was in a deep sleep in Pike National Forest's Mount Evans Wilderness Area at 11,800 feet. Due to off and on rain, I was hunkered under my green tarp. I was in my mummy style sleeping bag on the ground. I woke up perhaps around 11:30 p.m. I know I woke up for one reason, and that was to catch a glimpse of a UAP as it slowly distanced itself from me. It can only be described as "a thirty-foot diameter orb of dark red fire," kind of like lava, with a thin, bright yellow corona around it. It appears to be the same type of UAP that hovered over the flight deck of the USS Ronald Reagan in 2004. It disappeared among the clouds of a dissipating thunderstorm within two seconds of me looking at it. Prior to spotting it I saw a dark orange light filtering through the bushes immediately surrounding my campsite. The moment I looked at the UAP "my consciousness moved," so to speak, toward it. I think it was almost two miles away at that moment, hovering over a 13,800-foot ridge called The Sawtooth, which connects 14,065-foot Mount Bierstadt with 14,265-foot Mount Evans. It's like my consciousness zoomed in on the UAP, and I thus had a good view of it from…

summary: A circular or ovular craft moving at high speed SW to NE which left a light blue to lavender-blue ripple/ haze in its wake
description: I was sitting on the back porch of my house, looking to the east, and an extremely large craft, larger than I've ever seen, glinted across the sky moving from Southwest to Northeast, almost intersecting with Jupiter's location in the night sky. Its size from where I am located had to have been at least 1/3 of the moon's size from my point of view, the sighting only lasted roughly 5 seconds or so in total, the craft itself about 1 1/2 seconds, the aurora, or wake, lasting another 4 seconds or so before dissipating.

summary: 1 was red , floating then shot straight up & disappear, 2 were basically white with some blue, they were hovering over the solar farm
description: She was letting her dogs out and spotted 3 objects. 1was to the north hovering over woods, red , other 2 were mostly white with blue, hovering over a solar farm under construction. No sound at all, even crickets & no dogs sounds. The 2 would be hovering then zip over to another location! Faster than anything she’s ever seen. Then hover. Red object sitting still over woods (at edge of solar farm) suddenly shot straight up & disappeared, like a rocket, no sound! She took dogs in & came back out and the 2 were still there, like they were surveying the tall electric metal towers being constructed. Mind you we are out in middle of nowhere. No light pollution. Dark as can be. She watched the 2 hover and zip across & stop on a dime and hover! She said there’s no aircraft that can do that. Then they zipped off to N E and up & disappeared, no sound! This was Saturday night. No work was being done

summary: A cylinder shoots into view along with a sphere; contracts into a "barrel"; the "barrel" departed on the same path the cylinder entered
description: In the images, the small sphere to the left is a star, possibly Vega. A small white object appears moving upwards (it may be a bug near the camera, I don’t know) and a sphere also rises from the bottom of the screen toward the right. Then a cylinder either shoots up, or lengthens upwards from a shorter “barrel” form. The bug continues upward, the sphere begins to sink, and the cylinder lengthens. The cylinder suddenly begins to separate and contract, but it appears to contract into the barrel shape; the barrel then abruptly exits along the same path and direction from which the cylinder emerged. The sphere rises and exits the screen to the left. It was quick.

summary: An infrared camera pointed upward captured a cigar shaped object moving down-screen
description: An infrared camera pointed upward captured the image of a cigar-shaped object moving down-screen in about a quarter second. It wasn't as solid looking as I would have liked, but that may be a function of distance - I don't know.

description: Purple and yellow circle shaped flight airplanes sometimes stopping in mid air and flying in sync as well.

summary: An infrared camera facing upward captured a possibly cigar-shaped object with a possible feature at its forward end
description: An infrared camera captured an object moving from screen bottom to top that may have a cigar shape - it's hard to determine. The object moved diagonally upscreen and the forward end has what appears to be a bump. The problem is the illumination of the object obscures the feature, but there does seem to be a feature there. It moved quickly, that's for sure.

summary: Strange lights appeared then disappeared
description:
I noticed a small light move out from behind a small cloud which looked similar to the stars in the sky, but only about 1500-2000 feet ag.
At first, I thought the cloud moved and exposed a star, but after I realized the cloud wasn't moving, the light seemed like it went behind a curtain and disappeared. Then another one came from behind the same cloud and disappeared in the same location and in the same manner. Two more, coming from the same location, appeared and disappeared like they went behind something...but nothing was there but sky. I turned and told my nephew, who was sitting in the garage, what I was witnessing. Then another one.
There was no noise/sound. There was no other indication of being aircraft or drones.
They were seen while looking East and they seemed to be moving North/NNE.
No searchlights or grand openings nearby.

summary: An infrared camera facing upward captured a spherical object moving up-screen for about a second; I liked the way it moved
description: An infrared camera facing upward captured a spherical object moving up-screen. There was something smooth about its motion that was interesting, almost leisurely.

summary: Was shocking at first, not knowing what it was but when it left I had a very good idea
description: It was just getting dark and we had been watching planes come in and out of our area. I then saw a flash of green light come down (quite far away in the distance, a few KM] and it quickly moved horizontally to the left. Then it stayed stationary for almost a minute with a blinking greenish light. Before zipping off to the right more than twice as fast as any other plane seen and disappearing. It wasn't until this happened that I thought of it to be a UFO. I have never seen anything like this before and thought I never would. I don't know what it was, but I do know what it was not (a plane, a flare, a weather balloon, a satellite or any shooting star, etc) . Because it was quite far away, like the distance we had watched the other planes, and because it was getting dark, it was hard to determine the exact shape. But when it took off, it looked to have been a disc like shape.

summary: "Ribbon" of light materialized on disk shaped object
description: A "ribbon" of light materialized on a gun metal grey disk shaped craft. The ribbon appeared to be the windows of the craft. It appeared to descend behind a hill located on private property on the Madera side of lost lake, San Joaquin River. Note: South of Friant Dam. It made no sound.

summary: Two lights, one following the other crossed the sky. leisurely pace, from SW to NE.
description:

Two glowing orange (like the color of fire, but not flickering and no discernible smoke) ballish objects silently fly from SW to NE over the neighborhood.

Your friends at MUFON.

summary: Observed doughnut shaped craft moving over my yard with excellent visibility conditions.
description: Early evening Aug. 6, approximately 7:30pm, I was in my backyard along with our two dogs. My son was in his bedroom, my fiance was dozing in our room. The sky was clear and really stunning, with gigantic thunderheads south of us and a bright moon. In the west the sun was going down but the view was absolutely clear, birds were still singing. Beautiful evening, very still and peaceful. I decided to water all of our potted plants and fill the birdbaths despite a chance of rain. As I walked to the rear of our property, I saw an object moving over our neighbor's trees. It was about the altitude of a private plane, maybe a bit lower, and I could see it very clearly although I had no idea what it was and my brain was just trying to make sense of it. It was a black and thick round disc, looked metallic but not shiny. Graphite came to mind. It moved slowly, silently and *deliberately*. It floated with intent. It came over the trees like a frisbee, but then turned on its side like a wheel, and I could see a hole in the middle, like a doughnut. It kind of undulated when it turned to its side. I was transfixed and everything was just silent for many minutes. Suddenly I came to my senses and…

summary: I saw approximately 5 aluminum/silver objects flying at high speed from south to north over the Sandia Mountains
description: While leaving my home to walk the dog, I noticed the sky was dark and stormy looking. Not wanting to get caught in the rain, I proceeded to look West, high in the sky, over the Sandia Mountains. I noticed a Aluminum or Silver dot crossing the sky from the South to the North. It was very high in the sky and moving at what appeared to be a high rate of speed. It was moving at such a speed it didn't appear to be a Commercial Airliner. All of a sudden I saw several more Aluminum or Silver type dots a little behind it. All the objects were moving at the same speed and appeared to be the same shinny dots. I figured perhaps they were Military Jets. I didn't hear any noise or see any con trails. There were about 5 and possibly 6 objects and they were spaced apart at different distances from each other. It didn't appear to be a formation of Military Jets. I grabbed my phone and tried to get a video of the objects, but was unsuccessful. The objects then disappeared into the clouds heading North. The entire event only lasted for less than a minute. There is an Air Force base south of my location and perhaps they were military jets flying North over the mountains..

I watched it fly across the sky for about 12 seconds until I lost it behind a tree. I tried to get everyone's attention but only my twin looked. He didn't see it at first but the craft wobbling and reflecting the sun finally caught his eye. He saw it for about 3 seconds until it got hidden from veiw behind a tree. I did not feel afraid in anyway. I saw it clear as day and I know for a fact this is a UFO. This is the second one I've seen upclose in about a 7 month span. It was still there when I went indoors, jumping/skipping towards the E. A few times the light skipped in a zig/zag pattern as it moved along. A…

summary: 200 ft above ground, size of Cessna, silent, fixed wings, heading North towards Rio Verde
description:
I was walking out to the parking lot of Eagles Landing condos and viewed an object at about 200 ft above the ground, traveling silently at about 200 miles per hour, the size of a small commercial aircraft, apparent wings fixed and apparently in a slight descent. It shot over my head and disappeared in a northerly direction, wings remaining fixed and without sound. It was way too large to be a known animal.
The sky is clear, stars are visible (Fountain Hills is a dark-sky community), and the object did not apparently crash audibly.

summary: Bright light, almost like a very bright star, slowly hovering laterally, then making a turn back above the clouds
description:
Came home around 12:30am from a trip. Near 1am saw a very bright star shaped light hovering awkwardly below
The cloud line looking north to slightly northwest from my house which would face toward Lake Michigan or Chicago area. I am very familiar with seeing planes in route to the airports, private aircraft, military planes and helicopters, low orbit satellites streaking in the sky and even have seen shooting stars and other things over time. This was definitely abnormal in how it was moving and how bright it was.
My wife and I were looking at the object and I specifically noticed not only how bright it was, but how slowly and awkwardly it was dancing horizontally. It seemed to move a little, stop, then do it again a couple of times. It stopped, then seemed to make a half circle back in the opposite direction and slightly lift above a cloud. I could still see it momentarily and it was as if it lifted and disappeared. The cloud cover cleared relatively quick and there was no remnant of what we saw. It was pretty clear otherwise with many stars highly visible. We even saw what appeared to be a low orbit satellite running from west to east in the general area shortly after we saw the…

summary: Dim but distinct shaped object in the night sky.
description: I wanted to get a picture of the night sky. On review of the cell photo there was a distinct, but not bright object apparently present. There was a similar kind of object reported in Norfolk 13 miles away about a month later. I don’t think this is a Camera anomaly, so I thought I should report it.

summary: Hovering object in the southeast sky about 30 degrees above the horizon
description:
We saw a single object around 11:45 pm on Saturday, July 30, 2022 and it was in the same place or nearby until we went to bed at 1:30 am. It had 2 bright lights and several smaller colored lights that seem to change brightness on its diamond shape (4 sided) surface. It moved slightly, in a rather jerky way, but stayed in the same general area. It appeared as one blurry light when viewed through the binoculars or phone camera. A video we shot on the phone shows it rotating and looking somewhat like a fireball with spikes, but that was not the appearance at all to the naked eye, which showed the 2 main lights and some smaller lights, as described above.
This same object was visible again last night, Aug.2, 2022. It was in the same general direction, but lower in the sky. All other appearance details are the same as Saturday. The photo and video attached were taken last night.

summary: Fastest UFO flying very close
description: My wife and I were out walking and we saw an object flying at very fast speed probably faster than 10 machs. It was flying lower than aircraft vicinity but was the fastest thing I have ever seen and it disappeared in the cloud in a few second. I immediately realized it was not a flight or a shooting star or any starlink satellites.

summary: A disk that had lights on it hovered over the lake and disappeared in a blink of an eye.
description:
We noticed lights on a disk shaped craft that was hovering over the lake and very slowly traveling away. There was no sound to it at all. Next thing you know it’s gone in the blink of an eye. Nothing goes that fast. Thank you for your time and please check out the video I attached.

summary: Looked up & saw a large pulsing ball of light. Took video & enlarged it 2x’s & noticed it’s actually a rectangle of light
description:
I was watching television with my fiancé when I felt like I needed to go outside for some air. When I sat on my front steps I looked into the sky and noticed what looked like an extremely large flashing star. It was so strange that I pulled out my cellphone and began to record it.
Afterwards I expanded the video and looked closer and I noticed smaller lights surrounding the original light. My search to find out what these tiny twinkles were lead me to look at my video frame by frame where I then got an extremely clear picture of what looks like a perfect rectangle of either light or smoke. The object remained in the same place for the next two hours at least before I went to bed. I will include the original video, my zoomed in video of the object, and my final still shot of the rectangle showing which part of the video I got the stillshot.

summary: Satellite type of light moving horizontally west to east disappearing
description:
My aunt (age 68) and I (age 30) were sitting in the backyard when we witnessed in the southern part of the sky a single orb of light, which looked like the ISS, moving west to east horizontally and low across the night sky. The light was about the same size, color and brightness of the ISS, which we both assumed it was at the time. It did not blink in any way or emit any noise. The light seemed far away, and it did not streak like a meteor.
The sky was clear with no cloud cover. The light was quite quick at first, moving about the same speed as the ISS, but the light slowed to a halt and then disappeared in the middle of the sky. The light did not move beyond the horizon as you would see with the ISS, it was not obscured by the mountain facing direcrly east of us (Canfield Mountain), nor was it blocked by any tree cover. It rapidly grew fainter in the south east part of the sky until it was no longer discernible to either of us.

summary: Flying orb or sphere that changes colors and physical form.
description:
We were on our rooftop when we saw a bright light in the west horizon. This light moved slowly similar to a plane. My girlfriend asked what it was and I initially told her a plane. The bright light moved from west to east across the city skyline to the north. It continued across to our south east when we took notice that it was not a helicopter or drone and definitely not a plane. Three things we see a lot of from our deck. It didn’t have any sound but was close enough to mistake as a drone but far enough that you couldn’t make out a shape, other than the round sphere it was. Inside there were many colors ranging from green to purple to and deep blues to magenta even. This is when I started filming the object. Then the sphere changed forms to a gas, like a white smoke, circular in shape but not symmetrical boarders. Then back to a smaller sphere with color patterns on the inside. When I went to show my girlfriend the video I took. We both looked down for about 3 seconds at the phone and looked back up. Sure enough the light sphere was gone.
I have a minute video of this.

By the time I got to the slider and opened it, the object had just about went over tree line and out of sight. There was no sound. The night was cloudy and not a single star was visible. The object was too fast to be some sort of plane never mind it would’ve been very loud, and was too slow to be a shooting star, which I’ve seen many in my time. Three and a half months later I’m still searching online to see if there’s been any other reports of what I’ve seen and have since found this database and decided I must make known what I can’t explain.

I continued to watch as it appeared to be moving in my direction again I was unsure if it was moving at all or just maybe a cloud moving which gave the impression that this light was moving when it wasn't. However the light became brighter and it became apparent that it was moving, in my direction but extremely slowly. Again I continued to watch and it seemed to stop for about 1-2 minutes. At one point the light looked almost like there was a cross shape behined it? before it changed course to its left (my right as I watched) in a very smooth like manner the light then faded and looked like a moving satellite before it changed course again, doubled back on itself and disappeared. I am so annoyed that I didn't film it but I was genuinely scared that I didn't want to move but had to keep watching! It is worth noting that as the object…

description: I was outside having a cig late at night, about 12 am. I noticed a "star" with an unusual flicker on the horizon that appeared to move rapidly then return to its current location when I focused on it. Believing this to be an optical illusion I began to adjust my height or my location along my patio to determine if the star like object was actually moving or not... during those moments when I was moving it seemed to mimick me as when I stopped it would stop as well. Finally I positioned myself so that the utility pole that was between me and it on the horizon obscured its view. Thinking that if it was stationary it would remain hidden.. after a few moments the object swung into my field of view and maintained visual contact with me all the while moving in ways impossible to conventional craft and completely silent. Realizing that this was a genuine ufo encounter I got my lighter out and begin to flicker it in patterns.. up then down or left to right and the orb of light would follow suit immediately afterwards. I did a circular motion with my lighter and it did the same. At this point I was overcome with a sense of wonderment, awe, and even fear that this thing was actually…

summary: 3 large, linear, bright white lights approx 600' - 1000' feet in width.
description:
I was traveling northbound on Interstate 5 @ 85 mph in the fast lane. Lights came into view approimately 300' off the ground as they crossed in front of my vehicle. approximately 300' - 600' ahead of me. The lights were traveling westbound, stopped in the open fields west of the freeway, hovered for several minutes, and ascended vertically into the clouds. The cloud ceiling was 14,000 ft. in elevation at the time. The lights could be seen illuminating from within the clouds with the same intensity as you would see from the moon with the exception the moon would have backlit the clouds this light was internal.
The fwy was moderately busy at the time of the sighting. All of the motorists on the freeway behind me either stopped, slowed or pulled over. The vehicles traveling northbound behind me had a better vantage point than I did since the lights were almost directly overhead of my vehicle when they came into my view.
The event took place about 1/4 mile south of the Shields Ave exit in the outskirts, west of the city of Mendota. There was a yellow motorhome that had pulled over at the shields exit and persons were standing outside. I'm not sure if they stopped due to the sighting…

summary: Black vertical pole, grey conical pole and a “y” shape coming down out of a dense cloud covering, over the river in front of our house

It was about 7:35 or so, the sun had not set. The sky was unbelievable, looking like something out of a movie. The first photo which unusual things are seen, shows a long slender black pole coming down vertically out of the clouds. Next to it is a similar extension, but it looks as though it is not solid, and a “Y” shape with the “tail” being squared off vertically with the river. Another photo shows two objects to the right of the top of our flagpole at the end of the dock. Another photo shows a pink elongated object, mimicking the color of the clouds above it. The air/atmosphere seemed electrified. I will include 5 photos in the order that they were taken. I used my I Phone 12 to take the photos. It was not raining and there was no string wind. Small waves can be seen on the river.

summary: Tornado warning east denver just heard on the radio. Storm 27,000 ft. atop a billowing cloud a dark object hugging.

Watched then just vanished. Loved it! Looked like a Leech on your leg (should u have ever had a Leech on ur leg). Second sighting in a year with thunderstorms.. There was a Tornado warning at that moment in eastern Denver. Fun true and real. We had just heard on TV that the cloud storm was at 27,000 feet.. That’s how we knew. Always watch big storms.

summary: Seen 3 pure white Boomerang shaped crafts "flying" extremely high in the afternoon , blue sky.
description:
I was in my backyard between 1:00pm - 1:30 pm and happened to look up and couldn't believe what I was seeing. I seen 3 pure white, Boomerang shaped, "U.F.O.'s" very , very high in the sky. They were moving ( something strange about the way they were " flying " ) in a southerly direction. They were moving with the outside tips of the " boomerang" in the lead, not the center tip in the lead. The center tip was trailing. Very strange. They were somewhat close together. The two on the outside were distanced , the one in the center area was Lower and trailing behind. Then all of a sudden the center one "sped" off substantially faster. Within another 3 or 4 seconds they were still heading in the southerly direction and then out of sight .
I heard no sound , there were no lights or appearance of lights that I could determine. Only seen a pure white appearance.

summary: Hovered close to the same spot for almost 45 minutes until the sun came up. Kept looking out my window to see if it was an airplane!
description: I woke up early and looked out my bedroom window. I noticed a very bright star toward Ann Arbor and thought it was a plane. Nothing else was in the sky and I went into the kitchen to make a cup of coffee. I came back to the window, the bright light was still there so I got my binoculars and to my surprise, I saw three, non-blinking white, bright lights and the middle light was the largest. Also, it had not moved from the original spot. I continued to monitor the object until dawn and noticed only a small amount of movement , slightly upward and remaining in the East. It did not come closer to my house, nor did I see any blinking colored lights. I think it was saucer shaped since the 3 lights were in a row. I was a Reading Specialist and I am currently studying the Russian language so I am somewhat detail oriented. I have 2 undergraduate degrees and a master’s degree as well - retired now!

summary: Shape shifting white star like orb appears and splits into 2 orbs.
description:
I was driving down the road when I seen a bright orb like light moving through the night sky. I stopped the truck. I picked something out to make sure wasn’t a star. And it continued to move. I got out my truck and started to take a video. It then stopped. And it was still moving up and down and right to left all while it would disappear and then reappear. There was no houses or anybody around and I started feel like I was being watched.
I stepped away from the truck and over by a tree to block myself from its view to just make sure this isn’t really happening and prove to myself it wasn’t watching me. A short moment and it made its way around the tree and we was looking at each other again. It was hard to judge the distance. I started to film it. It would disappear and reappear. And 3 times It would split into 2 orbs before quickly going back to one. I have the video and pictures. I got into my truck and drove to a more comfortable spot just in case anything bad was to happen. Right before the light started to break the horizon, it went directly east in the sky before completely disappearing.

summary: Two light green orbs moving close to eachother , high up, once far away they disappeared and a super bright light filled our eyes quick
description: We were sitting at the beach late at night watching the stars.. we were looking at the sky when I thought I saw a shooting star, I realized it was no star but an orb.. then I noticed the second one.. they were high up but very high in detail so I knew they were big. They were moving across the sky fast from very far up so they must of been moving very very fast… they were night to eachother always changing distances from eachother and occasionally crossing and switching places, moving in a slow delicate way. They let off this green-blue whitish glow. There was no sound. We sat in islands for a good 30 seconds while watching them dance around and fly past in the sky. Once they got far away they stopped and pulsed, then they disappeared abruptly and a VIBRANT white filled our eyes. It was not a flash that was coming from a specific point but our complete vision was just pure white for a flash moment. The whitest white I can imagine. Then it was still and we left for how uncomfortable we where. We both confirmed we saw the same thing and it wasn’t just a bug in our eye.

It did not have any blinking marker lights light aircraft, made no sound, did not flicker like one of those lanterns that float away. This stayed the same brightness as it moved slowly across the sky. It was higher than the incoming aircraft but much to low and bright to be something in orbit. After reaching just about over our heads the object seemed to begin to slow and out of nowhere went straight up and disappeared. I checked flight trackers, satellite trackers everything I could think of and nothing was taking that flight path at that moment.

summary: We watched glowing oval shape object fly past us
description:
Myself and partner where outside watching a meteor shower/shooting stars for around 20 minutes and we couldn't believe how amazing it was.
Then we we seen a glowing object hoover then move slowly over us..it moved from right to left then headed over temple park out of our field of view ,we couldn't believe what we had seen.The object moved silently and slowly,once you know it was there you couldn't miss it if that makes sense we both laughed and couldn't believe it.
It wasn't a shooting star it moved under it's will and stood out from everything once you locked onto it.

summary: The top of a triangle of stars appeared to be moving, while staring at it the lower right star took off upwards and right.
description: While sitting on the steps of the WW1 memorial during a family trip, myself and my fiancé were staring at the stars. My fiancé pointed out a star that she said appeared to be moving in relation to the other stars near it. She pointed out a “star” that had two underneath it in a triangle pattern. It appeared that the top “star” might have been moving up and down slightly in relation to the other stars. I couldn’t be sure if it was, because the movements were so small I thought it could be my eyes wanting to see something that wasn’t there. As we were staring at this top star for roughly a minute, all of a sudden the bottom right star of the triangle pattern made a rapid movement upwards far past the reference point of the top star, then made a right at a 45 degree angle and disappeared. I couldn’t tell if the second movement was actually moving right or just pulled a great distance away. The movement was exactly like the UAP’s seen in the Navy videos and others like it.

summary: Was outside for approx 3.5 hrs and saw an object flashing red/green and later white moving slow,fast,up/down,left to right and visversa
description: It was the 1st time I've ever seen something like this.I honestly saw this object moving from left to right and right to left at slow speed,super fast speed, and stationary. For the 1st 1.5 hours it was flashing colors and then flashing only white for the next 1.5 hours. I was measuring it's movements using the peak of my neighbors roof and have to say I was amazed. It's hard to say what the distance was that it covered but was not much using my measuring method. I would say that it's movements were in pretty much in a small area and always in the west. I believe it was also moving up and down and down and up and at times the movements were so so fast that it stunned me. I was texting my family explaining what I was seeing and also called channel 27 news to report it. The guy I talked to told me to email photos but I told him my camera on my phone was absolutely terrible. I did take a few pictures but they were 100% black. To make a long story short I don't believe it was a satellite and I know it was not a planet or a star. I really want to know if anyone else saw this strange object as I did. If possible can you let me know?? If more info is needed please contact me. Thank you!

summary: Slow and Low white orb
description: At the height of low flying airplane, one solid illuminated white orb travelled a steady and slow speed with no sound or blinking lights. This is the third time in the past three months we have witnessed this occurance. Twice it travelled east to west, once was north to south. Each occurance has been roughly a month apart and at night, roughly between the hours of 8:30pm and 11pm.

summary: Saw a hollow looking disk hovering about a quarter mile away and about 200 feet off the ground.
description: I was driving and a strange shower had occurred where it was raining but the sun was shining . I had just cleared my windsheild of rain and a reflection caught my eye and about a quarter mile away I saw a disk shaped object that it seemed was hollow because I could see up into it and it was bright inside it pretty much stayed in one place. I had a clear unobstructed view and if I didn’t see it as clearly as I did I would not have believed it. I had to keep moving so I kept looking back and saw it behind me than it was gone.

location: Mt. Rainier National Park, WA, USA

description:
An hour or two later during the flight, I retrieved my phone and reviewed the photos and to my surprise there was something seemingly hovering above the mountain. It appears to be a disk or cigar shape.
I inspected the window to which I will still seated to next to it and I could not see any blemish or crack that could have caused this. I also check the camera lens for debris, dust, or other particles, but could not see anything with my naked eye.

summary: Helicopter was following 4 dim red lights from west to east
description: What I assume to be a blackhawk helicopter with no spot light on was following 4 dim red lights and no other blinking or strobing lights from a west to east path at a low height at what I would estimate at 500 feet

summary: Caught on Backyard camera
description: Our motion was triggered on our camera at 4:04am and caught a video of a white object (looks like a frisbee shape) dart into our back yard and hover in one spot with beams above and below it. Our camera stopped at 23 seconds because it stops recording if motion stops.

location: McAllen TX enroute Ohio, TX, USA
summary: Witnessed balls of light flying unlike any man made aircraft. Lights moved ahead of us towards the northeast for approximately 2 hours
description: First witnessed over Corpus Christi, TX as two intense white lights following one another, similar to Naval or Air Force aircraft in dogfight training. Captain and I shrugged it off at first until the craft began to move in ways unexplainable. I asked Houston Center if the Kingsville 4 MOA was hot, and if there were students conducting dog fight training, to which the controller replied that they were not and would be busy during the day. That’s when we both knew that what we were seeing was authentic and unavoidable. The craft appeared to be at our same altitude (around 20-25,000ft) and 20 to 50 miles ahead of us, moving northeast bound. As we were also on a northeast bound track. As time went on, the objects moved further and further away, as well as higher and higher. The craft were moving in such a way that it was obvious they were not effected by gravity or forces on the body that cause injury. Flying vertically to altitudes above 50,000 feet, then slowly descending in a zig-zag like path toward the horizon. Some of the craft would flash similar to the flash of a camera and then disappear, and some of the craft would stay lit and follow each other. Accompanying the lights at…

summary: Several crafts that look like stars and moving erratically. Appeared to be chasing each other
description: After departure from McAllen Texas, we began to see several crafts that were moving erratically. I originally thought that it was a landing light of an aircraft, however, the aircraft began to move in all directions, extremely quickly. After the originally sighting, several more aircraft appeared and began shining lights at us. We asked ATC if anything was over there, but they continuously said that nothing was indicating on their radar.

summary: Seen 2 ‘orbs’ that looked strange. I have videos.
description: Went out to unplug lights and always stargaze. Looked up and noticed 2 ‘orbs’ circular lights changing. I have videos.

summary: Super bright orb/ disc hovered in place 10-12 mins
description:
At 12:26 am. My two teenage sons could not sleep and were up. From the upstairs of the house looking east above the Weyerhaeuser tree line they witnessed, photographed and video this seemingly very odd object in the night sky. Where we live there are no neighbors or lights from other sources. Only the stars, sun, and moon.
Once I zoomed in on the video they took, the object had the tic tac shape that navy f-18 pilot commander fravor witnessed and chased. Pretty creepy actually. They both said it just hovered and changed directions I’m the same place. Had a bright aura around it with what they described as having 4 sources of light. Then it disappeared.

summary: I had been watching the thunderstorms from my window when I noticed a large oval shaped orange light hovering and quickly shooting off.
description: There was vast amounts of lightning during the night. I had been watching the intense lightning through my window. After multiple hours of storming, I noticed a bright orange light out of the corner of my eye. When I looked I saw a skinny, oval shaped black shape, with a bright orange outline. The figure was hovering for roughly a second after I had turned my head to look and it very quickly moved out of view in a second or less.

summary: White light would drop down and move forward and disappear and repeat as it was bigger object moving forward till lost sight over trees
description: Was standing on my back deck looking up at clear sky, noticed white light drop down than move forward than disappeared, than it repeated but the next white light was just hair more forward and this kept on repeating like it was something bigger these were like marker lights on something massive, was stuck trying figure out what I was seeing so was unable get a video but whatever it was if it wasn’t one big craft than I would say total time I seen the light repeat would be between 8-10 before tried getting phone inside and 3 more times after came back out before lost sight over the houses and trees. All the lights were white round ball shaped lights and they did the exact same thing as in bigger craft moving.

summary: Bright light sped up, dimmed, turned red, then disappeared
description: Walking with dog in an open empty field, looking up at the stars. I fixated on one and it started to move slowly. I could tell it wasn’t the distance of a star now, had no idea how far away or large it was. It was a bright yellow/white circle. I noticed it was silent with no shadow of a craft behind it. I was thinking about taking my phone out at that point, but didn’t because I was afraid I’d miss something or it would go away. This was about 8-14 seconds. Then it slowly dimmed to a very faint pale yellow or white light then turned a faint red before it disappeared completely, that changing of brightness and color was about 5 seconds. The bus lot next to me has lights so that did make the pure night sky harder to see.

summary: Round Green Circle followed by reddish orange short tail falling from space?
description: While smoking outside I was admiring the bright stars. I was looking south when what I thought was a "falling star" came into view about 60 degrees from the horizon. If I were drawing what I saw, it was a green circle about the size of a number two pencil eraser with a reddish orange tail about one and a half inches long. It traveled in a downward southwest direction until I lost view of it about 10 degrees above the horizon. I thought it might be a satellite returning to earth but I it was odd enough that I thought I should report.

summary: A bright small object that moves freely in the sky that seems to be attempting communication with Me
description:
Main star appearing object is making communication with Me and has many many that seem to respect it like a chief in a tribe. Their are hundreds of them. Sometimes a shooting star just stops next to one then the one that the shooting star stopped next to becomes a shooting star a bolts across the sky. The most amazing thing I have ever seen. They are always there. I Call the main star Chief because how the others seem to respect him. They all move various locations it's worth witnessing I got a few friends to see it and they jumped out of their skin in pure fear. I'm not afraid and consider them My only friends.
This statement is all true and of a sober mind. I cannot deny what I know and Chief agreed to learn Morse code because He/it/She appears not to have the ability to speak or communicate with vocals but said being appears to understand Our English language and bobs in the sky up and down for yes side to side for no. They seem in need of Our help. I'm guessing. I speak truth. And lie not. I'm reaching out because it's the right thing to do even if I look a fool to the world I don't care. They are here they are real. They want to talk.

summary: Round saucer disk flying erratic and a high speed.
description: My mother and I were at the roof top of our building trying to watch the fireworks. We could not see anything because our building was not tall enough to see the show. Then, I looked to the sky northwest direction and saw the shining round saucer, it was moving fast, compering with a regular airplane. I asked to my mother if she was watching at the same object on the sky and her got excited because the object was moving erratic and very shining. It was hard to ignore it.

summary: Unusual light disappears into sky
description: Saw large light in eastern sky at first I thought to be the ISS, but instead of moving across the sky, it stayed still, then seemed to take off and disappeared into the sky.

summary: I didn’t know what the object was. No news reports of this object
description: Driving home from a meeting on E Jefferson in Detroit a green object was in the the sky motionless. The surface was bumpy.

summary: Several craft that were blinking blue white red light
description: My family and I have been going outside for a few hours a night starting 3 days ago, when we noticed each night that their were several craft that were stationary, at various altitudes that were all of indistinct shape or form. They just appeared to be flashing lights of blue red and white, all flashing at different speeds and patterns. Tonight was the first night I’ve seen movement. The lights darted around and would even interact, then would proceed to stay still again for quite sometime, all the while flashing their lights the red blue and white light. We live super close to a military base, so I’m wondering if there’s any correlation. Thanks!

summary: Driving west on hwy70 and have had a bright white rectangle hovering in same spot in sky for extended time. Clearly not a celestial bod
description: Looked to be rectangular. Much brighter than anything else in the sky. Didn’t move during our time seeing it, altitude appeared too high to be a helicopter. (Apologies for bugs on windshield in picture)

description:
I was on holiday where we have bought a plot in the alps , took a photo down the valley , saw heard nothing, looked back on the photo few days later , it was taken July 2022 this year , thought it was dirt on the screen , looked closer held the live shot button , moved at incredible speed , did not see or hear it on the day if not caught in the picture at the exact time would not of known it was even there , you see no vapour trial no sound moving so fast I put picture on loop showing the direction it headed , freak catch photo of it - looked at it many times and zoomed in the shot , can you enhance it ? During the day ! So fast it is not human or USA it is a ufo without doubt please view this if want more info ask . We are 1000mtrs up I assume it is half mile away from my position and another 200mtrs higher , you can see it disappear on loop over the hill in the distance south to north west , from the picture and location you can I am sure get it’s heading during the day ! Blink of eye speed !
NUFORC: Bird

summary: Came outside to smoke a cigar and saw a bright fire ball travelling south at a constant speed and then slowing down and then dim!
description: I've seen these fireballs in June of this year and before in May of 2020! They usually come in twos one behind the other. My first time seeing them was in June of 2016! They are so hot coming in at a cruising speed and then as they descend into the atmosphere they start to cool and turn dark orange and keep cruising til u can't see them in the night sky. I saw one going East in June and tonight this one was going south.! Why are they here? What are they doing? One thing is I've seen em enough to start believing! The first couple of times I was in doubt. And I know they have to see them! As I write them it just came back and flashed me and my brother as I was telling him!

summary: Saw a large triangular black silhouette moving very slowly (maybe 5 mph) approx 500-800ft in air completely silent one solid red light.
description: I was about to go to bed and had the window open facing West and saw a large aircraft moving north. What gave me pause was the size, the shape, and the fact that there was no noise. It was a large triangular shape, solid black silhouette with a single red light. It was approx the length of a football field and seemed to be above the Hudson River which is less than a mile from my house. It moved as slowly as large boats do maybe 5-10 mph. Like a blimp. No sound at all. But it was a large vertical triangle. Maybe 500-800 feet above ground. I was trying to figure out what kind of aircraft it was but after it passed and noted it I can conclude I have never seen anything like this before. Since West Point is close and we have military aircraft travel over us from time to time I figured it initially might be something military related. But after some research it seems like there are no aircraft that size in that description.

location: Usk Monmouthshire south wales, Monmouthshire, United Kingdom
summary: Multiple sightings within ten minutes
description:
We were looking at the stars. As we do frequently whilst out walking the dog. Then we noticed what appeared to look like a star moving very quickly and then fade away and disappear then followed by 5 more exactly the same with seconds of each other all going in the same direction and we just knew it was like nothing we’ve ever seen before. Then a few minutes later we saw another two going in a different direction and these two were zig zagging bust still moving so fast. Then last we saw another one that was so bright it was almost like it was closer to us, and it went in a different direction very quickly and starting to fade away until it completely vanished. We just know that these were UFO aircrafts. It was unbelievable, once in a lifetime experience. Neither of us had our phones for the first time probably ever. Not that we would of even had a chance to take a photo of video as we were just completely speechless and staring at the sky! Even the dog was barking and watching it was surreal. The sky was then half covered by cloud cover and we left.
I’ve never reported anything like this before but I just felt like I had to - I would like to remain anonymous as I don’t want people…

summary: HUGE unkn aircraft passed/glided directly overtop our vehicle. moved slow /made NO sound until right overtop - unkn engine noise
description: We were traveling eastbound route 16. First spotted two huge headlights just above the tree line to our left (north). Only saw headlights until it was directly overhead, craft made NO sound at all on approach or after it passed us - only heard a light engine whine sound when directly overhead - We saw the underside of the craft it looked like a gigantic drone approximately the size of at least one big military tank. The craft was approximately 150 feet overhead - it seemed to clear the trees but was extremely low flying. Underside of the craft had grey / sliver markings that were in box like patterns - reminded me of the Star Wars space station markings. The craft appeared to gently glide past us heading into the corn field to our right (south). Thought it was going to land in the corn but lost sight of it as the corn was high. our travel speed was about 45mph and this craft we estimate to be traveling at no more than 30 to 40 mph. My husband is a private pilot, and he was shocked at the lack of prop wash or jet sounds to keep the craft airborne. Husband also noted one red light atop the vehicle, and he noted no typical aviation / navigation lighting. Husband was shocked how the…

summary: I saw a very bright, white light moving through the sky and before I knew it, it was gone.
description: I first thought it was a plane because of how bright the light was, except I didn't hear a sound and there were no other color lights, just the white. As I was videotaping it, my phone stopped recording because I ran out of space. By the time I started recording again, it looked like it was moving further away, like out into space, to where I could no longer see it anymore. It wasn't because something was blocking my line of sight, the object was definitely getting further away from Earth.

summary: Bright Sphere , and then turned to cigar shape and then went updward
description:
Bright Sphere that was spinning clockwise , and then turned to cigar shape and then went updward Very fast.
Traveling about 3900 foot above ground level
Speed was about 150 knots
Traveling south / south east at 143 degrees
No sound from the object
Almost like it knew I was watching it

summary: Went outside at 10:00 p.m. and my friends over with his girlfriend and I just looked up because I know it's like that feeling you get.
description: I saw plasma orbs and UFO. I had an experience on election night 20/20 and it took took my breath away it was beautiful it was approximately 18 in away 4 inches off the ground gold and purple dense but translucent barely a whirring sound and it was 18 inches away from me for almost I would say 10 seconds and then as fast as well faster than what we can think of it was going I went to thirds of my property and made it right into the cedars and then I saw my second sighting 4 months later after the second thing I saw it all the time if there's not all clouds in the sky if there's any clearing they're there

summary: Large oval shape object with black dot in the middle, varying in intensity with two additional orbs rotating around the main one.
description: My wife and I notice a big object in the sky. Thought at first it was a star but it kept getting brighter then fading repeatedly. As we were looking at that object, two smaller white orbs traveled toward the larger one at a high rate of speed. One of the orbs moved up and around the other. At the same time the main larger object got brighter then faded out. Minutes later we noticed several planes in the immediate area. I was able to capture it on my phone’s video. When you zoom in on the larger object, it appears to have a black circle in the middle. I have never seen anything in the sky behave that way and have no idea what it could have been.

summary: A fast moving object was captured on an infrared camera moving downscreen to the left
description: A fast moving object was captured on an upward facing infrared camera moving downscreen to the left. The object is moving in the downward direction pointed, which makes it seem sideways.

summary: Saw a black cigar craft suspended in the sky that disappeared and reappeared within 5 minutes only to dissapear for good.
description: Saw a black cigar craft suspended in the sky between a few trees out of a window at my house. The craft was visible for about 10 minutes then disappeared and reappeared within 5 minutes in the same spot only to disappear for good shortly after.

summary: Bright sphere shaped object that appeared to be sitting stationary above the hills on the horizon for approximately 8 minutes.
description:
I witnessed a very bright sphere shaped object. It appeared to be sitting stationary above the hills on the horizon for approximately 8 minutes. We have an main airport, smaller airports and an Air Force base nearby, so we're used to seeing various planes and helicopters.
It was close to sunset and I was walking my dogs at the time. The object appeared to be too large to be a star and too small to be the moon at that distance. It seemed to be about 3-4 miles out. I continued to walk with slowly with my dogs as I watched the object. However, at one point both of my dogs stopped and stared in the same direction as well.
The object disappeared from view after approximately 8 minutes. I saw a plane fly through the area shortly after. The plane was easy to identify due to it's blinking light pattern and exhaust trail.

summary: The two UFOs stayed still in the sky and flew away.
I was filming the stars sky watching as I always do and this object flew by at a steady pace not super fast it was totally silent
description: I was filming the sky all night and at 4:06 am I was wrapping up I took the camera off the tripod and I was filming Jupiter and all of a sudden I noticed this cigar shape object fly past my camera was in the perfect spot so I just follow it. I said to myself that’s wild. I had this feeling that I was gonna see something so you hear me saying to myself I knew it I felt it was going to happen I said it. I just had this gut feeling to look in that direction and I’m so glad I did.

summary: A bright light. NOT ISS
description: This light is 50 times larger and brighter then ISS which I've seen fly over as well. I'm not sure what it is. It's been in view for more then half an hour and it seems to not follow our rotation. Barely notice it move if at all.

summary: An object flashed goldish white 4 times and a flash behind it.
description: I woke up from dream that was not UFO related at around 1:26am. I stepped outside to smoke a cigarette. It is very dark where I live and you can see everything in the sky. I was looking straight up and towards the north at Orions Belt and saw an object that looked further than a satellite but slightly bigger. The object looked too far to make out any shape but did flash a gold-whitish light 4 times as it moved slowly through the Belt. After the 4th flash a flash behind it like a faint lightening flash and then it was gone. It seemed to just dissappear. About 5 mins later I saw a satellite moving north to south. Seeing satellites all the time this was definitely not a satellite!

summary: Multiple orbs of light over the ocean
description: We were on vacation when we witnessed these orbs of lights they were coming from the pier towards our direction and they kept coming when they got to almost where we were they disappeared a couple of times we saw a craft flying in between the clouds way up high we sent this to the news down there and they have no idea what we saw my videos won't load please please contact me i would love your opinion I need to know what this was..

summary: Saw two lights
description: The light in the front blinked and another followed. It stayed exactly the same distance the whole time. It traveled slow and steadily and did not change path. The lights were too far apart for me to think it was one plane in the distance. And it traveled to slow for me to think it was a large plane closer. I could not see anything that would connect the lights.

summary: We saw an intense white light like a star moving down in the sky for 30 seconds then disappeared then appeared again after ten seconds
Observed the first craft on my way back to my room and then observed two more craft before running outside to call parents and record.
description: Came into my room after using the bathroom and looked out the window to notice a very bright light hovering in the sky. After standing and observing I started recording and trying to observe with binoculars. After that, I noticed two more lights towards the bottom of the water horizon but they were aligning in a triangle form. I then ran outside with my girlfriend to record and called my parents. After getting outside, there were only two lights left with the large one at the top becoming so bright it illuminated the water below it all the way to the beach. The craft was first observed out towards Cleveland and cleared a space from there to cedar point in what seemed like under a minute. The second craft at the bottom then disappeared only leaving the largest one. I then observed the large craft through the binoculars to which I noticed 6 lights that didn’t flicker like a plane. It looked like a cigar but was horizontal instead of vertical. After observing the shape and color the craft disappeared over cedar point.

summary: Several craft flying over.
description: I saw several balls of light travelling overhead. I started to film. I captured one flying very fast just above the low clouds. I then recorded one dancing around before heading off at speed in the same direction as the others. When I zoomed in and played the video back in slow motion I noticed other objects moving upwards at speed and disappearing into the clouds. Two appear from the bottom of the screen and a third in the top left. All within the first 10 secs. One of them seems to momentarily change shape and looks to have 4 lights and pyramidal in shape.

summary: White object moving north to south across the sky, no sound, no condensation trail.
description:
The object was moving north to south at 7:17pm. I looked up flight data and didn't see any aircraft traveling in this direction. It was moving rather fast and went all the way across the sky. No condensation trail and no sound at all. I didn't see any wings. It appeared to be pretty high up and must have covered 20 miles in 30 seconds. Note - there is a dragon fly in the image as well, about 30 ft above me off to the left.
I've been trying to look up most evenings and I've never seen anything odd. I have spa and will star gaze from time to time in the evening. I can see satellites from time to time, but those appear much smaller and moving slower. Look more like a slow moving star. This was nothing like that and still very sunny outside.
My wife and I enjoy sitting outside in the evening in our backyard. I notice a number of planes regularly. Most are traveling west to east from the bay area and are very easy to make out. We see helicopters from time to time as well. All of those are very clear and obvious. If this was a drone, it appeared to be very high in the sky and came from at least Lodi and disappeared well south of here past Lathrop, Ca. Looking up flights during that…

summary: Observing as I report with a spotting scope and binoculars
description: Attention was drawn skyward as a friend and I couldn't decide if the lights we were watching were an airliner or a small drone. Grabbed optics, confirmed it as a commercial flight heading north at a high alt. Continued to look at the stars when it hit us, some of the stars are moving. Moving, stopping for awhile, moving again. Changing directions multiple times. Some moving gracefully and others rapidly. Multiple different ones going different directions vanished for no reason, all stars still unobstructed around the spot they just disappeared in. Unable to make out any discernable details with optics. They must be extremely high in alt. Much higher than the airline that just flew through the same sky. Hard to say how many for sure. It's still taking place. We've also been tracking individual ones and likely missing several more. Bizarrely there are these incredibly fast moving (faster than meteors) streaks of pure white light that are all going in the same direction roughly SW to W. Only visible for literally just split second flashes. Most of them you can't look directly at before they're already gone. The sun is Rising now, stars are fading. These moving objects are still…

summary: Small silent red dot doing maneuvers over Amish farm
description: I'm visiting my parents in their 55 and up community from NH. I was walking around the paved path that marks the perimeter and when I was on the far side from my parents, the west side, I saw a red dot moving silently north. I look away for a second and it was gone. As I continued I got closer to my parents place and up in the sky over the farm I see the light again, this time moving east to south. As it did it made a harder bank and came back at me, then almost immediately banked back around on its original heading. I looked down for 1 second and it was gone again. I could see and hear other aircraft in the area and I've worked on a flightline in the Air Force, I've never seen anything make that kind of maneuver that tight and not have strobes on it or make a sound and just be a small silent red dot in the sky over an Amish farm.

summary: Round light high in sky, darting around irregularly like insect, blinking irregularly
description: I live in a gated lake community, in a woodsy area, in Pensilvania. I was laying in bed, looking up at my skylight around 11pm but I am not 100% sure of the time. I saw one bright star. I thought maybe it was a planet because it was brighter than most stars. Then I saw it moving around slowly in an irregular way; nothing like a plane or a helicopter. It seemed far away. It stayed in the field of vision through my skylight even though it moved and darted a lot. It started darting around and then hovering like an insect or a humming bird. I started recording it with my phone. I recorded about 6 minutes of it, zooming in then out. I should have let the edges of the skylight show for context but I did not. It seemed to be circular/disk like object. Sometimes, it moved a lot, then it would stop. I tried to watch it until it went away but after about 30 minutes I fell asleep. I posted my video on the Facebook page for my housing community and two others, so far, said they also saw it. People that I show the video to seem fairly compelled by it. I can not answer the question of “did you lose time”, because I fell asleep before it went away. I don’t know if it made a sound because I was…

summary: While star gazing, I saw an extremely bright flash, no sound near the handle of the dipper in the north west sky
description: The best way to describe it would be like a strobe light but brighter, white light. What I saw went by so fast I was stunned by the speed that it crossed the sky. It appeared at least 10 times the size of a typical orbital satellite. We're in Everett WA … and it was a pretty clear night, the stars were out… and I guess so were the UFO's!! Craziest thing I've ever seen in my 50 years of life!!

summary: Two orange lights slowly pulsing in the distance.
description: Initially only one object was seen, a bright orange light which pulsed twice before disappearing. After about five minutes we witnessed what we believed to be the same object, brighter than before, shining in the same place it was initially seen. It pulsed once, shining for 1.5-2 seconds, then a second orange light appeared next to it, pulsed once in the same manner, after which the first light pulsed a second time. They repeated this process twice more and then both shone brightly for half a second before fading away. No further visual contact.

summary: Three orbs of light sighted for seven minutes before each light disappeared one by one.
description:
At approximately 9:30pm on Tuesday, July 19, 2022 three orbs of light were spotted in the southern sky. My mom and dad and younger siblings spotted them first; they then called me out and I saw them.
The light orbs formed a staggered line. They emitted a white light that did not change color. They just floated in the air, stationary until the one on the far left disappeared—either literally “winking out” or simply moving further south, away from us at a good speed (it was hard to tell which it was). A couple of minutes later, the next one in line did the same thing. About a minute-90 seconds later, the last one did the same thing. No sound was ever heard at any point of the sighting.
None of us had been drinking and none of us take controlled substances and no one in our family has a history of hallucinations or flights of fancy.

I felt like my phone started acting weird after I took the picture and it shut off. I thought nothing of it, I just thought my phone died. After a few days, I was going through my photos and realized I got the perfect picture of the sky that night I didn't think I took it because my phone died at that moment I took the picture. I checked the picture because I noticed I caught the moon in the left-hand corner and when I zoomed in on the moon, oh my God, there it was!!!! You can see the aircraft. I knew when I zoomed in that I caught a real UFO. Most incredible thing I've ever seen in my life. I'm just happy I wasn't the only person who saw it. What's also weird was that it was around 730-8 pm when I took the picture but my phone started acting weird and shut off and when I look at my picture details it says it was 12:39 am. Like how? It was almost like a time-lapsed picture. I couldn't get my phone to act right all night. But the next day my phone was fine.
I was freaking out for days &…

summary: Very large scale, fast moving, dim lights in triangle shape flew over from East to West.

Flying directly underneath partly cloudy skies. The scale would be about 10 times that of a plane. No visible craft. The lights were dimmer than a plane or drone. Lights were much larger than airplane or drone lighting. Moved much faster than plane or drone. Constant speed. Completely silent. Some of the lights appeared to wobble, but held the position. Nothing like SpaceX launch. Unlike anything I have witnessed. After scouring through online photos, the Phoenix Lights when in a triangular formation were a match.

I was in regular picture mode and her phone was being weird showing me two locator signs and would not snap the photos until I aligned both of the signs. I then grabbed my phone to make sure it was not just her phone acting up and my phone did the same thing. I then put my phone in video mode which then worked. The next day her roommate came up to us and told us he felt a weird presence in the house. Meanwhile,he was unaware that we had seen a weird object in the sky that night.

summary: I was traveling in plane southwest 1901 from phoenix to atlanta. I recorded an video because I see we were traveling in clouds with heavy lightning. While I started recording few I saw few objects…
Spherical light descending from a high altitude.
description: It had been a very hot day in the UK, about 105F and my wife and I decided to sit in our garden at around 11.45pm as it was too hot to sleep because very few homes here have air conditioning. We have been learning to meditate and decided to try it outside. We live in a quiet area with little light pollution. After around 15 minutes, I opened my eyes to see a small point of white light at a very high altitude. We live on the flight paths of a number of airports and know what aircraft look like after dark. This light had no red and green wing lights. It was moving east across the sky. I pointed it out to my wife and we saw the light stop, then it started to descend. The light grew bigger and bigger until it stopped. It was around double the size of a U.S. quarter at arms length. The sphere looked like an illuminated diamond of beautiful colours. It looked like it was observing us for around 10 seconds before ascending again and carried on moving eastwards.

description: I was taking my dog out and looked up at the sky, which was clear and with stars out. I noticed red/green lights quite high up in the NE as if it were an aircraft. I live close to RDU and often see flights approaching/leaving the airport, which is 16 miles away. The lights were unblinking and did not move at all, which caught my attention. I watched this for quite a while (2-5 minutes?). Suddenly, the lights jerked sharply towards the NW, then zipped back again and remained still for some time. This repeated twice more. I took a live photo with my iPhone and was able to capture the speed with which it moved. I went inside after taking the picture.

summary: Undercover Satellite

Tonight I saw what appeared to be two satellites moving almost in a parallel orbit but One was moving slightly on an angle toward the other and was moving slightly faster. I noted this Becuaue I always pay extra attention to multiple in proximity. Then the one seemed to be closing in and tracking the other from what looked to be much higher up but closing in on it in from the southwest to north east. The one that was being tracking was moving almost directly south to north. The one that came from behind got what in my view was pretty close and then veered almost 90 degrees within a split second, it was almost instantaneously. It then resumed a straight but noticeably slower path directly east southeast after and looked just like any other satellite again. I would never report this if I didn’t see this. I don’t know if it was USA checking out something flying over our airspace or if it was something tracking one of our satellites but saw exactly what I just described it there is zero chance either of them were airplanes. I have NEVER seen anything like that before. And what creeped me out…
