summary: Bright light hovering in northern sky.
description: I was setting up my telescope in the back yard for a night of astrophotography. I am familiar with where north, magnetic north and celestial north are in my yard and set up my tripod during the day roughly pointed at the selection North Pole near Polaris. The sun had not fully set and there were no stars visible at this time. I estimate that I will be able to use Polaris to polar align my scope once its dark enough in about 30 minutes. I look up and see a very bright star close to Polaris. It catches me off guard as I should not be able to see any stars at this time, but it is definitely a star and a bright one at that. I almost convinced myself that it might be the North Star and begin the alignment procedure when I realize it’s too far off to be Polaris. I then pull out my iPad to use Stellarium software to find out which star I’m looking at cause I now think it might be a super nova that just exploded. I watched this object for roughly 5 minutes before deciding to get a picture with my phone. I line up the shot then decide to switch to video to zoom in. The object immediately blinks out and is gone. It was roughly the magnitude of Venus while there was still sun light. It did…

summary: Looked up in the dimming night sky--sun was still setting--orange to the west---above I saw a very bright -very large STRAIGHT object
description: (I am vacationing in Laramie, Wyoming when this occurred) On the evening of July 15th around 8pm, I looked up into the sky (above) and noticed a HUGE BRIGHT LIGHT--It was shaped like a I. (Like a line in the sky).I thought it was the moon--because it was so bright, but it was only an object (stationary) in the sky--to my eyes, it was shaped like an I. thats what it looked like, a very bright, very large I in the sky. I watched it for about 30 minutes, my adult daughter saw it as well from a different area of town. It completely disappeared after about 30 minutes. Just vanished.

summary: Brightly lit object stationary in the sky for 2-3 minutes, during recording my camera failed and shut off
description:
Easiest for me to do is cut copy and paste this from my social media account
First let me start with a couple of things about me; I have been a fulltime paramedic for going on 30 years and for the past 7 years a paramedic field supervisor, locally in the Tampa Bay area.
Why do I feel this is worth mentioning? Training.
I am trained to objectively observe things, several things at once in a high impact stressful environment. Patient condition and much much more. I have also been trained in investigations, being a supervisor a lot of times I must gather evidence, data, testimony and more to handle incidents or situations with our staff or the public. In all our training we are always reminded to remain objective, gather facts and evidence before concluding anything.
Friday night (7/15/2022) between 7 pm and 730 pm in the evening, I was outside getting the grill ready to fix dinner. Now, I will tell you I live in Florida, just south of the city of Tampa on the Gulf Coast. Near me I have 2 commercial airports; Tampa International, St. Pete / Clearwater International, several small private airfields and then lastly MacDill AFB which is just off to my northwest.
This is Hurricane…

summary: We saw a white dot in the blue sky that stayed still for a prolonged period of time.
description:
Three of us were eating dinner outside after our town's summer festival parade on July 15, 2022, and we saw a bright, white dot just staying still high in the sky just about overhead, but a bit toward the east. It did appear to move southerly, but just very, very slowly, and not like it was being blown by the wind. We were curious about it enough to want to get home to see if we could see it with a telescope, but by the time we got home, we couldn't see the dot anymore.
When I saw the video of the recent Chinese spy balloon over Montana, I thought it looked like what we saw last summer.

summary: odd light in the sky
description: Notice the small green light above the sun. Taken late afternoon looking due west in Mason City Iowa. Summer of 22. Pic taker says it wasn't visible to the eye-likely due to the glare of the sun.

summary: Awakened by bright light feeling house went on porch saw disk with lights
description: My wife and I had an argument so I went to stay with my parents for the night. I was sleeping on the floor in front of the window unit bc it was summer and hot outside I was awakened with the whole house being bathed in light. my first thought was who is pulling up in the driveway shining that light. I got up to go in the kitchen and try to look outside. The clock on the microwave said 3:33 Am. I looked out the window but couldn't see any vehicles, just solid really bright light. Lights stopped as suddenly as they started . Went to front door opened it to nothing.walked outside stood on porch. It was calm outside. could see the lightning bugs flashing in field across the Rd felt very light breeze blowing across my face really nice summer night/morning. Then I looked up hovering about 15 - 20 ft over house was large disk shaped craft made no noise. I kept looking up to see if I could see the sky past it behind it I couldn't it was that big ,bigger then my parents house. I stood there frozen in awe it had two smaller rings light under the craft. They produced an amber and blue color. Then the rings started to spin and there was a humming not really audible but more like inside my…

summary: Craft was in the shape of a ring. My son called it Sonic’s ring.
description:
We were coming home and my son jumped out of the car as soon as we parked bc he saw something.
I was able to see a shiny object at first but as I was taking pic and video I couldn’t see it anymore. My son (4yo) was able to see it continuously. He called it Sonic’s ring. And he asked afterwards why it didn’t fall.
I would like to hear what experts in this field thinks. I am not a UFO enthusiast and would be happy to hear that this can be identified.
I googled possible explanations. The space station came up but didn’t cross at this time and the shape does not match.
Curious to your thoughts.

summary: Stationary white oval with tail
description: Driving Northbound on South Holiday Road while pausing for traffic at a stop sign, we looked outside our driver left window to the West and saw a white stationary oval object the size of an SUV that looked like it had a tail or streamers coming out of the back. We noticed that the object was blurry and out of focus compared to the surrounding clouds and trees. Once we passed a building that blocked our view for a moment, the object had disappeared.

summary: All the stars moved so fast that we got scared then the usaf followed them
description: The stars moved like 500 mph

summary: Very bright bouncing sphere. Illuminating the clouds and sky.. slow moving
description:
I just happened to see this on the video feed for my Ring camera. At first I thought is was the street light until I saw the night sky light up and the wispy clouds in the air were illuminated with the slow passing of the bright light.
It’s movements were like a drone in that it went up/ down and side to side very slowly, almost in a grid pattern.
I watched this intermittently on Ring video from 3:25 am- 4:40 am. The object left my cameras viewpoint, towards the west.
This was NOT an airplane. I’m no longer skeptical about UFO’s.

summary: Strange big light object appeared in the sky and sat there just kind of tilted.
description: I was outside waiting on my DoorDash order and suddenly a very bright light began shining, brighter and bigger than anything like a star, it didn't even look like a star. I was so amazed I ran inside to grab my binoculars and phone but when I came back it was gone, but about 5 minutes later it appeared again... I do mean appeared, not flew back, it just appeared again and it was very silent. I looked through my binoculars and a saw something that looked like a spinning top only the bottom was slightly flatter but that's what it looked like, and it also had a little that continuously circled the craft and would change colors. At that point, I grabbed my phone and started recording.

summary: Saw a bright unblinking light going above my house and the light was changing colors
description: It was a circle shape and not loud

summary: Very unusual craft traveling w-se no sound whatsoever
description: I was sitting outside on my porch. I always watch the sky stars aircraft etc. from the west I notice two red flashing lights at first I was betting in my head it was a rescue helicopter or the sort due to speed. The very unusual thing was as it moved across the sky, I clearly saw that the lights were kind of Atari ponging back and forth yet a large space between said lights. It was the fact as it approached closer and even clearer the lack of any noise is what really got me thinking hmmmm. Not sure if this would qualify. Also an unusual flight path if it is domestic. I watch and listen to my surroundings, kind of “stop to smell the roses” type of nature thing,

summary: At approximately 10:30pm on 7/14 i noticed 4 oval shaped lights hovering about 150ft above the park at the end of my street. They were extremely bright. A bright light came out of the bottom of one…
Many lights appeared behind my house and other homes in the neighborhood after an orb appeared in the sky the night before.
description: My friend and I were in my backyard late one night and observed an orb low in the sky, we got a telescope to try and see details, the orb was so bright we could not look at it through the telescope. The next night we observed hundreds of tiny lights in the 2 trees behind my house later in the evening a plane (we assumed was a police plane as it had red and green lights) flew low over the house followed by a helicopter and then 3 police drones, the drones hovered in the area my friend and I observed the orb. This continued every evening throughout the summer. I was curious as to the reason for the drone surveillance and what the tiny lights were, so I installed video cameras that soon recorded many strange occurrences as well as beings that seemed to take the shape of their surroundings. The beings seem to be the lights that we have observed all summer. When the leaves on the trees started to fall and the foliage was no longer in the back yard we saw less of the lights in that area, but the camera in the front part of the house had started to record or snap pics of odd things, things that appear to be beings but take the shape as their surrounds as well as the lights we had seen in…

summary: Saw three lights in triangle shape shoot across sky
description: I was sitting in my backyard (white city sk) and saw three lights in triangle shape (solid light not strobing like normal aircrafts) shoot across the sky at insane speed. Comparable to a shooting star in speed maybe a bit slower but not by much. Saw the same thing in regina sk a few days later maybe two or three days. No sounds or anything.

description: We seen this craft in the north and went by to south .No noise ,no exaust ,no lights.im resending this as i cant find it in my sent mails.It apeared translucent and sorrta glowed ..The sun was set and there was no wind as the bush is very quite . At home we seen an orb infront of craft .We watched for close to 20mins and was gone . 48,08'60.00n -80' 01.60.00

summary: Bright orb in the eastern sky, moving incredibly fast.
description:
My neighbor (Jean Smith) and I were outside talking when a bright orb caught my eye. I immediately pointed it out to my neighbor and I began recording. This was not an airplane or satellite. The sky shows a couple airplanes far off in the distance. This craft wasn't binking nor was there any engine noise. It was moving in a smooth direction but every few seconds it would jerk. Almost looked like I was seeing a "glitch." Not like a anything I've ever seen. Just odd how it was rotating and moving. The craft was incredibly bright, it was oval shaped and was rotating, making it look round at first until you fixed your sight better on the object.
I have two videos. I attempted to move myself to get a better view on the other side of the pine tree. I followed the object until it flew behind a nearby hill.
I had another sighting in late November 2021 around 8:00pm. I again was talking outside with the same neighbor when I saw a green ball off light swoop down and vanish. I didn't know to report it. Tonight, she admitted, she also seen green orbs not long ago.
Feel free to contact me if you should have any questions.

summary: Flying bright white light, no visible structure, no sound
description: Steady bead of white light moved in an arcing trajectory from west to east. It seemed to continue straight east over the North Atlantic Ocean. It didn’t make any strange movements, and there was no noise. It was just a bright white light that didn’t change shape, no sound, and there were no colored, blinking lights. Estimated height unknown- 20,000 to 40,000 feet?

summary: Saw a star shaped craft floating like a feather and gliding across the sky towards the airport probably 400-500’ in the air
description:
Craft was star shaped with 7-8 points
Craft was behaving oddly and waving back and forth like it was on water as it traveled across the skyline of seattle. My neighbors and I saw it. I took a video with the only camera I had available. This is the second time I’ve seen it since April. Last time I did not have my phone.

summary: Dark Gray Mass Over Southern California
description: Out for a walk, heading east. I am a bit of a skywatcher and a couple of lights had caught my attention. On the second light, a dark fuzzy object popped out from the darkness. It was about 60 degrees up and I estimate about 1 1/2 miles away. It had no lights. Gray and hazy with no discernable edges. An out-of-focus Brillo pad wrapped in yarn would be one way to describe it. About the size of a 3 bedroom house and traveling around 300 mph. It flew from west to the east in a straight line with some up and down variation. My sighting was brief, but I got a real good look before it scooted off into the night.

summary: It was an aura surrounding a light with a flashing light following behind it
description:
It was a glowing cloud behind a flashing light and it looked like there was a spotlight all over the cloud but more specifically from the light. It was moving in downward/ side ways across the sky.
Nufroc note: Rocket launch

summary: Round silent white traveling west to east flying erratically leaving smoke trail.
description:
Same as summary
Rocket launch

summary: Strange cloud formation and an object flying out from it moving very slow
description: I have 2 videos of something flying in the sky tonight which was leaving a strange cloud like formation behind it.

description: I saw a bright white object with a small fire like trail behind it. After recording the uap, I turned around and saw an unusual jet stream in the sky so I recorded it. I then noticed afterwards that there was a funny shaped cloud hovering around other clouds slightly moving left and right. I took the video recording of the cloud and edited the video cropping it and re-recorded it in slow motion and you can see a small disc like object circle up and then around the fake cloud and go underneath It was moving at a very high rate of speed going under the.fake cloud,

summary: Steady green light hovering 1-2 min, change to red bright, intense, 1 min then green, 6 degree west 2 sec hover E original fade south
description: Looking South at appx 8:20 PM on July 14th 2022 I noticed a bright green light at about 25 degree elevation from my location. There were no flashing light white or red and light source was steadily hovering. Light moved slightly east and then back west to original location. 3 to 4 minutes elapsed. Green light turned Deep Dark Red for 2 minutes then changed back to green. Light moved West 6 to 7 degrees in 1 second, hovered 1 to 2 minutes. Green light moved back close to original and proceeded to move in southern direction and became faint into storm clouds when it became un-seable. This was not a commercial craft or balloon. Military background Avionic Instrument Systems. Monsoon moving through the area but clear line of sight as noted above. No aircraft in skies until UFO was out of sight.

summary: We sat in a hut having a smoke and chat, I suddenly stopped and said look at that!
description: Myself and 2 other friends were sat in a hut where we ride our mountain bikes i suddenly stopped the conversation by saying look at that! We all stepped outside and looked into the blue sky to see a disked shaped object but appeared to change shape on video to a pointed object at a single point but maybe that was just the angle of what it tilted to and maybe deep blue in colour and when the sun hit the edge of the object it looked diamond blue in colour. It looked kind of out of control but so high up in the sky, when it tilted to its side it looked kind of like a deep bottle cap if you can imagine that? But from underneath it looked as if it either has a hole in the middle or had a blue light underneath at one point it flashed from the very middle of it an electric blue colour from top to bottom of the object and my friend also mentioned that it had a red Ora around it what we could not see on camera other than a slight white Ora. We watched the single object for around 40 seconds capturing 29 seconds of it on video before loosing sight of it we was all stunned to what we saw and couldn’t make our minds up about it.

summary: Figure over South Norwalk
description:
On balcony facing West, saw figure in sky floating over the buildings then proceeded to get higher on an angle until it disappeared.
Likely balloon

summary: Saw a very bright light coming from toward the river
description: I first saw and extremely bright light that was coming toward my home . It was moving faster than anything I'd ever seen and as it came over my house I could see a tube looking thing in front of the bright light , it had swirls of light blue and dark blue color like liquid in it. No sound at all going in the straitest line I'd ever seen brightest light behind it I'd ever seen . The tube looking thing looked to be about 50 ft or so not that long , the light almost looked like a star on the back end of it and there was a strait white trail behind it that stayed there after it passed for a long time that looked like light not smoke like a plane and it finally disapated.

summary: UFO flies up to Blue Angel Jet during Air show practice
description: Was at Willow Run Airport (YIP) filming the Blue Angels practicing for the Air Show, and due to it being bright outside i didnt notice it until after i had gone over the footage. You can see in the video at the time of filming i noticed something dart away from the aircraft and tried to follow it but just figured it was a glare or something. Once i broke the video down frame by frame you can tell the object approaches the plane (above the plane) then hovers and slightly dips down, then darts up and towards the NE. I've been in aviation about 10 years and have worked as an aircraft operations lead for a charter operator, i'm very well aware of aircraft and aviation as a whole. I'm also a skeptic myself, but this one i cannot explain.

summary: Red light moving
description: We were sitting on the back porch over-looking the ocean when a red light appeared out of nowhere, moved toward the coast and got much larger as it approached land. It moved from east to west and as it got to its largest point, I decided to record and it completely disappeared instantly. This was NOT a plane. It was about 3 to 4 times larger than a bright star and was approximately a mile or 2 away. It was above the horizon and I would guess under 5000' .

summary: A long string of star size lights
description:
I was outside when I notices a string of lights about the size of medium stars traveling across the night sky in perfect straight line formation from south east to north west. They were mostly single lights evenly spaced apart but some seemed to have an extra one close by.
The lights were white and not flashing. There was no noticeable sound. the entire length covered most of the visible sky.

summary: Golden Geometrical cube rotating in the sky for long period of time, looked 3D
description: We were on a family vacation and staying at the hot springs in Moffat, CO in a yurt facing the Sangre De Christo Mountains. I awoke in the middle of the night in the yurt with a glass top at the center of the roof. As I opened my eyes I saw this golden geometrical cube rotating or spinning in the sky. I layed awake for a long time just watching it, it was there for at least an hour. I drifted back off to sleep before it disappeared.

summary: It looked like a star, but the stars don't shine that hard
description: on the night of 7/13/22 to 7/14/22 at 2 o'clock when I was going to sleep I noticed through the window on the stairs that something was glittering in the sky, it did not look like a star because the stars shone all the way around, the sky was clear. I thought that I would take a picture with the phone and see if the phone catches something. I took 2 photos, one and a second later. On one of them you can even see the captured top in the afterglow and the neighbor's window to compare the quality of the photos with. Only today, when I sat down to the computer and checked the photos, it looks very strange after approximation and I have no idea what it is. The photos have not been processed and are sent straight from my phone

summary: Changing pinkish white geometric orb
description:
I was up late and went out to walk the dog, I looked up and saw a light first then it brightened and moved real fast to the left and the changed. I watched for about 5 minutes then decided to record it.
The dog wanted back in so I went back in the house.

summary: Triangular bright changing shape and color
description:
Bright triangular object with 2 projecting lights. No stars visible that night. Changed to white ball shape. Moved up and down. Became stationary with glowing red then blue and green.
Present again tonight.

summary: I was out taking photos of the Milky Way as I do on most clear nights when bright flashes appeared in the sky
description: I am a photographer who spends most clear nights capturing the Milky Way. I have over a decade of experience of astrophotography and can easily identify passing satellites which are so numerous these days it’s hard to get a good photo without them. I was taking a long exposure of roughly 13 seconds, and at about 2 or 3 seconds into the exposure a bright flash appeared within the frame, about 10 seconds later it flashed again. Upon closer inspection the bright light seemed to traverse across the sky an incredible distance passing behind or in front of a passing satellite almost as if it was swimming through the sky. It did not follow a straight path. In the image captured you can in fact see several satellites. I have had several other encounters over the years, some closer than others. Some have claimed it to be a firefly. I am sure it wasn’t.

summary: Back garden look up and saw bright light
description: This was very bright and perfect circle with a shimmer of light around it ,it moved quite fast about 500 miles an hour and was not long after a plane had gone past an the same route and it had no sound at all

summary: A glowing object moving around off the coast of New Smyrna beach
description: My daughter Catherine Hope Steele sent this to me around midnight. She was looking out from the beach towards the ocean on New Smyrna Beach last night and saw this. There are a few lights blinking to the right of the film. In my opinion they are aircraft heading to an airport or Cape Canaveral. But, to the left is a bright object that seems to glow and move strangely. My thought is that it could be a drone filming the storm. There’s supposed to be a SpaceX launch tonight or tomorrow so it could be someone testing out the drone camera. It just doesn’t seem to act like a drone though, and it glows. That concerns me. Would you be able to review the video and let me know what you think please? It would give us peace of mind if it’s just a drone.

summary: We were driving home and at first we thought it was a plane upon getting closer we both observed the object litteraly hovering
description: We were driving home right when we got to the graveyard we seen what looked to be a plane upon getting closer both me and the person whom was driving noticed that it was hovering still we went to the red light and turned around to come back for a second look and we noticed it getting significantly lower before disappearing into the trees

summary: While watching a large thunderstorm an oval disk shaped craft was illuminated against the clouds it floated up and right and disapeared
description: I saw 1 craft back lit against clouds, it had such an interesting way of moving through the air, like it was floating but against the wind and without rotation vibration or any sign of movement. It loomed over me about a half kilometer ahead of me before floating up and right and with the same unfathamable speed it appeared it darted off. The way it moved was like space bent around it and it could go wherever it needed. I feel crazy because it looked exactly like every descriptor I've heard about ufo's since I was a kid. There was no lights or tiny green men, it was smooth, like perfectly smooth, while looking like the byproduct if a football that mated with a discus.

summary: 2 Lights hovering, moving after short period
description: Returning from evening fishing trip on Lake of Menteith driving on A873. Two white/yellow orbs stationary above high ground between Stirling and Gargunnock, smaller & duller light descended slowly down behind ridge line never reappeared, around 60 seconds later the second began flashing, lights changing colour/flashing similar to a mirror reflecting the sun. Began moving slowly in westerly direction following ridge line before dropping behind and out of sight. Shape only visible on second object, similar to a rugby ball.

summary: Two times in 45 seconds
description: I was on my pool and looked up and I saw a red/green spherical object on my roof for around 15 seconds and disappear but one minute later the spherical object comeback and stopped on top of my house for 20 seconds and then disappeared.

summary: Looking up saw light flying across sky and over my house
description: Light flew over my house. I live next to a airport and planes fly over my house multiple times a night. This light made no sound and just went across the sky and had a haze in triangle form. Definitely was not a plane or helicopter.

summary: Hovering Light
description: Really Bright Light off Pryor Creek and White Buffalo Rd.

summary: Two UFO’s flew past each other in opposite directions.
description:
This evening around 8:30 pm cst, my eighteen year old daughter, my fourteen year old son and myself were standing on our deck when I noticed something shining in the sky. We saw two shiny, white, oval shaped UFO’s flying over us in opposite directions. One was flying to the west and the other to the east. After the two UFO’s passed each other, a jet with a smoke trail, flew into the path of the UFO’s. The jet was flying more towards the south.
The sky was clear, no clouds were obstructing our view. We did not hear any sound coming from the UFO’s. We took a picture with an iPhone but it’s not a clear picture. The UFO’s disappeared after a few minutes.

summary: Leaving store noticed beautiful sky, loaded groceries, driving in car looked at sky again, saw sphere at high alt., recorded it.
description:
After having had a few days in a row of summer high heat, rain, & high humidity, yesterday was a nice and unusually low humidity day.
After grocery shopping for a couple hours we left Walmart near 8:00 pm. With the unobstructed view from the parking lot I noticed the beautiful sky while walking to my car.
It was near dusk. The sky was a clear blue (usually low humidity for us here), the few clouds in the sky were very high (for here) and were wispy and pink, due to being near dusk.
After loading the groceries I stole one minute to myself and deeply took in the beauty of the sky. Got into the car to drive away and while still in the parking lot looked again at the sky. I noticed an odd object and asked the person with me to look at it and ask.what it was. They didn't have a clue. Then it dawned on me I had my phone to video it. I did so, fearing I'd miss it. But I didn't. I got it as it crossed a pink wispy cloud. It was very high in the sky at a great distance from me but it must have been large for me to be able to see it so clearly. It did not seem like a plane to us. My video is only 11 seconds. I stopped filming when I thought it had disappeared. But later when I cast the…

summary: Bright light suddenly appears above commercial plane
description:
I was sitting on my back deck watching a commercial plane in the distance. As I was watching the plane, a bright light suddenly appeared out of nowhere right above the plane. It hovered above the plane between the wing and the tail section. It just hung there in the sky for four seconds and then flew off, very fast, in the opposite direction from the plane. It flew for two seconds and just vanished. It was daylight, clear skies no clouds. It flew faster than the plane.
PS: if you do contact me by phone, and if I miss your call, please leave a message and I will return your call. Thank you.

summary: We saw a disk shaped object clearly leave Mt Baker and disappear straight up
description: My 10 year old son and I were on our balcony looking at Mt Baker which we have a clear and unobstructed view of and we saw a disk shaped object slowly go up above Mt Baker unit it disappeared straight up. We were watching the mountain and preparing to watch the full moon and this was amazing. Disk like grey in colour very clearly visible. By the time we figured out what was happening and I took my camera out it was gone

summary: VERY FAST whoosh that was heard and also felt/sensed
description:
Five of us, ages 20 - 79 were sitting around a campfire. Weather was clear and no wind, about 70 degrees. Sun still fairly high.
There was a medium loud, EXTREMELY FAST huge whoosh from west to east over us. We experienced/felt a sensation (energy/air?)..
At first, we just looked at each other in shocked disbelief, then out loud to each other "did you hear that?".
Our mixed breed dog immediately ran to the east then back to us very fast with all hair on her back and neck standing on end, She was obviously freaked out. Twenty-year-old Ethan happened to be already looking up at that moment and saw two objects flying side by side, shinny metallic, about 2-3 feet wide and 4-6 feet long, about 100 feet in the air. Because of the speed, he said it was actually a blur, but this is his best description. The rest of us saw nothing as we looked the direction it was going, and there was no visible tail.
Note: none of us were predisposed to believe in UFOs, but probably not 100% disbelievers either,

summary: Distant, grey object that was at least circular frozen in air for short duration until it flew off extremely quickly.
description: I was outside in the summer in my backyard. It's been a while, so I'm most likely misremembering the date, but I know it was around 1 p.m. or so. I was just bored as heck, standing around and sitting in a swing-chair, until I walked across my backyard to where I can see above a nearby neighborhood and the trees, where I saw a fairly distant (a few miles most likely) grey, mostly flat object that had what looked like a dome, but it seemed to be at an angle pointing a bit towards me but not entirely. I've good distance vision despite bad eyesight, and I saw it stay still for half a minute, but caught it flying off due west so quickly that it was a blur. I wish it was a tad closer for more detail, but I assume it was there for longer before I looked at it. I've no idea, but I soon went inside while just trying to not acknowledge it.

summary: My friend and I were star gazing and saw a white egg zip across the sky in a 3/4 of a rectangle movement.It zipped away after that.
description: I was star gazing when I saw a white egg like thing come from the west start a nosedive,pull out of the nosedive and go west,then point up at the sky and go upwards then gain at least 500 mph in speed in the blink of an eye,head west and then it disappeared.

summary: I was out side late at night about the same place the encounter took place
description: Stacy Sellers and Ellen Sellers This is the 2 time I saw these lights I lost 10 to 15 minutes of time I black out after the same white light touched the ground I have this cut mark on my leg it was a green light and 3 red lights it seems like it's following me .

duration: In my view for ten minute
summary: 2 orbs, one higher up, both alternating flashing bright white light in 2 second intervals
description: Clear blue sky, other aircraft in area of planes at their level and jets much higher up. Orbs about helicopter size. They stayed in the same spot without wind shifting them or their movement. Unusual to see in this air space. I took a phone photo. They vanished instantly from same spot. Have lived here for 2 years. Odd stuff.

summary: All metal disc with blue light. After some seconds it just teleported ahead within a second.
description: I could be either dehydrated or I saw what I saw. Usual AM PT. Ending with 15 sec sprints for 5 mins. While doing breathing exercises with some stretching I lookup above the trees is a disc shaped drone. Well I thought it was a drone. But it’s way too big to be a drone and it’s circle with no fans or propellers. And no sound. I stared at it for a few seconds then this blue light turned on from the disc then shot away in a blink of eye. No fire or rocket booster visible. I panicked no way that just happened. My Apple Watch has a high bpm but I’m running so that’s normal. I’m confused and it doesn’t make any sense. Distance I would say probably not close enough to throw a rock at it but definitely close enough to fire at it with any Glock or AR. Color I would say silver or the special gray they use to paint Navy warships with. Time of day was early morning as the night is leaving and the sun has arrived and along with nature animals communicate with each other.

summary: A very bright and constant light in the northern night sky silently moved east and then south before trees blocked view.
description: I went outside for a cigarette just after 4 AM this morning after my young nephews who are visiting decided they couldn't sleep anymore. I immediately noticed a very bright and constant light (much brighter than Venus) low in the sky to the north. It appeared to be silently moving east for several miles from my perspective, but then moved south several more miles before my house and a tall grove of trees blocked my view. summary: Five or six "stars" dancing/chasing each other in a circle.
description:
At about 10:30 PM, Friday, July 1st, I walked out onto our balcony and immediately saw in the eastern sky five or six "stars" dancing/circling around each other.
My brother had followed me onto the balcony and heard me exclaim, "Holy s..., look at that!" I then reached for a pair of binoculars on the balcony table, and when I turned back to see them again they had disappeared. My brother said he saw them just before they disappeared and described them the same as what I saw.
The objects emitted no sound, and the sighting only lasted for about 3 seconds. They looked exactly like stars - the same size and brightness - but they were all moving around each other in a small section of the sky, in the area between the two actual stars of Altair and Tarazed.
Though I've read other people's reports detailing similar sightings, neither my brother nor I have ever seen anything like it. It was a shocking and incredible thing to see, and I wish I hadn't taken my eyes off it to grab the binoculars.

summary: Pilot observed two spherical shaped objects flying in formation below aircraft

I am an FAA licensed private pilot. On June 26th, 2022 I was flying with my girlfriend from Sioux Falls, SD (KFSD) to Fargo, ND (KFAR). Roughly an hour and twenty minutes into the flight, I looked out the left side of the aircraft and observed two spherical shaped objects flying in formation below and to the left of my aircraft. The objects were either reflecting light or glowing white in color. At first I figured they were other aircraft, however we were only flying at 3,000ft MSL and the objects appeared roughly 500ft below us. At this altitude and in my experience aircraft and birds are easily distinguishable. I highly doubt that they were drones because I do not think I would have been able to see them, nor would I expect them to reflect light. As I continued to watch the objects they made a coordinated right hand turn (from the perspective of the objects) and soon disappeared from my sight. I made mention of these objects while I was watching them to my girlfriend, who claims she did not see them at first but did see them before they disappeared.
The time and location provided is an estimation, but in the general area.

description: On Monday June 20th I was taking a break from work and laying on my deck. I saw a spherical metal looking obj fly fairly quickly and got covered by the roof of my house. I pulled out camera and started recording while still looking at the sky with my eyes. I noticed one more moving steadily and it also disappeared from sight when passing over my roof. When reviewing the video right after the first object flys by two other similar shaped faster objects also zoom by glittering in the sun and can be seen by slowing down video. I’ve attached a 3 second video and another where I tried to slow it down. I only saw the first one (going from bottoms right to left ) in the video with my eyes. If you have other questions please reach out.

summary: silver egg flies through the morning sky + disappears.
description: On my way to work this morning, I looked N/NE while driving and saw what first looked like a bright light (brighter than a satellite but dimmer than Venus), but that seemed like a reflection of the sun. I say that because the light transitioned into a silver/metallic egg shape. In the next second, it just disappeared. almost like it flew behind a blue curtain in the sky. it wasn’t a zap or a blink…it’s like it went into an invisible hole.

summary: Walking Dog when I saw this...was not a plane or helicopter for sure as it had alot of lights...some changed color and it would just go back n forth about 5 miles. Went in to get my phone to video n…
Moving, roving cylindrical lights moving toward the camera and yard.
description: Have a home surveillance camera in the backyard and saw a series of detected motion videos around 1:15am Central Time in MIchigan which consisted of lights hovering around the camera and jerking around the backyard. They were seen coming toward the camera and then hovering around the yard. Very strange...never saw anything like it on the camera video before. The motion events of the lights kept triggering the camera for about 15 minutes. Videos are attached. You can see small lights and also, a very large blurry round shaped light on the very first video.

summary: Fast moving agile lights seen over Worlds of Fun.
description: We saw the lights watching for shooting stars. Seems to have central white light with 3 red light around it. Moving very fast but close making eratic swinging patterns and dives sometimes disappearing for several seconds. A car alarm went off shortly after no one was around and no one ever shut off the blinking lights but it stopped honking in ~10 seconds. A second identical object was spotted close by but they were not in sync.

summary: See my video
description: Object was not moving for about 2-3 minutes, so I pulled on the shoulder of the road and filmed, then it took off at a high rate of speed. I had to start driving to try and follow, but could not catch up to it.

summary: 4 lights on the top of the mountain
description: We always arrive home at night later work, but today we just saw 4 lights that we never see before, and we stayed for around 40 minutes watching them. we enter home and 15 minutes later I go outside again and the ligths still there.

summary: Very fast moving ball of light
description: Driving on the parkway near the Driscoll Bridge. Noticed a very fast ball of white light fly through the sky lower than any aircraft and faster than any aircraft I know of. It then disappeared into clouds heading east towards the ocean. I tried to debunk it as I was heading south, but nothing comes to mind. It left no trail, unknown for a noise and moved too low and fast for an airplane

summary: Very bright, lined-up white lights, and fast-blinking red light, moving slowly southbound along I-85, that disappeared when passed
description: I was travelling along Interstate 85 southbound, between exits 6 and 13, when I came across a a group of very bright lights in the sky, unlike anything I've seen on any kind of man-made aircraft. The lights appeared to be moving southbound, several hundred to several thousand feet in the air, as I was able to gradually catch up to, and pass them. There were 4 very bright, white LED lights on what appeared to be the rear of the craft, and a very small, fast-blinking red light on the front of the craft, but from my vantage point I could not define a specific shape or form. As stated, I was able to gradually catch up to the group of lights, and even passed them as I approached exit 6. They appeared to be on the eastern side of the interstate, above a wooded area across Kia Blvd from the Kia factory in West Point. I pulled off on exit 6, and pulled into an abandoned neighborhood development on Kia Blvd to get a clear view. While I was stopped at the red light on the exit ramp, the lights never passed me again. After I stopped, I got out of my car and looked around, and the lights were gone. They had literally vanished into thin air. I called a friend of mine who works with me at…

summary: Object pictured appeared on unmonitored camera; is it anomalous or an airplane?
description: One object entered and left an "unmanned" camera frame across four seconds, moving left to right. Its aspect or viewing angle remained the same throughout. It had two "headlights" which always faced the same direction towards the camera, and a single blinking light on its base. There was no apparent change in size to suggest advance or retreat, and it moved in the direction it was pointed. The seeming downward movement is misleading; the camera was facing about 85 degrees upward, so it was traversing the sky in a slightly curved fashion. No distance estimates are possible.

summary: An upfacing infrared camera captured an object moving from screen left to right about 5 seconds after another previously posted
description: An infrared camera faced upwards captured an object moving from screen left to right. The four screenshots show that it seems to change shape, but it is more likely rotating as it moves left to right in the direction pointed. The third screen shot seems the best or clearest to me. This appeared about 5 seconds after another object, previously posted at NUFORC, had crossed the screen in about 4 seconds while maintaining the same appearrance throughout.

summary: 7-8 round mostly stationary, quick moving lights clustered and performing different formations
description: I was traveling southbound over the Whitestone bridge in queens headed toward longisland and saw in the western part of the sky 6-8 round very bright objects. They were stationary in the sky and not moving, then would form a different formation in the blink of an eye. One was caught moving diagonally as well. They were clustered very close for a period of time.

summary: MADAR site 192, 28 mi east of McKees Rocks had magnetometer spikes, plus compass change.
Silver object came out of the north and crossed overhead.
description: Witness had been laying on a lounge chair for quite a while looking at the sky and watching airplanes fly by when suddenly a silver object coming from the north crossed overhead. It was moving at a similar speed and height as the planes that fly by as they approach the airport. However, it appeared much smaller than a passenger aircraft. There was no sound and it looked very silvery white in color and appeared to be oval shaped. However, witness could not discern a definite shape and doesn't know if it was some sort of balloon, but it appeared to be moving at a steady pace and a steady trajectory and not floating. Witness had to stand up in the middle of the video to continue watching it beyond the tree and it was quickly out of sight within a few seconds. Witness doesn't know what it was but I thought it was worth sharing with somebody who might be able to figure it out. (MUFON)

summary: Looked up saw flash took pics and captured cylinder which I didn't see at first
description: Saw flash that caught my attention looking up and to the east , while attempting to capture first object I caught 2nd one that appears to be a dark cylinder I have pics of both.

summary: After viewing photos several days later, 2 separate unknown shape were seen in the photos when zooming in.
Caught on security cameras
description: White light that leaves hole in sky. Will attach pictures and video

summary: 3 green lights noticed after photo was taken
description:
Taking photo of mountain in morning.
Didn’t notice until forwarding photo to someone else.

summary: Extremely bright spherical object crossed southern sky.
description:
At approximately 5:15 am CST a bright glowing spherical object crossed the southern sky fom west to east at high rate of speed. Then just disappeared, covering roughly half the distance of the southern horizon. Roughly in same visual plane as the moon.
Latitude 36.546108
Longitude -95.382622
I was walking out to car to go to work and looked upto look at the moon, and saw a very bright sphere white light traverse the southern sky in a straight line. I called out to my wife who stepped out further into the driveway and she saw it as well.
The object appeared to have a slightly magnetic like side to side movement to it.it was very bright, then just disappeared like someone turned out a light switch.
It did not look like a meteor or airplane. No trailing line of light or blinking lights. No aircraft visible in the vicinity at the time.

summary: Was a light with a mist, no blinking as it moved slowly the light got brighter until it starburst and then mist spread, formed smoke
description: We were fishing when it showed up in west direction. Moved 10 to 15 min until it finished with the starburst, then smoke ring with faint small cloud looking center til it disappeared. My son in law got an image on his phone

summary: Star lookin ufo that left smoke ring over us
description: So my son, mother-in-law and me are outside arguing kinda about my sons music being loud at 2:30 in morning. When my son looks up and sees what he thinks is a star but it looks fuzzy or foggy. He says why’s that star look blurry or foggy. We all 3 looked up and immediately it headed our way, freaked us OUT! So it’s about the distance of maybe a plane at this point. It then turns we see one flash of white light and then a perfect circle of smoke or fog starts to fall towards us and by this time my husband is out on porch because I started yelling for him because we 3 were already terrified at this point, and he sees this ring in sky as it’s falling and getting larger then fades away and the object (ufo) just kept moving on until out of site still with this weird haze over it. Also there were no engine noises at all! Sadly our videos couldn’t pick anything up but we got one pic of it when it was heading out of view. Barely can see it but it’s there.

summary: We saw a ring of light in the sky coming from an object far away
description: We were sitting around the campfire when I looked up and said, “what is that in the sky?” We all saw a ring of light that looked like it was coming from some sort of glowing object in the sky. The ring of light looked like a round cloud at first that was hollow in the middle. The glowing object started to move and the ring of light followed it. As the glowing object in the distance started to move, the ring of light in the sky shifted with it and looked more like an oval. Then, quickly, seemed to retract into space, because it just got farther away until it disappeared from our sight. My cousin’s husband works in the aircraft industry and he said it wasn’t a plane or a helicopter, but hadn’t seen anything like it before. He also said that there were no flight paths scheduled above us at that time of the early morning. My cousin, her husband and I all drew a picture of what we saw because we were all so confused and had never seen anything like it. We each drew our own description away from each other so we couldn’t see each others drawing. I’m attaching it to this report.

summary: Sighting of a star-like object emitting clouds
description: The sighting began with a lit cloud that eventually expanded into a large ring in the sky. From the ring came an object that resembled a star. As the object flew across the sky, it appeared to emit clouds on a regular basis before disappearing behind trees.

summary: Something that looked like a comet but left a ring in the sky
description: From my house, in a roughly northwesterly direction, I saw an object that left a plume behind it, similar to a comet, traverse roughly 1/3 of the night sky in 3-4 minutes. It left a glowing ring behind it that expanded and dissipated during the sighting. It had no blinking lights. It appeared to be very high in the sky. After checking a flight tracker, there are no planes in the vicinity.

summary: Viewed a ring shaped object moving north for about 3 minutes.
description:
My 14 year old son saw this ring shaped object from his window for about 3 minutes. He said it moved slowly without any sound. The two photos were taken by him on his Apple iphone without any filter or apps. We believe him 100 percent and has no reason to lie about this.
SpaceX

summary: Light moving across sky leaving smoke circles.
description: A bright light moving across the lower horizon, not appearing to be a plane but something much larger, glowing, and creating smoke and a very large smoke circle in the sky. Visible at night. I was only able to get a halfway decent photo as the smoke circle was fading. But you can faintly see it behind the glowing object in the photo attached.

summary: A light moving west to east enveloped in a cloud. There were zero clouds elsewhere in the sky and I had been looking at the stars cle
description: I had been looking at the stars clearly....there were zero clouds. This light was enveloped in a cloud. I had been watching for a minute or so and it let out another cloud which became doughnut shaped. This cloud became bigger and looked like it was lowering like a funnel...? I began to get scared and called for my friend in the house. It took a couple minutes for him to get outside and in that time, the funnel/lowering part stopped and the cloud became just a doughnut shape. The light had slowed down while the funnel thing was happening but once the funnel stopped, it went back to what seemed to be the same speed, travelling east with the cloud still around it. My friend saw the doughnut cloud and the light with the cloud. We both looked at the light with binoculars but it looked as if it were just a light with a cloud around it. It continued east, travelling with the cloud around it until we couldn't see it anymore. The doughnut cloud just dissipated into nothing and again the sky was cloudless. Also throughout the entire time, there was no sound. I was not sleepy or tired as the neighbors had had a very loud party and it kept me awake. I didn't really freak out about until the…

summary: Saw a ufo
description: It was in the night sky and was moving pretty fast and I thought it was a comet but it looked weird.

summary: Form of energy in the sky that created a continuous circle
description: My son and I was outside enjoying the night sky. We were looking for consolations and noticed a what appeared to be a white Mass object in the sky. The mass object suddenly appeared to suddenly expand into a large circle that was continuously getting larger and larger and was coming toward us. We continue to watch it for about 5 minutes before my son got so scared he started to cry and beg me to go inside to get away from it. After going inside we no longer monitored it. I have watched the night sky throughout my life multiple times and have never witnessed anything like this at night time before ever.

summary: Bright object with light ring trailing it
description: Bright object projecting a ring of light behind it was observed by my wife and I while sitting on the back deck behind our house. The ring and light appeared to move in unison slowly form west to east, and looked like one bright light while dropping over the eastern horizon.

summary: I arrived seconds after sighting
description: You would need to talk to one of the two witnesses to get full details.

summary: Very bright UFO
description: Went outside with two of my family members, we were talking and all of the sudden I looked up in the sky and saw this big bright UFO just park in the night sky above us, when I notice it I quickly yelled at my family members “OMG it’s that an UFO?” Which they instantly looked up and were amazed by it. Right after we all looked up the craft moved very fast leaving giant smoke circles behind it but there was no sound it was so incognito and so strange and very bright. No it wasn’t a comet or an airplane, or a weather balloon, this was definitely some sort of high advanced craft or UFO. I tried to record it but to my luck we have so much light pollution that it was difficult to catch the whole thing even when the craft was very bright. I have never ever seen this thing and I love looking up at night regularly.

summary: looked up at the sky around 1am, the object appeared very bright at first then slowly started to fade away.
description: There was a smaller bright light and a circular light over top of

summary: looked like a bright light behind a V shaped object
description:
Looking S-SW at about 75 degrees up from the horizon. It was moving slowly to the east. The object appeared to be slightly smaller than the size of a full moon. It appeared to be a bright light behind a distinct V shaped object. A cloud started to form above the V. The cloud was lit up by the light emitting from the object. The cloud was moving away from the object, to the north, but it was also moving to the east at the same rate of speed as the object. The bright light and the V shape became dimmer as it moved to the east-south east, but there was a halo effect that was there until the last moments. The cloud dissipated at about the same rate.
I have watched the ISS fly by many times. This was much brighter. The distinct V shape that was visible early on was very interesting.
Could it have been the ISS?

summary: It was a slow moving object that shot off a ring of smoke or mist
description: It was a slow moving object flying west to east like a rocket that shot off a ring of smoke that fell slowly down right over the forest. The ring enlarged as it dissipated. And the object continued slowly across the sky heading eastward.

summary: Triangular flying object moving to the side.
description: I was getting home around 1 am, and noticed what I thought was a plane with its landing lights on. It seemed strange though since it was pretty high up. When I got out of my car I noticed that it wasn't moving in the direction that a plane would if it was using its lights. It was also really high up, and there were no clouds in the sky for the light to be reflecting off of. I tried to take a video with snapchat, but you couldn't see it. I was able to get this picture from my phone's camera. I didn't stay outside to see what it did after the picture was taken. The object was moving down and slightly to the left relative to the picture.

summary: Bright flying object with a smoke ring behind it.
description: We were sitting outside around a bonfire. One of us looked up and saw a haze with a bright light. What looked like a smoke ring formed behind it as it continued to move across the sky. We watched it for almost two minutes. It moved too slow to be a shooting star. It was brighter than anything else in the sky. We also took a picture of it and captured the ring behind it. The photo was taken with a simple cellphone

summary: First appeard exactly like a comet. Then more of slow moving fireball then triangular shape w peominent geometrical smoke plume. w
description: Saw reports on AMS and thought they were loony with an event that was greater that 60 sec. Sure enough I have video from 3 cams and reports were very accurate from ok coty and midlothian tx.

summary: Seemed as though you could see headlights coming off of it, but the beam expanded
description: At first appearing quite small, the beams of lights expanded to a very large scale, seeming to stretch across the constellations in the sky. I took a photo as it began, and tried to take zoomed in photos as it expanded, but camera quality is not the greatest. As it grew larger, my phone camera couldn't quite capture the light being sent out

summary: Green light like fire following craft
description: With my best friend, I saw the green light in the sky appearing closer than a plane. It traveled very fast horizontally across the sky before disappearing behind us beyond the trees. There was some wind and then three very bright white flashes that I couldn't tell if they came from the sky or the ground. It did not move like a plane or drone.

summary: Bright white light round craft moving extremely fast in high altitude west to South. Crossed visual view left to right in 3 minutes
description: Round bright white light entered field of view from West moving east disappearing in front of eyes into a dark looking hole. Were doing fireworks and noticed light moving very fast. High altitude!

summary: Slow moving ball of pulsating light surrounded by fog aura. Changed speed and direction quickly leaving a halo of "exhaust"
description: All three witnesses were immediately drawn to a slow moving ball of light. Despite being a clear cloudless night the object was surrounded by a hazy fog and had alternating or pulsating light. After hovering in the atmosphere the craft grew brighter and with an explosion of light left a ring of fog in it's wake as it moved rapidly across the horizon before changing direction again directly away from Earth. It maintained an aura of fog around it at all times. The halo of exhaust hung in the atmosphere for approximately 15 minutes growing larger and larger as it dissipated.

summary: Star that turned brighter than all the others appear heading North West and a sudden streak that resembled a kind of flame
description: While driving eastbound on I4 about a mile past I75, I watched what appeared to be a very bright star high in the sky suddenly move into a bright orange streak that resembled a torch lighter absorbing the object until they both faded away. No sign of the bright star like object was found after the bright orange and reddish streak disappeared.

summary: While driving east bound witnessed a bright redish, orange glow in north eastern sky, appearing to leave the atmosphere then disappeare
description: Was in vechile traveling eastbound while on cellear divice close to a half an hour past midnight with a friend in front passenger seat to get food. Apon driving to pick up food noticed a oddly colored crimson redish, orange glow that resembled the shape and look of a rocket thruster in North Eastern sky. There was no emissions trail or any smoke. The object created almost like a flaming ball but traveling upward into the night sky, color stayed consistent until it appeared the mass left the atmosphere and literally vanished without a trace.

summary: A small light growing in illumination and size that shot out lights into a rainbow shaped illuminated area.
description:
A oddly illuminated light moved slowly but inconsistently across the sky (bigger than any visible stars or planets) until it started growing in size and illumination.
It then shot out around 20 or more light beams at a 45 degree angle. Then a rainbow shaped slightly dimmer but much larger illumination appeared connecting all the light beams. At this point the whole thing took up about an inch or two of the whole field of view of the sky.
The origin point of the beams lost illumination until it wasn't visible while the rainbow shaped illuminated section persisted but faded consistently for a few minutes until it was gone.
It's worth noting I was sober and working the festival.
I saw it with atleast 7 other crew members and I heard chatter among the 6000+ person crowd throughout the night.

summary: A ufo emitted an array of lights before disappearing.
description: A star like object was seen moving across the sky. The star seems to have a haze around it that moved with the star. After a few minutes it stopped moving and began to shoot what looked like white lazer like lights in a 45 degree pattern. The lights traveled away from the craft and the haze appeared at the end of each beam. After the beams disappeared the haze remained and continue to grow across the sky in a half circle arc. During that time the original star like light faded from the sky. Then eventually the haze also disappeared. Our entire staff witnessed this.

summary: Silent item falling from sky leaving huge cone like trail that took up sky.
description: Friend told me to look to what I believe was the east. There was a fuzzy spot in the night sky and we thought maybe it was the Andromeda galaxy. I quickly noticed the spot was getting bigger. We immediately gasped when we realized this was an object coming toward us. Suddenly multiple people stopped and watched as this point in the sky was coming down at an angle with a huge cone like plume behind it. There did not seem to be a fire trail, no noise, no giant flashes of light. The object itself seemed too just be a small point of dim light. The night was so dark and the light dim to where cameras weren't able to pick it up. We eventually watched as it went behind the mountains and that was it. No noise or anything. The cone plume left behind took up quite a portion of the sky but eventually dissipated.

summary: Glowing craft followed by ring next to it
description: Moving Object with Glowing ring following close by, slowly disappeared into the sky , was moving north east.

summary: Colours changing. Bright in sky. Turquoise,red white,,yellow,green
description: It would move left to right up and down and could hover. Definitely not an helicopter. Definitely not a plane. No beams to show searching. It a clear night. Can hear noise of traffic passing but nothing from object. I had been going for over an hour and a half. I seen planes passing as well as train on the ground. One of the times when it stationary it lasted approx 20 minutes. Most of time though it moves continuously apart from a few minutes of hovering.

summary: The flying object was hovering slowly over Pimpri Chinchwad (Pune). It has no noise at all. Just the lights were flashing in crisscross
description: We were on the roof our building when we saw this flying object. Unfortunately we manage to capture it in the video little late therefore the video is not much clear. This object was flying slowly and had no noise at all just the lights were flashing in crisscross directions. It was there for almost 10 minutes before it goes out of our sight. I observe it doesn't have speed like any other known flying objects. It was weird looking flying object.

summary: Appeared suddenly seemingly out of nowhere.
description: Was with a group of 9 people at Cabin Canyon at approximately 11 pm on 18 June 2022 when this appeared suddenly and seemingly out of nowhere. We were on a night ride in our UTV vehicles. As it moved to the east northeast it left behind a smoke ring which expanded and then dissipated. At first I thought is might be a meteor but it did not move that fast. Undetermined altitude. As it moved it did not seem to gain altitude just distance from its original sighting point. Could have been a launch of a test vehicle but no other vehicle sighted.

summary: I saw two small lights in the sky that moved super fast and did not move in a straight line.
description: Saturday June 18th, a few minutes before 11pm, I was on the balcony of our shore house in Wildwood NJ. I looked up at the stars and saw two ufos. They looked like satellites, just two little dots of light. However, they moved super fast across the sky and did not move in a straight path. They seemed to be chasing each other, almost like insects. They were side by side with one just a little behind the other. I saw them for only a few seconds and then lost them over the water as they faded from view. They were moving southeast. It was a clear night and a little chilly.

summary: Red or orange fire streams darting up down left right very fast and sparatic unlike any aircraft we have can move. Above the ocean.
description: We were sitting in the dark quietly at the beach near the water. We were waiting to spot sea turtles laying there eggs. We happened to look to the left and in the sky was what l can only describe as some sort of craft with red or orange flame like trails coming from it. It didn't move straight. It moved erratically up down left right…all over really. Unlike any aircraft we know about. It was too far to see what kind of craft it came from but it was very bright. Because of the visibility over the ocean it could have been coming from as far as the keys in Florida. We were at the beach in jupiter Florida. We sat in awe and shock and saw it happen 2 other times separately after within the next hour in different spots and distances. All seem to be over the water there and very high up. As high as a plane if not higher. This was not a earth craft and this was not made by nature. Nothing else was in the sky. We even tried to debunk it but the only thing we could come up with that would be similar would be if the military was launching secret rockets over the ocean in Florida during the night. Which doesn't make much sense nor is it discreet. The next day I had itchy bumps all over my…

summary: Saw a green light in sky then seperated to 3 red lights and red light had a white white light shine down to ground and a white being sta
description: Was a green light went to red light seperated into 3 red lights then a white beam came down from red light and a white grey being started walking towards woods. All time stopped to 10 minutes. Speedometer went to 18 mph and all power was stopped. Time stopped and ever since had this sickness of cough can't get rid of and rash on legs.

summary: Fireball object
description: Orange object sighting look like a huge fireball above the sky over LaVergne and also after reviewing our video we also caught a white/clear object that looks like a fairy. Both disappeared at the same time.

summary: Caught on Ring camera and have video of craft coming and going
description: We were having a drink in my basement bar and my neighbor had his Ring Camera alert him with the video I provided. We have no explanation of what we see in this video.

summary: Ball of light changes direction
description: This evening, my husband and I and our 5 year old son were outside of our house playing frisbee when my husband noticed a bright object in the sky. He was able to record it on his phone but it was a very bright ball of white light that seemed to move rapidly through the sky and as he recorded, the object changed direction and made quick sharp turns from left to right and then back to right again. It was a clear night with no clouds and was just after sunset. The object had no blinking lights.

summary: me and my friend were taking a picture of the sunset we seen an cylinder shape object in the picture.
description:
Dear Mr. Davenport,
My friend and I were taking a picture of the beautiful sunset. after we looked at the picture I said "whats that in the picture". we looked at the sky but the sun was in our eyes and couldn't really see anything. So I said take another picture and in your mind invite the alien's to show them selves to us and be with us. Then there was a bright blurry cylinder shape above the sun in the next picture. you could also see a plane coming down to land which is shaded by the sun. Same thing I said do it again and invite the aliens to show us themselves. and again bright blurry cylinder and you can also see the plan in this picture. each picture was taken about 60 seconds apart. The airport is to the north and about 20 km away.

summary: My wife and I saw a rectangular shaped object that was lit up in the night sky.
description: As I was driving eastbound on Bluemound Road my wife and I noticed a rectangular shaped bright object in the twilight sky. It was stationary for several minutes and then abruptly disappeared. It was at a very high elevation. This object was not a helicopter. We frequently see flight for life helicopters landing and taking off from Froedtert Hospital which is in that area. However, this object was different and at a higher elevation than the helicopters we typically see. What surprised us the most was the abrupt disappearance. My wife who is 70 retired from teaching in 2007 and I retired as an Electrical Engineer in 2017. I am 66 years old.

summary: Triangle shaped UFO passing over my apartment.
description: I am not sure if it was a balloon or a UFO, but I first noticed the object in the sky far away and I thought it was a bird. As the object got closer, it look like it was spinning in circles and illuminating in light and then got darker and then brighter again. The object was quiet and moving maybe 10 to 15 mph. It was shaped like a triangle and then stopped spinning in circles when it was approaching over my apartment and continued moving straight. There was no wind and the weather was calm. I believe it did not have the characteristics of a balloon because there was no design on it or a string attached to the object. I have never seen anything like the object I saw. There were no blinking lights too. When I first noticed the object I was stunned and then realized I should try to record the UFO on my phone before it went away.

summary: Orange and green lights. Pillar with a disc in it. Like a metal spear. Seen in our neighbors backyard
description: Seen outside our bedroom window for about three seconds.

summary: 2 shape-shifting objects that stayed together over manhattan.
description: It was a little before 8pm. There was an opener for a concert I was at with some family right on the East River in Lower Manhattan. My father noticed the objects, and at first I thought they were just balloons that someone has released because they were pretty high up. However, the more I looked I realized they were not behaving like balloons. They would light up on all sides and then not at all. They were moving in such a strange manner I cannot even describe. They maintained exact distance and speed heading east until they went into the clouds or got too far away. At one point one lit up all at the same time. It was three perfect circles in a perfect triangle formation. The other one never did this, but it did have the same shape at certain points.

summary: I was just taking a picture of the sunset.
description: I took two pictures of the sunset, one right after the other. The object doesn’t appear in the first picture. The camera wasn’t repositioned. The pictures were taken in direct succession!!! You have to EXPAND the second picture!!

summary: I saw three very bright dots in the sky in the shape of a triangle hovering. A 4th dot appeared and they started rotating into a circle
description:

I was cognizant of the sun's location and was trying to avoid taking shots directly towards it. When photographing with my drone, I almost always use AEB mode (with 5 exposures each), I then merge them in lightroom to produce HDR images. I have at least 3 photos (15 exposures) showing a constellation of triangular shaped bright spots in the sky. They are stationary w/respect to the geography in the photo even though my drone was repostioned between each shot. For this reason I am ruling out optical artifacts and/or sensor noise. I have uploaded 2 of the merged images. These are highly compressed JPG images. The original exposures are all in RAW .dng format. summary: Disc-shaped object moves at high speed at high elevation in the day time.
description: I was filming a flock of American White Pelicans flying high in the sky with a 12x zoom on my Galaxy S21 in "video mode". An object moves across the very narrow field of view at a seemingly higher altitude than the pelicans and at a high speed. For reference, the pelicans were gliding very slowly in the sky. There is a moment in the video where the object crosses paths with one of the pelicans and I am unable to determine whether or not exactly the object is in front of or behind the pelican. The object holds a steady speed and trajectory through the video. The object also makes a left-to-right tilt in orientation, sort of ruling out the possibility of it being a plane. There is a possibility it could be a bee, but if it were a bee wouldn't it appear much blurrier in the foreground with a 12x zoom? The other possibility is that it is a bird at a significantly higher altitude catching high speed winds, but the shape of the object does not appear to be bird-like. I did not view this with the naked eye but discovered it in my video afterward. This is all of the information I have.

It was only visible for about a quarter of a second during about seven seconds of "madness" when a wind came up suddenly. Consequently, someone at work who has a pilot's license thought it might be a plastic bag, but that seems unlikely to me. Apart from a mantaray, it makes you think of Lockheed’s F-117 Nighthawk or Northrop’s B2 Spirit. It is similar to the illustration of an object seen at Farnham Quebec, on 21 July 2017. That object was seen only from the front before it quickly departed, and was said to have windows. It was not portrayed from the side. The following screen capture is its tail, which was not portrayed in the Farnham case because probably not visible. I'm sorry if this is the second submission of the same thing. I'm sure I sent this one along before, but I don't see my record of having done so.

summary: A half-second image of a manta shaped object and its "tail" (in the second frame) from an infrared video; camera pointed upward
description: The object moved left to right for a half second in a seven second segment of madness. It’s similar to the online drawing of an object seen at Farnham Quebec, on 21 July 2017. That object was seen only from the front before it quickly departed, and was said to have windows. It was not portrayed from the side. The second shot is its tail, which was not portrayed in the Farnham case probably because not visible from the front. The object was only visible in infrared, not to the naked eye.

summary: An object moved into the field of an infrared camera pointed upward, did a motion reversal, split and moved off screen, but intact?
description: This was difficult to follow. In about half a second a bright object moved into the screen of an infrared camera facing upward from the lower left. It appeared to be headed out of the screen from the bottom but suddenly changed direction upward and appeared in full in the screen, but the shape was too ambiguous (to me) to figure out. It then split into two objects which quickly departed from the bottom left corner of the screen. It wasn't clear (to me) if the split objects recombined, or left in close proximity to each other. The whole thing was too bright and too quick. There was a wind, but this does not look or behave like wind-blown debris. Sorry - a lot of ambiguity.

summary: Three objects similar to the Davie Florida "egg" posted by NUFORC on 21 Dec 16 appeared on an infrared camera facing upward
description: I would not have submitted these images if it weren't for the NUFORC Gallery drawing of an "egg" or blimp-like object seen in Davie, Florida, on 15 December 2016 and posted by NUFORC on 21 December 2016. I can understand the submitter's desire for anonymity. The first image (23-28-07) is of a similar object which moved across the infrared camera screen from left to right. The following three images (23-46-07) are of a like object moving upward across the screen. The final image (23-46-11) is of a similar object closer to the camera moving left to right. There was a wind, which gives the impression that it was all just something blown around, but the three images (23-46-07) of an object moving upward was accompanied with other aerial "debris" (if that's what it was) that moved left to right. The night of 26 May 2022 was the only time I've seen this shape put in an appearance, but given that there was a wind, I can't say with certainty that they were anything more than aerial debris.

summary: A pale light blue craft moving east, no navigation lights.

It was a blue orbish shape...just moving. It was about 5-7 miles from my eyes view (as far I could tell) I was looking from my third story deck, facing the downtown Reno skyline, with RNO to my east. The color was a pale electric blue, looked identical to a star in the nights sky. Again no flashing lights where seen on the craft, unless it was at a greater distance than I could've comprehend. After about 30-40 seconds of eastward travel the craft abruptly faded away it took about 3-4 seconds to completely fade/disappear into the night sky. My thoughts; not landing lights, why light electric blue and solid in color? why no nav lights/strobes? No noise? Looking forward to hearing some feedback on this one...
