summary: Helicopter chasing an erratically flying light that abruptly accelerated and became extremely bright before disappearing.
description: 2 witnesses parked at Torrey Pines State Beach facing the water just after sunset. Observed two crafts several miles offshore - one obvious helicopter due to the pattern of flashing lights and predictable motion, and one smaller craft moving much quicker with a single unwavering white light. The paths of the two crafts appeared to nearly intersect and once they passed each other, the smaller craft abruptly changed its course heading due north to at first follow and then pass the helicopter. The helicopter pursued the smaller craft for several minutes, but the smaller craft was visibly accelerating ahead of the helicopter. Eventually, the craft decelerated, the brightness of the single light increased significantly, and then it vanished. The helicopter continued heading north. Sighting captured on dash cam - video submitted is enhanced with noise reduction (to reduce artifact from night filming), color correction (to brighten footage as it was night), and zoom (to view objects far away). Video is quite compressed due to file size limitations of submission site. Please contact via email for full size video file.

summary: Large object floating away from the moon

Hi there, my best friend, my sister and I witnessed something strange last night that left us shaken to our cores. We didn't get the best pic but my friend called on his way home and told me to look at the moon with no further direction,
I instantly saw what he was showing me... there was a weird object floating away from the moon, it looked like nothing any of us have ever seen. It was the shape of a rocket of some kind, but moved like a cloud, the shape had a nose and a tail and it consistently held its shape as it moved away with more persistence and direction than that of a cloud. We could clearly make out the pointed nose and raised tail as if it was some kind of rocket/ship
I had a panic attack and didn't get footage but my sister grabbed a pic on her iPhone 5.
We watched as the object floated away and disappear and we sat, in utter disbelief. We have searched news, YouTube, Facebook and the internet and can't find anything about it so far. Any info you could give us would be appreciated

summary: Red Lighted Sphere moving from west to east over the Satilla River.

I estimated the altitude to be about 10 degrees above the horizon. Also noted was the fact there was no sound associated with the light. Had it been an aircraft, I would have certainly been able to hear it. The estimated distance from my location was approximately one mile. I observed the light for about 7 seconds until it disappeared behind a copse of trees. It did not resume its path once behind the trees. The object appeared to be following near the path of the Satilla River.

There was no sound at all, so knew it wasn’t a plane, and it seemed like it was higher altitude than a plane would be. As I tracked with binoculars, the light’s apparent motion seemed to “slow down” in that it never left the NE quadrant of the sky it was in. It no longer behaved like a “normal” satellite that goes straight across from horizon to horizon. It kept getting lower and lower in the sky (but not dimmer), which made me think from its apparent motion that it had changed direction, and was moving away from my position/vantage point. After a couple of minutes, it disappeared beyond the horizon. The light or object or whatever it was, was quite bright the most of the time I saw it. summary: Caught On Camera During Blood Moon Lunar Eclipse
description:
I was facing south east when I took a pic of the Blood Moon lunar eclipse, and in doing so, I accidentally caught something very bizarre looking. This thing was NOT visible to the naked eye and I was very surprised when it showed up in the shot taken. I live in a very quiet neighborhood, so in addition to not being visible to the naked eye, this thing was completely silent. I am an aviation enthusiast, ex-military, and have spent a great deal of time around aircraft, both commercial and military. But I have never seen anything like it. Unsure of what to make of it and fearing ridicule, I stayed quiet, told no one, and moved on with daily life.
Until today 7/23/22, when I decided once again to do more extensive research as to what the thing could possibly be. Then I discovered this website, and saw that others had also seen something strange on the night of the Blood Moon eclipse. It felt reassuring to know I was not the only one. I had no idea there was an entity I could report the experience to and share my pic with. Had I known, I would have done it sooner.

summary: It was night time during the lunar eclipse and the triangular shaped craft came from the north and made a wide turn towards the moon.

That’s when I took notice of what the child was referencing in the sky.
My eyes opened wide and my brain slowly began to process and try to understand what I was seeing. A triangular shaped
object with no hard lines just 7 lights distinctly keeping the shape of a triangle almost as if the actual craft was invisibly cloaked. These lights moved in unison as if they were attached to a craft. Try to picture not bright lights but lights that are similar to how the stars look. (No blinking lights) I’ll attach a drawing.
The object had the size of a commercial jet that would be landing except this thing was high up in the sky leading me to believe that this UFO was of gargantua‘s proportions.
The craft slowly moved across the sky from the North and then began to make a wide left turn heading east towards the lunar eclipse without a sound being made. The sighting lasted about 1 minute and then the craft disappeared out view due to distance.
I was stunned…

summary: Small dot of light, looked like a satellite, moving in straight line. Then, sudden change of direction, significant change of speed.

An object caught both of our attention. I said something like “look, a satellite.” It was a small dot of light, like a star, moving steadily across the sky at a slow pace, in a perfectly straight line. Consistent pace. Then, suddenly, it stopped completely still for less than a second. Then, it dramatically changed direction and also changed speed. It went sort of perpendicular to its original direction for a couple of seconds, at a much faster pace than its original speed. Then it completely disappeared from view, very suddenly.
My wife and I both saw these exact same details. Neither of us could explain what we had just seen. It was unlike anything we had ever observed before. The entire event took about 10 seconds. We didn’t have our phones so we don’t know exactly what time it occurred. About 10-15 minutes later we found a clock, so we estimate the sighting around 9:20 pm.
We noted where in the sky we saw this. We used an app to understand what star it occurred near. Near the constellation “bootes” and specifically near the star “izar.”
The object was too far away…

But then, it either reappeared or a new one appeared to the southeast and was quite bright, perhaps a bit brighter than a typical sodium vapor street light seen from about a half mile (0.75km). It was if 20 or so smaller lights were traveling in perfect sync with each other in the shape of a V. It created an atmospheric disturbance that made it look similar to a nebula. We both were caught in both shock and slight horror. It made no sound, left no contrail, and was below the higher stratus clouds. It moved west for approximately ten to fifteen seconds and disappeared. We initially suspected it to be some Russian Spy plane. I immediately called my significant other and while describing what I saw, the craft returned. This time it was flying north to south. It began to shape shift into a straight line, a triangle, and almost a bird like shape. summary: Three small starlike objects in a perfect triangle, each one higher than the other and moving strangely - definitely not satellite
description: I’m a college student, and my roommate and I like to stargaze in the country. Neither of us believe in aliens and were only looking for shooting stars. We both noticed one “star” that was moving, and assumed it was a plane or satellite. This object started to move in shapes, some of which seemed like letters to us - we saw a deliberate “M” shape, an “S” and etc. We watched it for an hour wondering if we were seeing things, and looking at other stars to make sure it was actually moving in relation to them (which it was). We then noticed two fainter starlike objects very close to the main one, seemingly higher in the sky, making a perfect isosceles triangle. All three would move in strange jerky ways, unlike a satellite or plane. None of them moved very far from the original spots, and after making shapes, would return to their original positions. We have no idea what could be doing this and decided to report. All objects looked high enough to be outside the atmosphere, and several planes flew under them. They were white and generally just looked like stars, but twinkled more frequently.

Her and I witnessed the second object that followed the same pattern as the first object from east to west. The object was very bright, red /orange, orb shaped. I could see a square metal object in the center. There was a gray halo around the bright lights. The second object flew off at a high rate of speed and then slowly disappeared from sight. I took a photograph with my phone. The third object followed the same pattern, about 10 minutes later and I took a video. I will attach them here. I am very familiar with Starlink and have apps to track satellites, this was not a satellite.

summary: Spotted while waiting to photograph Starlink Satellites
description:
I have a Ph.D. and am an amateur photographer. I set up my Tamron ultra-telephoto zoom lens (SP 150-600 mm f5-6.3 DiVC) on a tripod to shoot the Starlink satellite pass over Lake Norman last night. I focused on the area where according to my Stellarium App the satellites would be visible from 8.20 PM onwards. I saw a yellow "star" that to the naked eye I assumed was probably Venus, but on closer examination through my lens it appeared to be a large circle surrounded by
a ring of bright white lights. Thinking this may be part of the satellite system I started shooting. When I developed the shots, most were blurry because the object was moving faster or more erratically than expected. I enhanced the clearest shot, which looks to be a bit too symmetrical for a planet or star. My neighbors were also watching from their docks and saw only the "star" but suggested sending the clear shot to you for further analysis.

summary: another very bright flasher
description: At 8 pm, while outside enjoying a warm evening, a long-duration (10 seconds) flasher appeared of brightness -6 (brighter than brightest Venus) in the southern sky at 50 deg declination. I refer to these sightings as flashers based on the typically instantaneous flashes of varying brightness that are almost a guaranteed viewing if one gives a half hour or more of continuous observation. As a 54yo lifelong skywatcher, I have seen well over 50 uap including close-ups, daytimers, and shapeshifters. I haven't seen an extraterrestrial that I am aware of. Over 50% of the sightings have been flashers. 0% were common satellites. The light of a flasher typically is of point-source starlike intensity vs dull, reflected light from satellites or planets. Normally the flashes are instantaneous or microseconds in duration but a few have been of seconds-long duration. Flashing light is a great way to send information I hear.

The police public safety report stated: "There have been no reports of overdue aircraft or ELT activations indicating an aircraft crash. A rescue team on a helicopter flew a mission around the Lazy Mountain area this morning and located nothing suspicious and there were no signs of crashed aircraft.
Further investigation revealed that a large commercial jet was flying in that area around the time that the photos and video were taken. The aircraft was contacted and reported normal flight operations on its way to JFK airport in New York. Troopers believe that the photos and videos showed a contrail from the commercial jet combined with the rising sun which together caused the unique atmospheric sight."

I looked out and saw a large white glowing orb at what looked to be maybe 5-7 miles. As we studied it, it started moving on what looked like a collision course with us, and at co-altitude. summary: I was passing by the Asheville airport in the afternoon, when I noticed a very bright object over the runway.
description:
The sighting occurred on March 3, at approximately 3:00 PM. I don't remember the exact time, since it was 6 months ago. Since I was passing an airport, my first thought was that it was an airliner, with the sun reflecting off it. Then, I realized that it was motionless, hovering just below a cloud, at no more than 3,000 feet, at maybe a 40 degree angle. It was elliptical in shape, as if viewing a saucer from edge on, very bright and glossy silver in color. It was definitely a solid, probably metallic, object. Just as I really focused on it, there was a blinding flash, then it was gone. I can't say if it simply disappeared, or sped off so quickly, that I couldn't track it. I was a passenger in the front seat of a vehicle, on the passenger/airport side of the vehicle, so I had an unobstructed view. The duration of the sighting, no more than ten seconds, did not allow me time to alert the other passengers, until after it had disappeared. It was a sunny day, with a few clouds.
I am a semi-retired radio broadcast engineer, and professional energy manager.

I filed another report on the same light that I saw in Cumberland Virginia on the 14th, this was the exact same light but larger since I was closer, and in a different county. I had been in the field in Cumberland again, this time actively looking for the UFO, but saw nothing. Once it started to rain, I packed it in and went to drive home. I only saw it for a few seconds as I was driving by, but I saw it long enough to watch it descend into the neighborhood. I quickly turned around and entered to see if I could see it again, but couldn't. In both this report and my other report, I do not check the "The object landed" box, since I saw it descend below the tree line both times, but I have no actual proof that it landed.
It's also worth mentioning, I think, that somebody online also posted a picture taken from Amherst Virginia a few days later of the exact same light. Amherst is only about an hour away from the locations where I sighted this light.

summary: Light moving L to R in sky above mountains, NNE of my location. After a short bit it just vanished.

My wife and I were driving NB on I-25 near Contreras, NM. I noticed a white light at about 020 relative position from my direction of travel. I felt my windshield and distance might be why I saw no flashing lights. My wife noticed it about five minutes after I first saw it. She thought it might be an early evening star, but as she started asking me about it, it just vanished. We both felt it was very odd and we could still make out the mountains, so we know it didn’t go behind them.
It seemed to bright and slow to have been a distant satellite, which we see a lot of from our home in Upper Michigan.
It may be nothing, but it was odd enough for me to report, just in case there are other reports from this time period or a similar described sighting. I was driving, so I was unable to take a picture. It seemed normal up to the moment it disappeared.

We were sitting around the fire, my parents and I, and I said, "Look at that!" My parents turned around and were amazed. We watched it for the next few minutes as it veered away toward the SW. It followed the cloud line.
What was strange were 4 factors.
1. No sound came from it. I expect it was 1,000 feet in the air. I fly drones, so I can somewhat estimate altitude of aircraft.
2. The glow that surrounded it was enormous and unwavering, even though it itself was quite small in comparison. It had no flashing lights. Just steady and bright.
3. As it drew near and passed by, I noticed the glow created a shape or a symbol. My mom saw that, too. The shape was that of a spiral galaxy with 2 arms. Or a pregnant "S," I guess.
4. My dad said he watched the actual object closely while my mom and I watched the glow. He said it looked as though it was swimming back and forth a bit. We thought maybe this was an optical illusion because it was going in…

summary: I got a photo
description: Saw this slowly move across the sky from north to south.

summary: Strange Sphere over Smilax
description: I first noticed a sphere-shaped object coming from the northwest going southward at a slow speed. The description is so hard to describe. It was a round object emitting a constant yellowish light. It looked like it was muted with something film-like blanketing over it (Similar to putting a cloth over a flashlight.) The light coming from it was a steady beam with a yellowish glow. There was no sound coming from it. The object did not fly out of sight, it just faded away. This was not the ISS, I was alerted to it approximately 7:20 via my ISS app. At the same time I saw an airplane that looked to be flying at a higher altitude.

summary: Object was bright white to bluish white. The night was completely clear but the object looked like it had a fog or cloud around it.
description: Was taking trash out and noticed a bright light in the sky. Looked up and thought it was a helicopter. Did not notice movement at first. Was in the north northeast part of the sky. Slowly moved in a generally west or southwest direction. Went in the house to get people to come and see it, they witnessed it as well but it had moved much further away and wasn’t as visible. The object was generally spherical but you could not focus on details of the object. It looked like a cloud or fog surrounded the object. It was self illuminated but, it didn’t seem to be reflecting light. The color was a bright white almost bluish with a slight purplish or red hue, but faint. Tried to drive to get a better view but never saw it again. The sky was completely clear, no high level clouds and no fog in the area that evening. There was no noise associated with the object. Could not tell if the object was very large and far away or smaller and closer. Was not starlink or space station, moved in the opposite direction of satellites/ISS. Was not a Chinese lantern. SpaceX launched that night but we are too far north to have seen anything associated with the launch.

summary: I look up at the sky and photograph quite often. What I saw yesterday evening was different.
description: I looked up to the sky and saw a shadow in the sky. So I photographed to see if my phone would catch it. It did. But then I thought it could be an orb. So I took video. The shadow stayed fixed. There were lights coming from it but it stayed still.

summary: Bright dancing light that was about 40 feet in the air, then vanished.
description: One light appeared suddenly on the other side of the pond when I and my friend were on while stargazing. The light caught me and my friends' full attention for about 5 to 6 seconds I would say. As the event occurred we both could not explain this happening in nature or from a man-made structure. The light seemed to dangle/dance moving up in down right next to the road that was very dark with some cars passing by. There is only one house right near where we saw the orange light and when it dipped down it might have touched the ground possibly being a ufo abduction.

summary: I’m a commercial airline pilot.
description: While flying at FL 380, at 0055z I observed a round white donut and a lighted moving object within it. The observation lasted five minutes. Sky conditions at cruise altitude were clear with unlimited visibility. No moon illumination was present in the starlit sky. Winds aloft were 310/20 and my ground speed was 445 knots. There was a scattered undercast cloud layer with tops around 10,000 ft. The glowing object within the donut was slowing moving, and I do not attribute its movement to autokinesis. After five minutes of observation the lit object vanished and the white donut dissipated within a minute. One photo was taken.

summary: We were outside and we saw a bright light so we recorded it and checked flight radars and it didn’t Show up was much brighter then any airplane in the sky the pictures where taken with night mode on…
White dot with 3 cloudy rings with top and bottom truncated. Diameter 2 ft of my vision. Fades to nothing in 60 Seconds. Sky was clearish, bright stars were visible. Did not move.
Moving point of light (a satellite?) surrounded by a spiral shaped haze in an otherwise crystal clear night
description:
Monday Jan 31 appx 6:50pm cst with clear skies. I walked outside and looked into the sky. To the North I noticed a point of white light high in the sky moving to the SSW. I assumed it was a satellite as I could not detect any flashing lights. I see lots of satellites. The only reason I took notice is that it seemed to be passing through a haze, like a fog or a wispy cloud. All of the other stars in the sky were crisp and clear. I thought that the “cloud” must be a rogue and the satellite would quickly pass through it and become “crisp and clear” as well.
I was facing to the west and the object was high in the sky (maybe 15-20 degrees west of my zenith) and passed from my right to my left. It never escaped the haze. In fact as it got more overhead I could see that the “cloud” was in the form of a spiral around the object, a two-armed spiral with each arm curling away from the object on opposite sides. From end to end it took up maybe 20 degrees of the sky.The spiral cloud was not very thick but was definitely noticeable and undeniably in a spiral shape. The spiral cloud did NOT seem to be rotating in any way. It just moved along with the object. And if not for the hazy spiral the…

summary: large tree size mass like a glowing round clous movingfrom north to south then changed into a cylindrical shape and headed west
description: A large ball shaped glowing mass looked like it was drifting toward my location headed south at a slow speed. It then changed into a cylindrical shape and headed west . The cylinder shape began extending down toward the ground and disappeared. I would guess the size to be100-150 feet long and about half that distance in diameter. The position of the cylindrical shape was vertical to the ground and the only well defined lines were the vertical outline of the cylinder shape. I did not recognize any surfaces that appeared to be solid and saw no lights The sky was clear of clouds .

summary: We were walking and saw a weird non-blinking shape
description: We were taking a walk and noticed a weird shape in the sky and decided to take some pictures. Normally something like this would be blinking but there were no flashing lights, just this weird shape flying from North to South.

summary: Spiral ufo emitting some type of trail
description: Was walking to the public bathroom, looked up in the sky because I thought it was the moon. Next thing I see it moving quite fast and two spiral tails coming off of it. Soon after I called my mom and dad out of there RV and they were flabbergasted. Was one of the most amazing things I have ever seen.

summary: Spiral ufo changing shape
description: My son was going to use the public restroom and saw a spiral object in the sky. Soon after came running back to our camper and had me and my husband see it too

summary: This object was traveling from the north to the south. It had no sound. Had a bright Halo around it. Seemed to be slowing down. Me my wife and a friend were out on our Backyard Deck when this object…
Big white orb moving south across the sky at a fast pace, and then vanished.
description: There was a big, bright white orb with a haze around it, quickly moving across the sky to the south. I took a video of the object and when zooming in, there appears to be an object in the center creating that haze around it. Once the object got across the field it vanished into almost a mist. Images uploaded, are separate frames of the video.

summary: Brightly lit object appeared at 6:48pm at 20° above horizon approximately center between polaris and cassiopia
description: Brightly lit object, intense white brightness at center but indiscernable shape, however it had a massive light blue glow surrounding the object, in the shape of a two-armed spiral that didnt change but appeared larger as it approached. It started from the north, at about a fist and a half higher than the horizon, it was so bright it illuminated the tree tops at my neighbor's property. As it moved south-west it became a bit higher maybe 30° above horizon as measured by closed fist. It appeared to be moving very slowly and at a low altitude, it moved about 90°-100° west taking about 9 minutes to move from its appearance in the north to disapearance in the west. It didn't disappear per se, it faded and appeared smaller as it got further away. No sound was heard from the object at all. Very clear skies tonight as many stars and constellations are visible however there is a light low mist or fog. Immediatly after observing its appearance I brought my ten year old son outside to witness it with me. We have no conclusion what it could be, but both agree it was unique and spectacular.

summary: Elliptical light inside cloud formation moving south at a slow speed.
description: Looked north and noticed an elliptical star/ galaxy type light inside what appeared to be a cloud- it was slowly moving south/southwest from me. Watched for a minute then filmed a video. Went inside and got someone else to come look at it and watched it continue to move south until it was past our view and below the tree line. It appeared to have changed shape and color from a blue to more an orange color once I returned outside.

summary: I first saw this cigar shape fairly brightin the northern sky, there was glowing around it on two sides, like if it was shining light.
description: A bright cigar shaped light in the northern sky, it was moving directly overhead towards the South at a steady speed. It lit up what looked like clouds around it on two sides. Fairly close to it at first then the lighted up area around it seemed to spread the out wider as it went directly further South. I watched it fly directly overhead as it went South at a steady speed. I've seen satelites before and it was similar in its velocity. But satelites are high enough up that their reflected light does not light up any clouds or anything like that which are below it. The light on the sides was like a glowing light, and it spread out further as it went further South and out of view.. This is the strangest thing I've ever seen in the sky. The sky was not clear but partly cloudy I believe before sundown. I first saw this not too ling after sunset, but was pretty dark by then.

summary: Swirling Vortex with a halo, White bluish in color, moving from the north to the southwest.
description: Starry night, Just finishing up cutting wood and making it back to our house with a full load in the truck. I looked up after opening our gate and noticed a White bluish star. At first thought it was an airplane, it was not blinking, then thought it was a satellite. As it got closer it began to create a bluish halo then a brighter plasma like spewing from each side and started to swirl as it was still moving with no sound. Kind of like the "Norway swirl" but moving faster and no tail. I ran to the house and got my wife who witnessed it too, I then grabbed my Video camera and started shooting video. This lasted for about 4 minutes and kept going southwest. I will try to lighten this video and send it too you soon!

summary: My daughter, my son and myself, were just getting out of our car when my daughter said "look at the the sky", so I did and saw a spiral forming north of coffeyville toward Independence, Ks. As we…
Spiraling slowly southwest
description: My kids said they were playing “worm hole” because they saw one. We all came out to see a spiraling light around a sphere of light traveling slowly and silently southwest for about 15-18 minutes before dimming out of sight. Clear skies, airplanes and stars were visible without the same haze that twisted around the moving sphere/light.

summary: white light in oval shape surrounded by a cloud
description:
I saw what looked like head lights from a jet approaching from the north. It was under a cloud - so I watched to see what it was when it flew out of the cloud. It never did. The cloud was always surrounding it. I quickly realized it was moving too slow and too low to be a jet. The light was white and constant - no other color light. Just white steady light. Did not pulse. As it got closer, I could see a cylinder or oval shaped something that glowed white moving slowly to the south with a cloud surrounding it. No noise.
The night was clear. No clouds except the moving object. The stars were bright. The moon was not shinning. Moon phase was wane cresent at 1% illumination, but it was not up yet. I checked the weather station at Frontenac State Park at that time. Wind was at 9 mph from the southeast. the temp was 28.4 degrees F. The dewpoint was 19.4 and the humidity at 68.56. This was at 7p.m. The Frontenac State Park station is about 1/2 mile from the location where I saw the object. The object was moving north to south. It was moving into the wind.
I cannot tell how high up the object was, but when it passed over an old med sized maple tree in our yard the cloud was a bit wider…

summary: Objects coming out of a luminous cloud
description: We witnessed two bright objects come out of a cloud that seems to be lit up from the inside. The sun has already set.

summary: 2 white orb/spheres in the sky with white cloud mist
description:
I was walking inside and saw two white orbs that appeared to be separating from one another. They both eventually disappeared.
There was this weird white mist that looked like clouds.
I have video and picture footage.
Orbs disappeared and mist remained.
The color white looked illuminated while the other clouds got darker with the sunset.

summary: It went sideways and then straight into the sky disappearing
description:
I was on my way to have dinner with friends. I was in slow moving traffic. I noticed a rocket coming sideways leaving a large trail behind it. You can see the trail of smoke in my photos. It then seemed to stop midair and release what I thought was its jet propulsion system. But then the item released started to fly separately. The main diamond shaped rocket or UFO then went straight up into the air into space very very fast and released another item that flew separately. It was hard to see so far away… I have a Tesla so I put it onto autonomous drive so I could use my phone and zoom in. This was so close to Miami’s buildings and the airport that I was confused. I tried to be relational and think of what it could be? There were bright lights white and at times a small red light.
I am a 61 year old college graduate from Boston University with a family and am a respected member of my community. I am a philanthropist and a world traveler. I live in South Florida. I have never seen a flying object move in this manner.
In my photos you will see the reflection in my car which I tried to differentiate from the flying objects. Thank you. Did anyone else report this?

It continues slow and smooth. Watched for about ten seconds and the orb fizzled and changed to a reddish color and disappeared. No cloud clear night

summary: We saw a light hovering that appeared to have another smaller orbiting sphere, it appeared out of nowhere and disappeared as suddenly
description: My wife and I were enjoying the sunset around 5:35pm on January, 31 2022 when we noticed a bright white dot in the sky. We were looking eastward toward a peak called Lone Peak in the Wasatch Mountain range. The only land behind our home is BLM land with no buildings or lights just mountain terrain and high desert vegetation so we had a clear unobstructed view of this. We thought it was a star at first but the time of day seemed too early for a star to be so visible and bright. We watched it for several minutes and observed that there appeared to be two dots with one stationary and the other appearing to orbit the other or move side to side either in front or behind. As the sunset progressed the colors changed on the peaks but the object just stayed in the same place so we had a pretty good idea that this object was stationary and not moving with the orbit or movement of the sky. We watched this for about 20-25 minutes then the lights got dimmer and two smaller lights appeared below the center object so now there were 3 separate lights lined up vertically and they all got dimmer and dimmer then disappeared. That’s all we saw and for the next 45 minutes we continued to look in the…

It appeared 5 separate times and would hide back and forth behind the clouds. Some of the appearances had the streams behind it like a jet. It was so bright like as if it was iridescent. It had no sound. Last time it came by it had a set of wings on each side .

I thought it might be a satellite or a planet so decided to take a photo with my phone camera. 2 days later I saw the same thing and took another photo. summary: We were leaving the work and as we were about to turn on the road we saw a cluster of 3 orange lights
description: The orange lights formed a triangle and moved in formation across the sky, each light slowly disappeared, appearing as if it went up and slowly faded out of view.

summary: Many red lights on the east side of Audubon that looked almost like stars that formed a disorganized triangle.
description: I saw many red lights (8) similar to a star but closer to earth and they did flicker. In the sky on the east side of Audubon while I was driving. There was many cars behind me so I was trying to be safe. I thought it looked like a water tower because there is one further down on the south side. But clearly this was not . And I felt scared and thought these are UFOs. I pulled off into a neighborhood and they were disappearing quickly. And then all gone. I drove through the neighborhood with my niece on the phone and I saw 2 more on north side of town. I had my niece on FaceTime so she could see it. She said I see a red light. And then they were gone. I drove further to see if I could see them again but I didn’t see them again. It was all very fast . But I new it was nothing I have ever seen. They formed a disorganized triangle. That is why I thought it was some kind of structure. As of now I haven’t heard of anyone else seeing what I saw. Which is strange because it was in the busy part of town .

summary: MADAR Node 70
MADAR Node 100
Moving lights moving somewhat in sync crossed half the sky and disappeared/went out one at a time

When I finished I was about to make a right turn onto Glendale when I saw these four glowing orbs/lights in the sky. I was looking towards the north and I would estimate they were at about a 27 degree angle above the northern horizon (roughly a quarter of the way up from the horizon). I got my phone out and recorded for one minute and 32 seconds. At the start of the video (0:00) the orbs are visible and they slowly move almost in tandem towards my vantage point. At (0:16) I attempt to zoom in and see what the lights are. The zoom proved to be quiet out of focus so I went back to being zoomed out (0:21). For the next several seconds the lights continued coming closer but now seem to be slightly out of sync in their movements. At (0:29) the second closest light seems to begin to dim and slowly goes out/disappears. By (0:35) that light is no longer visible. By (0:38) the closest light also goes out. The remaining lights come quite close to each other and seem to go partially around each other and then begin to separate. Again at (0:56) I tried to zoom into the lights and zoom…

summary: Silent, dark, broadside cigar.
description: While looking up at night stars. I realize an object cover the stars of orion's belt. Moving SE over my position I could see a dark (blackish) cigar shaped craft crossing overhead creating no noise and with no lights. The object was traveling broadside at about 70-80 knots at approximately 600 feet. The width was around 100 feet and 25 feet high.

summary: At a glance it looked like a star then I felt a burning sensation and zoomed video and noticed the pulsing or thrusting.
description: I was on post at Raytheon Gate Redstone Arsenal had been watching it rather shacken the patrol guard came through gate around 8pm 1/29/22 and I pointed out to him as well (Brandon). I honestly felt a burning sick vertigo feeling. Brandon got out just for a couple of minutes got back I'm patrol vehicle and I'm going to get inside. Im sure Inoticed this while coming into Huntsville on 72. I have included video of the the sitting Saturday 1/29/22 same general area around 5:45am.

summary: Slow moving light across sky, that flickers and dissappears
description: As we drove home to Fort Dodge Iowa from Webster city Iowa, i noticed what I initially thought was a star. But a star I'd never seen in the night sky before (I'm very familiar with the night sky as I've always wanted to be an astrophysicist or aerospace engineer). And as we drove, I realized that the object was moving slowly across the sky. The object was fairly large, and very, very bright. Bright enough to outshine all but maybe one star in the sky. I told my girlfriend to take a left, and go west down a gravel road. When she did, I told her to stop the car and see if I could get a video of the object. In the video, I held the camera still enough to be able to see it move across the sky. I was paying attention to my screen to ensure a good video, but then I realized I might get better quality if I taped it in the raw camera mode on my phone. So I had stopped the video, switched to raw, and pointed my phone back at the sky. To my surprise, the bright object had seemingly vanished from the sky. That's when I wondered, if maybe I had captured it disappearing on my initial video. When I went and watched, during the last maybe 4 or 5 seconds of the video, you can watch it completely…

summary: It hovered
description: Seen something hovering and watched it for a while, took video I have two clips. It kept changing shape. Then my phone died. I added two other clips from a while ago of some objects I seen at night. Both happened while I was in my back yard. Since covid hit I have been paying more attention to the sky. I am a ufo skeptic, but these I don’t know what they are.

summary: Object in sky that hovered and glowed dim to bright for long time
description:
I went to warm up my car. I saw a cylindrical object brightening and dimming in the sky. I thought it was a helicopter, but heard no noise. After it hovered for approximately 5 minutes, I went and got my phone. I recorded 7 minutes the best I could, and tried zooming. Not a very good video. I went in and woke up my wife. She watched it for 10 more minutes, while I got ready for work. The total time it was where I saw it was about 25 minutes, and it never moved.
The screenshots were taken from video. The video is too large to upload. I elected to have an investigator contact me only if they want the video or have any questions.

location: Peakhurst Heights, New South Wales, Australia
summary: objects where flying on a line formation one behind the other. around 20 to 30 objects were count
description: Just staring at the night stars when the moving lights where noticed. And it wasn't the first time but now it was two of us :) please watch video.

summary: Beautiful LARGE white-tailed shooting star
description:
An amazingly large (or close to earth) object passed by, creating a white tail behind it. The entirety of it sparkled, and it was headed north, slightly northwest. In appearance it looked like a huge shooting star, but was distinctive in that it moved in slow-motion, was incredibly large, and was white with a thick tail that slowly dissipated as it moved. It was quite the sight.
It is certainly not a STARLINK satellite, nor an International Space Station, nor was there any natural phenomenon slated for tonight.

summary: 20+ triangular craft hovering in sky above us
description: Was stargazing with my husband and i noticed an area of the sky with lighter spots, but didnt say anything. A few minutes later, my husband asked if i see those bright areas. I took my phone out and took a picture that showed many triangular objects sitting at various angles, in the sky above us. We stayed watching for 5 minutes and went inside after feeling watched.

summary: Strange moving object in the sky
description: I was sitting outside when I noticed two airplane in the southern sky heading north in my direction the"plane" closest to me looked different, brighter, rounder and moving irradically so I pulled out my cell phone that had the best zoom capabilities of any cell phone the Samsung s21 Ultra 5G and took a couple snapshot. The photos looked strange so I started recording. You can see in the recording the strange way it moved. Side note: just before you hear me say, "Dam it" the ufo is moving back and forth that is me moving the camera trying to find it or center it. I film the craft for about 1 or 2 min then it fit small and disappeard, vanished it didn't fly away, it was just gone in the blink of an eye. A few days later a black unmarked helicopter showed up and hovered by me over my apartment complex were id seen the ufo for about 15 minutes with a light flashing. Strange I filmed it for a minutes and have included the footage in this. report. The photo with the read/orange gets quite interesting when you put it thru different camera filters.

summary: It was round but had little windows on sides then later we had a orb about 30 foot off ground
description: The object was round and had windows and we could see what looked like beings inside it flu in straight line and yes it had lights and little later we seen a orb like 30 foot off the grown this is the truth me and my son both seen both

summary: Three huge orbs in a V formation above the hilltop in California
description: My boyfriend and I went for a night hike like we normally do on Fire trail in Castro Valley and when we got to the piece we noticed a large bright orange circle in the sky it was above the hilltop and the planes flying in were so very little compared to this orb we can to ponder what it was and suddenly there was three they hovered in a V formation they change colors very rapidly they pull stated they were very bright they were much much larger than any aircraft flying into the airports and you can clearly see that in the videos day at one point blue and absorbed one another and then came back out of each other and flew around each other and they stayed there pretty much the whole time we were walking about 25 to 30 minutes we immediately when we noticed that there was more than one and that it definitely wasn't a plane we took out our phones and tried to document anything that we could and the distance from us to the crafts I believe is over 10 miles so they were quite large

summary: Three orange perfectly symmetrical triangle formation lights
description: My significant other and I had just parked and got out of the car to head into a grocery store to get things for dinner. It was dusk and as we started walking towards the entrance she pointed up and goes "Look at those lights". There were 3 orange lights in the sky unblinking sitting in the sky in a triangle formation. At first I thought it was those Chinese lamps that people release but quicky realized they were far too high up to be those and the perfect triangle was too odd for those. The lights were probably 15 thousand maybe 20 feet up in the sky with at least 200 yards if not more between each light and we're unmoving. I noticed a plane (probably commercial seeing as we aren't far from Jacksonville International Airport) was flying somewhat below the left bottom point of the triangle. Quickly one disappeared then another and by the time we knew it all the lights simply were gone. Sadly my phone was charging at home and hers couldn't snap a clear picture.

summary: Two tic tac or oval items came in from tree tops then one shot off into stars
description:
While I was hunting in a tree stand along a ridge near St. Stephens, Alabama, I had a peculiar experience. The area, once an Indian village and the location of the original sawmill, holds a significant paranormal history. Due to ongoing chemo treatments for my stomach tumor, I decided to leave the stand at dusk instead of waiting for complete darkness. Approximately 5:45 pm or so. As I made my way out, I noticed a commercial plane flying overhead towards Mobile.
Approximately a few minutes after the plane passed, i thought this is a perfect night to “call the others,” and used my version of CE-5. I have seen UAPs my whole life and most of them have been witnessed by lots of people. I have never really tried this before but I sensed something was off. Within 5 minutes of just walking and calling, I saw two orbs appearing at treetop level, seemingly coming from the northwest along Mobile Cut Off Road almost right to me. I observed them crossing the horizon, and watched them as I was walking for a few minutes and decided to see if they would photograph. I managing to capture photos and a video as they approached the tree line to my east. One of the orbs swiftly ascended into the sky,…

summary: The craft flew over, without sound, made a turn and disappeared into the clouds.
description: The craft was dark gray with 3 round opaque lights on the bottom. One forward light and a light on each wing. It flew over the General Dynamics building and turned above my hotel. And then it faded into the clouds. No sound at all. I had time enough to observe it, but it was gone before I could video it. I wasn’t scared by it because I remembered that the US is working on a new aircraft but this was certainly different.

summary: We were checking our security cameras again today and we caught this UAP.
description: We have seen these bright lights every day. Today, we caught it in broad day light and it was emitting some type of gas. We can't see it with the naked eye, just on our infrared camera.

location: Palmerston North, Manawatu-Wanganui Region, New Zealand

Saturday, January 22, approximately 3-4pm. Leaving Montesano Washington and driving on Highway 12, going to Aberdeen. Driving on the straight stretch of highway I noticed an object in the sky. Roughly 100 feet in the air was a chrome, diamond shaped craft in the sky. It was three dimensional and from my angle I could see its depth and edges. I was lucky that I didn't crash while watching it. The feeling of shock and confusion lasted long after the event.
I had gone home and journaled my sighting to preserve the details; and I consulted my journal while writing this report. I'm submitting this report to both MUFON and NUFORC.

The color of the light was not white-hot like a meteor, but, more yellow, and the light was not from a sharp point, but rather seemed to have a haze around it. I did not notice any trail of smoke or debris following it. As it traveled, the brightness did not seem to fade significantly like a meteor does as it disintegrates.
Very probably, there is a simple explanation, such as a guided missile test, but, I’ve not seen nor heard of one in this area. Nor do I know where to find information thereof.

summary: A sttange object with three wings took flight from ground level and disappeared into a northern direction upwards.

I saw an object take off from ground level, quite far from me. At first I thought it was a passenger jet, since it was taking off from the vicinity of George airport, as seen from my point of view. I kept looking, as I was intrigued by the sharp angle upwards of the flight path.
We were watching the sunset from our balcony while I witnessed the aircraft gaining height. After a few moments, the flight path seemed totally strange and I pointed it out to my parents and my wife.
My father fetched his binoculars. The object changed his direction from flying westwards towards Hartenbos, to flying in a northern direction.
We all got a chance to have a look at the object through the binoculars. It had three wings around its main body, comparable to a rocket with three wings evenly around it. The whole aircraft was unmistakably rotating while it was flying further upwards. All four persons present saw the constant rotation of the object. The craft was yellow and shining in the light of the sunset. It kept getting smaller and smaller as it gained height in a northern direction until it was too small to observe. The whole sighting was more than ten minutes long. There was no sound audible.

summary: Series of 4 red-orange spheres moving SW–NE
description: Conditions: calm, overcast, ceiling perhaps 10,000 ft. Saw first object near horizon, a single solid red-orange light. Thought it might have been an aircraft taking off from Manteo Airport, but it displayed no navigation lights. Difficult to estimate size, distance, or speed, but all three seemed constant. It passed NW of my location, covering the field of view in 2–3 min. As it moved out of sight, a second appeared in the SW and behaved likewise except that it seemed to pass slightly closer. As it moved out, a third appeared and followed a parallel, but slightly closer track. As THAT moved out, a fourth appeared and passed even closer. The last three may have been redder than the first. The fourth may have exhibited very slight, rapid variations in brightness. No sound audible above background noise—fireworks in town (ca. 1 mi. SE), traffic, and so on. No one to whom I have spoken since saw these objects.
